Additionally, the creature attempting to activate must make on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take lightning damage equal to engineer level, and become {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the start of its next turn. On a successful save the creature takes half damage and is not {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}. Regardless of success or failure, the creature drops your modified lightsaber.

entries.name: Blastsaber Conversion
entries: {@i Incompatible with other conversions} You heavily modify your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} to allow you to make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}. With this modification, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d6 energy damage.

Additionally, when you make your first attack on your turn, you can alter the properties of your modified lightsaber. Until the start of your next turn, the damage type of your modified lightsaber is changed to ion.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Brightsaber Conversion
entries: {@i Incompatible with other conversions} You modify your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, giving it a brighter glow. While activated, your modified lightsaber sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

Additionally, when you make your first attack on your turn, you can alter the properties of your modified lightsaber. Until the start of your next turn, the damage type of your modified lightsaber is changed to fire.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Burn Through
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with your modified lightsaber, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make against that creature.

entries.name: Comfortable Handle
entries: You make minor modifications to the ergonomics of your modified saber's hilt. Your modified lightsaber gains {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Crossguard
entries: You add an energy guard at the base of your modified lightsaber's blade. While wielding your modified lightsaber, you gain a +1 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} against melee weapon attacks.

entries.name: Disruptorsaber Conversion
entries: {@i Incompatible with other conversions} You modify your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, causing it to eminate a sickly green light. Your modified lightsaber loses the luminous property.

Additionally, when you make your first attack on your turn, you can alter the properties of your modified lightsaber. Until the start of your next turn, the damage type of your modified lightsaber is changed to acid.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Extended Beam
entries: You install a series of beam focusing amplifiers into your modified lightsaber. Your modified lightsaber gains the reach property.

entries.name: Greatsaber Array
entries: You augment the configuration of your modified lightsaber. Your modified lightsaber gains the two-handed property, and it's damage die increases to 1d12.

entries.name: Intense Beam
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Burn Through} Your modified lightsaber's {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range increases by 1.

entries.name: Magnetic-Lock Grip
entries: You insert a series of magnetically charged grips into your modified lightsaber's hilt. While wielding your modified lightsaber, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to disarm or avoid being disarmed.

entries.name: Prototype Blastsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Blastsaber Conversion} You fine tune your blastsaber. When you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to cause your modified lightsaber to let loose a burst of energy. Creatures other than yourself within 5 feet of the target creature must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, they take ion damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Prototype Brightsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Brightsaber Conversion} You fine tune your brightsaber. When you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to blind the target of the attack. The creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}.

entries.name: Prototype Disruptorsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Disruptorsaber Conversion} You fine tune your disruptorsaber. When you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to knock the target of your attack prone. The creature must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

entries.name: Returning Weapon
entries: You install a retractible chain in the hilt of your modified lightsaber. Your modified lightsaber gains the thrown property with a range of 20/60, and when you throw the weapon, it immediately returns to your hand.

entries.name: Astrotech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Astrotech Engineering discipline focus on utilizing their vast knowledge of droid technology to confuse, confound, and destroy enemy tech, droids and constructs.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

entries.name: Electronic Warfare Platform
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 3rd, 9th, and 17th level} You learn to modify your {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} into a mobile electronic warfare platform. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify your {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}. You must have {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} in order to perform this modification.

Your electronic warfare platform is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your electronic warfare platform has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

Your electronic warfare platform comes equipped with electromagnetic projection and sensing systems, enabling three fields: ionizing, jamming, and targeting. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate a field, which lasts for 1 minute, causing an effect determined by the field. Only one field can be active at a time, and you can end your field at any time on your turn, no action required. The range of your barriers increases to 15 feet at 9th level and 30 feet at 17th level. You can use these fields a combined number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, as shown in the engineer table. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Ionizing Field
entries: Whenever a droid or construct other than you starts its turn within 5 feet of you, it gains 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels and takes ion damage equal to half your engineer level.

entries.name: Jamming Field
entries: Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you are forced to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} by a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, the creature gains a bonus to the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

entries.name: Targeting Field
entries: You and friendly creatures within 5 feet of you gain a bonus to the first ranged weapon damage rolls you make each round equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

entries.name: Potent Electromagnetism
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 3rd level} Once per round, when you deal damage to a droid or construct, you can expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to deal an extra 2d6 damage to that target. The damage is the same type as the source of the damage.
The damage increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to 3d6 at 5th level, 5d6 at 10th level, and 8d6 at 15th level.

entries.name: Direct Controller
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 6th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level} Your mastery of droids improves your ability to manipulate them. When you cast a power that could affect only droids or constructs, and you only affect droids with the power, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Systems Hijack
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 14th level} All droids, constructs, and creatures wearing or holding a {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} focus within 120 feet are viable targets for any {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} which you cast with a range of touch.

entries.name: Electromagnetic Burst
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 18th level} As an action, you can end your field in a electromagnetic burst of power with an effect determined by the field you were generating.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Ionizing Burst
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that are within 60 feet. Each must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 ion damage and is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and isn't {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}.

entries.name: Jamming Burst
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that are within 60 feet. Once in the next minute, when a chosen creature fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} caused by a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or is hit by an attack power, the creature can choose to succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or have the attack miss instead.

entries.name: Targeting Burst
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that are within 60 feet. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC or be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} for 1d4+1 turns.

entries.name: Astrotech Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: AI Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to melee tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: AI Rangefinder
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to ranged tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Advanced Hardening
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Hardening} You have resistance to ion damage.

entries.name: Advanced Grounding System
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Grounding System} You have resistance to lightning damage.

entries.name: Advanced Jamming Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Jamming Phased  Array} While your jamming field is active, any hostile creature within the field must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on the power.

entries.name: Advanced Ionizing Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Pulsating Phased  Array} While your ionizing field is active, your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and class features ignore resistance to ion damage, and immunity to ion damage is instead treated as resistance from any creature within range of your field.
Additionally, when you use your Ionizing Phased Array feature, you create a fourth blast.

entries.name: Advanced Targeting Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Targeting Phased  Array} While your targeting field is active, as an action, you can allow a number of allies within the field up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one) to use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against a single target you can see.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Droid Restraints
entries: When you would install a {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt}, you can do so in half the time. Additionally, when determining the save DC of a {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} you control, you can use your tech save DC, if it would be higher than the item's DC.

entries.name: Flashlight Attachment
entries: You affix a targeted light to your electronic warfare platform. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can toggle the light on or off. While on, your electronic warfare platform sheds bright light in a 60-foot cone.

entries.name: Fadecasting Controller
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Grounding System
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against lightning damage.

entries.name: Hacked Communications
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you may choose any number of creatures that you can see within 60 feet of you that have commlinks, headcomms, or other such communications devices. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take sonic damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). Additionally, on a failed save, their communication devices are disabled until rebooted.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Hardening
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against ion damage.

entries.name: Intelligence Core Override
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You can cast the {@i override interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} at 5th level without spending tech points.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Ionizing Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While your ionizing field is active, as an action, you can send forth blasts of directed ionic energy. Make two ranged tech attacks against targets within the field. These attacks can target the same creature or different ones. Make separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} for each blast. The attack deals 1d6 ion damage on a hit.

entries.name: Jamming Phased Array
entries: While your jamming field is active, as an action, you can choose a number of creatures concentrating on a power equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of one) within your field, and force them to make a {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb} {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If you cause at least one creature to lose {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a power using this feature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make all creatures that lost {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} take ion damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Miniaturized Repulsor Coils
entries: Your electronic warfare platform can store 20 lb., not exceeding 1 cubic foot, which does not count towards your encumbrance.

entries.name: Prototype Transmitter
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} You further tweak your transmitter design, extending the area of your fields.  When you activate a field you may choose to double the radius of your field.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Prototype Grounding System
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Grounding System} You have immunity to the {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} condition.

entries.name: Prototype Jamming Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Jamming Phased Array} While your jamming field is active, when a creature within your field attempts to cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cast the {@i tech override} power at 3rd level without spending tech points. When you cast this power using this feature and you make the {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check as a part of this casting, you add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the check.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Prototype Ionizing Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Ionizing Phased Array} While your ionizing field is active, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or use a class feature that affects other creatures within the radius of your field, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the power's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against the power, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.
Additionally, when you use your Ionizing Phased Array feature, you create a third blast.

entries.name: Prototype Targeting Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Target Marking Phased Array} While your targeting field is active, as an action, you can cast the {@i scramble interface} power at 3rd level without spending tech points.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Redundant Circuits
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level} You can have two fields active at a time.

entries.name: Rendcasting Controller
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Dexterity or Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Sensor Scramblers
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} All creatures within 10 feet of you become undetectable to electronic sensors and cameras for the next 10 minutes. Anything these creatures are wearing or carrying is also undetectable, so long as it's on the creature's person. The creatures are still visible to regular vision.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Stealth Field Generator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} You integrate a portable, personal cloaking device into your electronic warfare platform. Activating or deactivating the generator requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} that rely on sight. The generator lasts for 1 minute. This effect ends early if you make an attack or cast a force or {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.
Once the generator has been activated, it can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Targeting Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While your targeting field is active, as an action, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier you can see within 60 feet (a minimum of one creaeture), and force them to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, all ranged weapon attacks made by allies within your field against the target have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.name: Truelight Attachment
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Flashlight Attachment} You modify your electronic warfare platform with a toggle allowing you to briefly gain enhanced sight. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate the {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} feature of your electronic warfare platform. When toggled on, for the next minute your electronic warfare platform now automatically dispel illusions and can detect invisibility, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Withercasting Controller
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: X-Ray Targeting
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You tweak your sensors to find weak points in thick armor. Your weapon attacks and {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} deal double damage against constructs.

entries.name: Astrotech Engineering (Companion)
entries: Those engineers who choose the Astrotech Engineering discipline focus on crafting and upgrading their droid companions.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

entries.name: Droid Companion
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 3rd, 11th, and 17th level} You employ all the knowledge you've accumulated to create and bond with your own droid companion.

Create your droid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} in order to create your droid.
In addition to its traits and features, your droid companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your droid is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

Your droid gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each droid trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of droid traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, when you would use your action to cast a 1st-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can instead have your droid companion cast it. You still expend tech points as normal, and if the power requires {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}, it still uses your {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}. Your droid companion must use its action, and it uses its tech attack modifier and tech save DC instead of your own. At 5th level, your droid can cast 2nd-level {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} in this way. This increases to 3rd-level powers at 9th level, 4th-level powers at 13th level, and 5th-level powers at 17th level. When you cast a power, you consume a number of uses of this feature equal to that power's level.
At 11th level, your droid companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your droid companion must be within 60 feet.

You can use this feature four times, and you gain more uses at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. Each time you use this feature in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Potent Integration
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 3rd level} When your droid makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to give it a boost. Roll the die and add it to both the attack and damage rolls, if the attack hits.

entries.name: Direct Controller
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 6th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level} Your mastery of droids improves your ability to manipulate them. When you cast a power that could affect only droids or constructs, and you only affect droids with the power, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Coordinated Attack
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 14th level} When you are the source of an effect that would force other creatures to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and your droid is one of those creatures, you can have your droid automatically succeed on the save. When your droid is the source of an effect that would force other creatures to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and you are one of those creatures, you can choose to automatically succeed on the save.

entries.name: Droid Defense
entries: {@i {@b Astrotech Engineering:} 18th level} While your droid can see you, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on all {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries.name: Audiotech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Audiotech Engineering discipline focus on using a specially modified instrument to use music to assist their allies and disrupt their enemies.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Audiotech Engineering:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in three musical instruments and audiotech's implements. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with audiotech—s implements, the rate at which you craft doubles.

entries.name: Modified Instrument
entries: {@i {@b Audiotech Engineering:} 3rd level} You learn to modify an instrument utilizing your audiotech knowledge. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify an instrument. You must have the instrument and audiotech's implements in order to perform this modification.

Your modified instrument is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified instrument has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

entries.name: Potent Amplitude
entries: {@i {@b Audiotech Engineering:} 3rd level} As an action while wielding your modified instrument, you can begin performing an enhanced song, which lasts for 1 minute. While playing a song, you gain access to a new use for your Potent Aptitude, as determined by the song, listed below. You can end your song at any time, no action required.

Whenever you take damage while playing your song, you must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to continue playing. The DC equals 10 or half the damage you take, which number is higher. If you take damage from multiple sources, you must make a separate {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} for each source of damage.

When you cast a damage dealing {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while playing your song that requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can cause that power to instead deal sonic damage. If you do so, instead of an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the power instead requires a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.
Your song ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die, or if you are no longer holding your modified instrument.
You can initiate playing an enhanced song twice. You regain all expended songs when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Song of Battle
entries: When an ally within 60 feet of you that can hear you deals damage to a creature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend one use of your Potent Aptitude, adding the result of the die to the damage dealt.

entries.name: Song of Support
entries: When an ally within 60 feet of you that can hear you makes a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a harmful effect, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend one use of your Potent Aptitude, adding the result of the die to their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

entries.name: Song of Disruption
entries: When an enemy within 60 feet of you that can hear you makes a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend one use of your Potent Aptitude, subtracting the result of the die from their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

entries.name: Concussive Blast
entries: {@i {@b Audiotech Engineering:} 6th level} You add your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of +1) to any damage you deal with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and class features that deal sonic damage.

entries.name: Smooth Rhythm
entries: {@i {@b Audiotech Engineering:} 14th level} Whenever you use your Potent Aptitude while your playing an enhanced song, you can roll a {@dice d6} and use it instead of expending a Potent Aptitude Dice.

entries.name: Legendary Coda
entries: {@i {@b Audiotech Engineering:} 18th level} You've gained mastery over your modified instrument. As an action, you can end your enhanced song in a triumphant blast of power with an effect determined by the song you are playing.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Battle Crescendo
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that you can see and that can hear your song. Each must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 sonic damage and is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} for 1d4+1 turns. On a success, it takes half damage and isn't {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}. If a creature is killed by this power, its head explodes.

entries.name: Support Crescendo
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that you can see and that can hear your song. Once in the next minute, each creature can, as a free action in response to taking damage, choose to halve that damage. Additionally, if the damage would reduce them to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, they are instead reduced to 1.

entries.name: Disruption Crescendo
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that you can see and that can hear your song. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Paralyzed|sw5e-phb|paralyzed} for 1d4+1 turns. If a creature affected by this feature is damaged in any way, the effect ends for that creature.

entries.name: Audiotech Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Advanced Battle Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Battle  Enhancement} While playing your Song of Battle, your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and class features ignore resistance to sonic damage, and immunity to sonic damage is instead treated as resistance from any creature within range of your song that can hear you.
Additionally, when you use your Battle Song Enhancement feature, you create a fourth burst.

entries.name: Advanced Disruption Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Disruption  Enhancement} While playing your Song of Disruption, any hostile creature within range of your song that can hear you must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on the power.

entries.name: Advanced Support Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Support  Enhancement} While playing your Song of Support, allies add your Intelligence modifier to their {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws} (minimum of +1). If this amount would increase the roll of the {@dice d20} to 20 or greater, the creature regains 1 hit point.

entries.name: Battle Song Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While playing your Song of Battle, as an action, you can send forth busts of directed sonic energy, make two ranged power attacks. These attacks can target the same creature different ones. Make separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} for each burst. The attack has a range equal to the radius of your song, and deals 1d8 sonic damage on a hit.

entries.name: Disruption Song Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While playing your Song of Disruption, as an action, you can choose a number of creatures concentrating on a power equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of one) within range of your song that can hear you, and force them to make a {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb} {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If you cause at least one creature to lose {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a power using this feature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make all creatures that lost {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} take damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Enthralling Performance
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level, Hypnotic Melody} For the duration of an enhanced song you play, whenever any creature that can hear your song tries to attack you for the first time on a turn, the attacker must make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it can't attack you on this turn, and it must choose a new target for its attack or the attack is wasted. On a successful save, it can attack you on this turn, but it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes against your powers or features on your next turn.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Finding My Way
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Rush} While you are playing an enhanced song, when a creature would make a melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move 5 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}, imposing {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Hypnotic Melody
entries: As an action while wielding your modified instrument, you can begin to play a song woven with subtle hypnotic influence. Choose a number of creature up to your Intelligence modifier. If those creatures listen to this song for a full minute, they must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or become {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you for 1 minute. Creatures that succeed the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} are not aware that you attempted to influence them, nor are creatures that failed their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} once the power ends.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Inaudible Casting
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Simple Melodies} When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or make use of a feature that requires playing your modified instrument, you can choose to do so quietly. Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sound to determine you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Long Range Noise
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} The radius of your songs increases to 120 feet. Additionally, any {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast with your modified instrument that deals sonic damage and has a range of 10 feet or greater gains a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Magnifying Device
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your instrument as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Overwhelming Soundwaves
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level} While playing, creatures of your choice treat a 15-foot-radius sphere around you as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}. Additionally, as an action, you can cause each affected creature to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 3d8 sonic damage on a failed save.

entries.name: Prototype Battle Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Battle Song Enhancement} While playing your Song of Battle, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or use a class feature that affects other creatures within the radius of your song, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the power's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against the power, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.
Additionally, when you use your Battle Song Enhancement feature, you create a third burst.

entries.name: Prototype Disruption Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Disruption Song Enhancement} While playing your Song of Disruption, when a creature you can see that can hear you attempts to cast a power, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cast the {@i tech override} power at 3rd level. When you cast this power using this feature, the power works against both tech and {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and when you make the {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check as a part of this casting, you your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the check.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Prototype Support Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Support Song Enhancement} While playing your Song of Support, when you use your Song of Support's Potent Amplitude feature, the target instead takes no damage if they succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if they fail.

entries.name: Restful Melody
entries: Over the course of a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can play a rejuvenating song to assist in the recovery of your allies. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} at the end of the {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
The extra {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d 10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.

entries.name: Rush
entries: While you are playing an enhanced song, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet, and {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Sharp Noise
entries: As an action while wielding your modified instrument, choose a creature you can see. If it can hear you, it must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take 1d4 sonic damage and have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on its next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} before the end of its next turn.
This feature's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

entries.name: Shock Mount
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your instrument as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to your tech save DC. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Simple Melodies
entries: When you are holding your modified instrument, and not actively playing a song, any {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that you could cast that could have its damage type altered by your Potent Amplitude feature can be cast as if used with Potent Amplitude.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Sonar Pulse
entries: As an action while wielding your modified instrument, you can release a wave of sound that provides feedback on your surroundings. For the next minute, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks to search for hidden doors, traps, or {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} creatures.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Song Flow
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level} While playing an enhanced song, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to change from one song to another.

entries.name: Support Song Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While playing your Song of Support, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that restores {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or grants temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the amount restored or granted is increased by an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

entries.name: Weapon Integration
entries: You can integrate a single weapon that weighs no more than 8 lb. into your instrument. While integrated, that weapon gains the hidden property.

entries.name: Biochem Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Biochem Engineering discipline focus on utilizing their vast knowledge of medicine and chemistry to supply allies with potent healing and enemies with debilitating poisons and acids.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Biochem Engineering:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} skill, biochemist's kits, and poisoner's kits. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with biochemist's kits and poisoner's kits, the rate at which you craft doubles.

entries.name: Modified Biochemist's Pack
entries: {@i {@b Biochem Engineering:} 3rd level} You learn to modify and combine your {@item Biochemist's kit|sw5e-phb|biochemist's kit} and {@item Poisoner's kit|sw5e-phb|poisoner's kit}, creating a mobile laboratory using your chemistry {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can create your modified biochemist's pack. You must have a {@item Biochemist's kit|sw5e-phb|biochemist's kit}, a {@item Poisoner's kit|sw5e-phb|poisoner's kit}, and materials in order to perform this modification.

Your biochemist's pack is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified biochemist's pack has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

Your modified biochemist's pack comes equipped with a chemical distribution system, complete with three chemical mixtures: corrosive, invigorating, and noxious. As an action, you can activate your distributor and target a creature within 30 feet, with an effect determined by the mixture.

entries.name: Corrosive Mixture
entries: Your distributor emits a burst of acid. The target must make a Dexterity sav-ing throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 + your Intelligence modifier acid damage. This mixture's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

entries.name: Invigorating Mixture
entries: Your distributor emits a bolt of kolto. The target gains 1d6 + your Intelligence modifier temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, which last until the end of your next turn. The temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} granted by this mixture increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

entries.name: Noxious Mixture
entries: Your distributor emits a cloud of poison. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 + your Intelligence modifier poison damage. This mixture's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

entries.name: Biochemist's Touch
entries: {@i {@b Biochem Engineering:} 3rd level} Whenever you grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, or deal acid or poison damage using a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you may expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to increase the potency. When you do so, the amount of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} you grant or damage you deal is increased by the amount rolled on the die. The damage is the same type as the original damage.

entries.name: Potent Mixtures
entries: {@i {@b Biochem Engineering:} 6th level} When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st-level or higher that grants temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, or deals acid or poison damage, you add your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of +1) to the roll.

entries.name: Epicenter
entries: {@i {@b Biochem Engineering:} 14th level} As a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} when you take damage from a creature within 15 feet of you that you can see, you can use one of your mixtures. The effects of the mixture release in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you, and if the mixture requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you automatically succeed on it. Additionally, the affected area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} to creatures other than you until the end of your next turn.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Masterful Mixtures
entries: {@i {@b Biochem Engineering:} 18th level} When you deal acid or poison damage using a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you ignore resistance and treat immunity as resistance.

entries.name: Biochem Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Biochemist's Amplifer
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your biochemist's pack as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Biochemist's Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your biochemist's pack as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to your tech save DC. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Chemical Counteragents
entries: You may choose one type of damage that benefits from your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixtures features. While wearing your modified biochemist's pack you have resistance to that type of damage.
You can select this modification multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

entries.name: Countertoxin
entries: When you or an ally within 30 feet of you is suffering from the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} condition, you may use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn to end the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} condition on that creature. The creature also gains immunity to the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} condition for one minute.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Detachable Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor with a secondary, detachable distributor. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can throw your detachable distributor at a point within range. Your detachable distributor has a range equal to 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. Your detachable distributor works for 1 minute before coming inert. Once it does so, you can't use it again until you recover it as an action.

Additionally, while your detachable distributor is within 100 feet of you, when you use your action to activate your distributor, you can choose to affect each creature within 5 feet of your detachable distributor. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Drone Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor, interfacing it with the target of your {@i tracker droid interface} power. When you use your action to activate your distributor, while your tracker droid is within 100 feet of you, you can choose to have your tracker droid deliver the mixture. Your tracker droid must use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to deliver the mixture.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Expanded Chemicals: Combustibles
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You add additional chemicals to your modified biochemist's pack. When you deal fire damage with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you can use your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixture features.

Additionally, when a creature fails their Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your Corrosive Mixtures feature, you can choose to instead deal fire damage. If you do so, each creature within 5 feet of the target takes fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Expanded Chemicals: Cryogenics
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You add additional chemicals to your modified biochemist's pack. When you deal cold damage with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you can use your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixture features.

Additionally, when a creature fails their Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your Noxious Mixtures feature, you can choose to instead deal cold damage. If you do so, it gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the start of your next turn. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Expanded Chemicals: Restorative
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You add additional chemicals to your modified biochemist's pack. When you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you can use your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixture features.

Additionally, when you use your Invigorating Mixture to grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature, you can choose to restore that many {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to the same creature. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Expanded Mixtures: Adhesive
entries: You've created a new mixture from your chemicals that you can use when you activate your distributor. When you do so, the target creature must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If the creature is Large or larger, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature gains 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels until the start of your next turn. As an action on their turn, an affected creature can repeat this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Expanded Mixtures: Blinding
entries: You've created a new mixture from your chemicals that you can use when you activate your distributor. When you do so, the target creature must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Expanded Mixtures: Hallucinogenic
entries: You've created a new mixture from your chemicals that you can use when you activate your distributor. When you do so, the target creature must make an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target loses the ability to distinguish friend from foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies until the end of your next turn. Each time the target takes damage, it can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Whenever the affected creature chooses another creature as a target, it must choose the target at random from among the creatures it can see within range of the attack, power, or other ability it's using. If an enemy provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} from the affected creature, the creature must make that attack if it is able to.
This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Explosive Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor, granting it the ability to create a volley. When you use your action to activate your distributor, you can choose to affect each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within 30 feet.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Injection Apparatus
entries: You install a wrist mounted injection apparatus into your modified biochemist's pack. It is a {@filter simple vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon|weaponcategory=simple} with the finesse and light properties, and deals 1d4 kinetic damage on a hit. Your injection apparatus does not fill the hand slot, but you can't use it while the hand is full.

When you hit with the weapon, you can activate your distributor to deploy one of your mixtures. If you do so, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your mixture.

entries.name: Inoculation
entries: You gain immunity to the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} and disease conditions.

entries.name: Integrated EVA Functionality
entries: You make several additions to your modified biochemist's pack, you are protected from hazardous conditions, as if wearing an EVA suit, for as long as you are wearing your modified biochemist's pack.

entries.name: Kolto Aerosol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You add a special dispersal system to your modified biochemist's pack. This system slowly disperses small amounts of kolto in the air. If creatures spend the entirety of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} within 30 feet of you, they regain all expended Hit Dice, instead of only half. Additionally, they are cured of any poisons or diseases that are suffering from.

entries.name: Long-Range Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor, improving the range. When you use your action to activate your distributor, you can choose to increase the range to 60 feet.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Luminous Gel
entries: You've added a light-emitting gel to your modified biochemist's pack. As an action, you can coat an item, object, or location up to 5-foot-square with this gel. When you do so, the gel sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The gel lasts for 1 hour before losing its potency. You can end this effect as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Oil Spill
entries: As an action, you can cast the {@i oil slick} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} without expending tech points. Casting the power in this way does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}, and the oil will remain in place for the full duration of the power.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Persistent Chemicals
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} Whenever you use your Biochemist's Touch feature, you may select one creature that was damaged. At the start of each of that creature's turns, it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it takes damage of the triggering type equal to your Intelligence modifier and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} until the start of its next turn. On a success, this feature ends, and the creature becomes immune to it for one day.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Piercing Gel
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Luminous Gel} Your luminous gel now automatically dispels illusions and can detect invisibility, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.

entries.name: Self-Injection Module
entries: You install a special kolto injector into your modified biochemist's pack that can inject you with kolto in response to pain. When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain health as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

entries.name: Smart Dispersal System
entries: When you activate your distributor, you can choose a number of creature equal to your Intelligence modifier. Those creature automatically succeed on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against your mixtures.

entries.name: Spray Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor, granting it the ability to spray in a cone. When you use your action to activate your distributor, you can choose to affect each creature in a 15-foot cone.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Biotech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Biotech Engineering discipline focus on the skill of modifying and upgrading the body through the use of cybernetic limbs and implants.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Biotech Engineering:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

entries.name: Modified Self
entries: {@i {@b Biotech Engineering:} 3rd level} You've learned to make modifications to your body, cybernetically augmenting yourself. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify yourself with cybernetic augmentations. You must have {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements} in order to perform this modification.

While you have at least one cybernetic augmentation installed, your body counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Additionally, you have 4 modification slots, and you gain more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

entries.name: Quick-Release Stimulant
entries: {@i {@b Biotech Engineering:} 3rd level} When you are dealt damage by an attack while you have at least one cybernetic augmentation installed, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to reduce the damage you take. The damage is reduced by an amount equal to 1d10 + your Constitution modifier + your engineer level. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the remaining damage reduction.

entries.name: Overclock Body
entries: {@i {@b Biotech Engineering:} 6th level} You've learned to use your body as a conduit for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can choose to pay up to half the cost of the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} using your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} instead of your tech points. When you do so, your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by the same amount until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: More Machine Than Man
entries: {@i {@b Biotech Engineering:} 14th level} While you have temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, when you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

entries.name: Focused Augmentation
entries: {@i {@b Biotech Engineering:} 18th level} You add your Intelligence modifier to Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} you make to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}.
Additionally, when you cast a power that requires {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} and would affect only one target, you can target an additional creature with that power.

entries.name: Biotech Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Active Camouflage Core
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} As an action, you can activate this augmentation to cast the {@i infiltrate} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} targeting yourself. Intelligence is your tech casting ability for this power, and if you cast it using this augmentation, it does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}.

entries.name: Anti-Dazzle Ocular Implant
entries: This augmentation replaces your eyes.

You are immune to the {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} condition, and you can enable or disable your ability to see anytime. Additionally, your eyes are equipped with a {@item Holorecorder|sw5e-phb|holorecorder} device. You can perfectly recall anything you've seen in the last 7 days.

entries.name: Auto-Defibrillator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Hardy Torso Prothesis} The Constitution score of your Hardy Torso Prosthesis increases by 2. Additionally, when you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can—t use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Brawny Arm Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces an arm.

When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength using only this arm, your Strength score is treated as 15. When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength using more than just this arm, you take the average of the arm's Strength score and your own.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Celerity Leg Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces both legs.

When determining your bonus to AC and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} from Dexterity, your Dexterity score is treated as 15. If your Dexterity score is already equal to or greater than 15, it has no effect on you.

Additionally, you can substitute this score for your own whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} that uses your legs.

entries.name: Detachable Eye
entries: This augmentation replaces an eye.

As an action, you can remove or replace this eye. While removed, the eye sprouts eight small legs, has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 15 feet, an AC of 10, and 1 hit point. If it dies, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. As an action on each of your turns, you can move the eye up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} as long as it is within 30 feet of you. You can see through both the detached eye and your remaining eye at the same time, or you can use your action to see through only one eye or the other.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Detachable Hand
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

As an action, you can attach or detach this hand. While detached, the hand has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 15 feet, an AC of 10, and 1 hit point. If it dies, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. As an action on each of your turns, you can control the hand as long as it is within 30 feet of you. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a container. You can move the hand up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} each time you use it.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Fadecasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Hardy Torso Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces your torso.
Your Constitution score becomes 13. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison.

entries.name: Harpoon Hand
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

You modify your hand, granting it the ability to transform into a harpoon. With this hand, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d6 kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the harpoon. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the harpoon. Removing the harpoon requires a Strength check. While the harpoon is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While the harpoon is deployed, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is larger than you. A creature or object your size or smaller is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to release the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use your hand again until you recover and reinsert it as an action.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Integrated Subdermal Armor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} When you aren't wearing armor, your AC becomes 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Iridonian Grav-lev Hand
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} with this arm deal 1d4 ion damage, and your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. Additionally, you deal double damage to energy-based structures with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Magnetic Forearm Enhancement
entries: This augmentation replaces a forearm.
Unarmed strikes with this hand have the reach property.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Mighty Prowess Enabler
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, {@feat Brawny|sw5e-phb} Arm Prothesis} The Strength score of your {@feat Brawny|sw5e-phb} Arm Prosthesis increases by 2. Additionally, you are considered proficient with any weapon you wield with this arm. If the weapon requires two hands to use, and you are not already proficient with it, you only add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make with it, unless you wield it with two of these arms.
You can choose this modification multiple times, but only once per arm.

entries.name: Nighthawk Ocular Implant
entries: This augmentation replaces your eyes.
You can activate or deactivate this implant as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. While active, you gain {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Powered Harpoon Hand
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Harpoon Hand} While your harpoon hand is deployed, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with a range of touch, your hand can deliver the power as if it had cast it.

entries.name: Rendcasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Dexterity or Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Skills Enhancement Package
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} using a skill you are proficient in, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add the result to your total.

entries.name: Sound Dampeners
entries: This augmentation replaces your ears.

You are immune to the {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} condition, and you can enable or disable your ability to hear anytime. Additionally, your ears are equipped with a personal translator that allows you to understand up to 15 different languages, however, you cannot speak them. The languages can be changed out while interfaced with a protocol droid or appropriate computer.

entries.name: Surveillance Implant
entries: This augmentation replaces your face.
This implant includes a {@item Headcomm|sw5e-phb|headcomm} with a scrambler that automatically encodes messages sent to a specified recipient {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink} or receiver.

entries.name: Survival and Surveillance Implant
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} This augmentation replaces your eyes and face.

This implant contains several tools for long-term survival and reconnaissance. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate one of the below modes that enable you to use several of these tools at once. Activating a different mode deactivates any currently active mode.

items: {@b Communications Mode:} This communications suite includes a {@item Headcomm|sw5e-phb|headcomm} with a scrambler that automatically encodes messages sent to a specified recipient {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink} or receiver. While this mode is active, you cannot be {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}.

{@b Interceptor Mode:} This is a jamming and electronic warfare suite that includes a {@item Comm jammer|sw5e-phb|comm jammer}, a {@item Holotrace device|sw5e-phb|holotrace device} and {@item Pocket scrambler|sw5e-phb|pocket scrambler}.

{@b Respirator Mode:} This includes a basic {@item Respirator|sw5e-phb|respirator} that grants {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid being {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} and resistance to poison damage.

entries.name: Swift Gait Attuner
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Celerity Leg Prothesis} The Dexterity score of your Celerity Leg Prosthesis increases by 2. Additionally, you gain proficiency in Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries.name: Vector Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to melee tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Vector Rangefinder
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to ranged tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Voice Synthesizer
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} This augmentation replaces your throat.

This augmentation allows you to synthesize and perfectly mimic any voice that you have heard in the last month, and the synthesizer can translate verbal communications between up to 5 languages. The languages can be changed out while interfaced with a protocol droid or appropriate computer.
