Additionally, you can add your Intelligence modifier to any Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check made to lie to another creature.

entries.name: Weapon Integration
entries: This augmentation replaces a forearm.

You can integrate a single weapon that weighs no more than 8 lb. into your forearm. While integrated, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to hide or reveal the weapon, which can only be used while revealed. While hidden, the weapon has the hidden property. While revealed, the weapon has the fixed property.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Withercasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Construction Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Construction Engineering discipline create portable, pre-built battlements that allow them to command the battlefield.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Construction Engineering:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in constructor's implements. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with constructor's implements, the rate at which you craft doubles.

entries.name: Portable Structure
entries: {@i {@b Construction Engineering:} 3rd, 11th, and 17th level} You have constructed a set of malleable, portable fortifications that can elevate you and your allies. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you create a portable structure that travels with you.

Your portable structure can only be directed by you, and you must have a tech focus in order to direct it remotely. If you lack a tech focus, you can instead direct it while it is within 5 feet of you. Your portable structure has the following features:

items: Its AC equals your tech save DC.

It has a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 5 x your engineer level. If your structure is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it collapses and can't be used again until you spend 1 hour repairing it, which can be done during a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You can restore missing {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to your structure by casting the {@i mending} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} on it, or by completing a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Casting the {@i mending} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} restores a number of missing {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one), but it can't be repaired to more than half its hit point maximum in this way. Completing a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest} restores your structure to half its hit point maximum, and completing a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} restores it to its hit point maximum.

Your structure has two modes: dismantled and deployed. While dismantled, your structure's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equals your own, it hovers 5 feet off the ground, takes up the space of a 5-foot cube, and weighs 500 lbs. This increases to a 10-foot cube and 1,000 lbs. at 11th level, and a 15-foot cube and 2,000 lbs. at 17th level as you upgrade it. While deployed, your structure's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 0 and it takes up space dictated by how its deployed.

entries: As an action, you can remotely deploy your structure at a space you can see on the ground within 30 feet of you, provided there is sufficient space to support it. This range increases to 60 feet at 11th level and 120 feet at 17th level. Automatic dismantling of your structure takes 1 minute, and can be initiated on your turn (no action required).

You can deploy your choice from these structures a combined total of four times, and you gain more uses at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. Each time you use this feature in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Bridge
entries: You deploy a bridge up to 30 feet long, 10 feet wide, and 3 feet thick. The bridge starts from the point at which you deploy it, and extends in a direction of your choice. When you dismantle your bridge, it retracts to the point at which you initially deployed it. Both ends of the bridge must be supported in some fashion; one end cannot be suspended in the air or on unstable terrain. The bridge can hold up to 1,000 lbs., any weight above which causes the bridge to instantly drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, destroying it. If a creature is on the bridge when it is destroyed or dismantled, it must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. On a successful {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it reaches the closest part of the bridge that has stable support, or it maintains a grip on your bridge as it retracts, as appropriate. On a failed save, it falls.

When you reach 11th level, the bridge can now extend up to 45 feet long, 15 feet wide, and it can support up to 2,000 lbs. When you reach 17th level, the bridge can now extend up to 60 feet long, 20 feet wide, and it can support up to 4,000 lbs.

entries.name: Cage
entries: You create a cage that surrounds a cube up to 10 feet on each side centered on the target location. The cube is surrounded on all sides except the ground by 2-foot-thick walls. The walls and roof are completely opaque, and you choose whether the structure has a light source when you deploy it that provides bright light within the cube. Otherwise, the space within the cube is in complete darkness. The cage is permeable, allowing air, water, and sound to pass through it. You can attempt to trap unwilling Medium or smaller creatures inside the cage. When you deploy this structure in an unwilling creature's space, it must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. On a successful save, it can immediately move to nearest unoccupied space outside of the cage. Otherwise, it is trapped within the structure when it is deployed.

When you reach 11th level, the cage can extend up to 15 feet on each side, and it can trap creatures of Large size or smaller. When you reach 17th level, the cage can extend up to 20 feet on each side, and it can trap creatures of Huge size or smaller.

entries.name: Shelter
entries: You erect a shelter up to 15 feet long, 10 feet wide, and 10 feet tall, with one-foot-thick walls, a roof, and a floor. It has a single door along its walls in a location of your choice. The building has temperature control and lighting systems, and can withstand harsh winds, heavy rain and snow. Any creature inside the shelter is protected from hazardous environmental effects outside the shelter such as extreme heat or cold. The structure does not provide additional breathing air for anyone inside if the environment it is placed in is not breathable. The shelter can comfortably support up to 5 Medium creatures. For each Medium creature, it can instead support 2 Small creatures. For each Small creature, it can instead support 2 Tiny creatures.

When you reach 11th level, the shelter can extend up to 30 feet long, 15 feet wide, 15 feet tall, and it can now comfortably support up to 10 Medium creatures. For each Medium creature, it can instead support 2 Small creatures. For each Small creature, it can instead support 2 Tiny creatures. Additionally, when a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} while within your shelter, they regain all spent Hit Dice, instead of only half. When you reach 17th level, the shelter can extend up to 45 feet long, 20 feet wide, 20 feet tall, and it can now comfortably support up to 10 Large creatures. For each Large creature, it can instead support 2 Medium creatures. For each Medium creature, it can instead support 2 Small creatures. For each Small creature, it can instead support 2 Tiny creatures. Additionally, when a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} while within your shelter, their {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} level is reduced by 2, instead of only 1.

entries.name: Tower
entries: You erect a tower from a 5-foot square platform centered on the target location that rises up to 30 feet. If the tower is created under a creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be lifted by the tower. A creature can choose to fail the save. The tower comes equipped with a ladder that reaches from the ground to the platform.

When you reach 11th level, the tower's platform can extend 5 feet by 10 feet and rise up to 40 feet. When you reach 17th level, the tower's platform can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a 10-foot square, and rise up to 50 feet. Additionally, any creature on the tower's platform has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Wall
entries: You deploy a wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 3 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 10 feet in diameter, 10 feet high, and 3 feet thick. The wall features ramparts deep enough to support creatures of Medium size or smaller, and provides one-quarter {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} to any creature on its ramparts. The wall includes a ladder on the side of your choice. You choose whether the wall contains any openings otherwise. Any openings chosen in this way can be seen through on both sides. The wall can be climbed, but requires a Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check against your tech save DC for any creature without a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. A creature can only make this check once per turn.

When you reach 11th level, the wall can deploy up to 45 feet long and 15 feet high, or a ringed wall up to 15 feet in diameter and 15 feet high. Additionally, the wall now provides {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover} to any creature on its ramparts. When you reach 17th level, the wall can deploy up to 60 feet long and 20 feet high, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter and 20 feet high. Additionally, the wall now provides three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} to any creature on its ramparts.

entries.name: Potent Fortifications
entries: {@i {@b Construction Engineering:} 3rd level} When a friendly creature other than you that you can see is hit with a ranged attack while within 5 feet of your deployed portable structure, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to have your structure take the damage instead. If your structure would normally have immunity or resistance to this damage, it loses that immunity or resistance for this attack. When you do so, the damage is reduced by an amount equal to 1d10 + your Intelligence modifier + your engineer level.

entries.name: Build and Destroy
entries: {@i {@b Construction Engineering:} 6th level} You've learned how to manipulate the weak points in structures with your technology. Your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and weapon attacks gain the siege property, and your portable structures have resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage dealt by weapons.

entries.name: Structural Knowledge
entries: {@i {@b Construction Engineering:} 14th level} You can spend 1 hour inspecting and looking over a structure you can see from every angle available to you and comparing it to data you have on hand. At the end of the hour, you learn the basic blueprints for the structure, including but not limited to:

items: The structure's total {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
Any common materials that make up the structures.
Whether or not the structure is in use or abandoned.
The total floor count for the structure, as well as the general purpose of each floor if it was created to suit a specific purpose.
All non-secret entrances (including doors, windows, vents, pipe systems) and where you could find them.
A basic map-layout of every floor and ventilation system for the building.
The history of the building such as what company or species could have constructed it, as well as how long it's been built.
Any structural weak points it might have.

entries: Additionally, when you make an {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} check while searching this structure for hidden structural elements, such as doors or passages, if you have constructor's implements, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

entries.name: Master Builder
entries: {@i {@b Construction Engineering:} 18th level} Your ability with your portable structures has reached untold superiority. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can have two structures active at a time, instead of only one, as you learn to more efficiently use your portable structure.
Your structures no longer take double damage from the siege property.

Your structures no longer automatically fail Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. Instead, your structure adds your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the {@dice d20} roll when it makes one of these {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries.name: Cybertech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Cybertech Engineering discipline focus on the ability to enhance their primary {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} in order to augment and empower their {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} abilities.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@b {@i Cybertech Engineering:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@item Cybertech's implements|sw5e-phb|cybertech's implements}. additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Cybertech's implements|sw5e-phb|cybertech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

entries.name: Cyberpad
entries: {@b {@i Cybertech Engineering:} 3rd level} Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad}. You must have a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} and {@item Cybertech's implements|sw5e-phb|cybertech's implements} in order to perform this modification.

Your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer class table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

entries.name: Insightful Casting
entries: {@b {@i Cybertech Engineering:} 3rd level} You can expend uses of your Potent Aptitude to gain additional tech points, or expend tech points to gain additional Potent Aptitude uses.

{@i Creating Tech Points.} You can transform a single use of Potent Aptitude into two tech points as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn.  These additional tech points can exceed your maximum. Any tech points you create with this feature vanish when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}.
{@i Creating Potent Aptitude.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn, you can expend two tech points to gain a single use of your Potent Aptitude.

entries.name: Quickslice
entries: {@b {@i Cybertech Engineering:} 6th level} When a creature you can see casts a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you may use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to attempt to download that {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} to your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for later use if it is of a level for which you can cast.

Make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} using your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} with proficiency. The DC equals 10 + two times the power’s level. On a success you store the power for later use. On a failure, the power is not stored. You can cast powers stored in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} as if you had learned them and they do not count against your {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.
Once you have used this feature on a creature, you cannot do so again on the same creature until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You can store an amount of levels worth of {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} equal to your engineer level at a time. Additionally, you can choose replace or remove one or more {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} learned by this feature each time you use it.

entries.name: Severe Fallout
entries: {@b {@i Cybertech Engineering:} 14th level} Whenever a creature rolls a natural 1 on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against one of your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} they take double damage from that power. If the power doesn't deal damage, instead they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on their next {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast.

entries.name: Maximum Output
entries: {@b {@i Cybertech Engineering:} 18th level} When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can choose to deal maximum damage or provide maximum healing with that power.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Cybertech Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Arakyd Vector
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 11th level and +3 at 17th level.

entries.name: Careful Subroutine
entries: When you cast a power that forces other creatures to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can protect some of those creatures from the power’s full force. To do so, you spend 1 additional tech point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the power.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

entries.name: Cryo Amplifier
entries: When a creature takes cold damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that you cast that requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you deal additional cold damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

entries.name: Cryo Amplifier, Mk II
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Cryo Amplifier} When you deal damage to a creature with this amplifier, the creature gains one level of {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} until the end of your next turn. If the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} already imposes levels of {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed}, the number of {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels imposed increases by 1.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Cryo Amplifier, Mk III
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level, Cryo Amplifier, Mk II} When you expend a use of your Cryo Amplifier, Mk II, when the creature fails Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it instead becomes {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Distant Subroutine
entries: When you cast a power that has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can spend 1 additional tech point to double the range of the power.
Alternatively, when you cast a power that has a range of touch, you can spend 1 additional tech point to make the range of the power 30 feet.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

entries.name: Electrical Amplifier
entries: When a creature takes lightning damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that you cast that requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you deal additional lightning damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

entries.name: Electrical Amplifier, Mk II
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Electrical Amplifier} When you deal damage to a creature with this amplifier, the creature must succeed at a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or become {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the end of your next turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Electrical Amplifier, Mk III
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level, Electrical Amplifier, Mk II} When you expend a use of your Electrical Amplifier, Mk II, when the creature fails Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it instead becomes {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Extended Subroutine
entries: When you cast a power that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 additional tech point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

entries.name: Evaluation scanner
entries: You can cast the {@i Analyze} power without using tech points. If you use this on a tech focus, you learn what {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, if any, are within it.

entries.name: Explosive Amplifier
entries: When a creature takes fire damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that you cast that requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you deal additional fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (rounded up, minimum of +1).

entries.name: Explosive Amplifier, Mk II
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Explosive Amplifier} When you deal damage to a creature with this amplifier, it becomes {@i ignited} (your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} modifier) until the start of it's next turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).  You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Explosive Amplifier, Mk III
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level, Explosive Amplifier, Mk II} When a creature is {@i ignited} with a use of your Explosive Amplifier, Mk II and that creature takes any fire damage while {@i ignited}, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the next Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes before the start of it's next turn.

entries.name: Elemental Absorbtion
entries: You can cast the {@i Absorb Energy} power once without expending Tech Points. You can't do so again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Elemental Ingenuity
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level} When you cast a power that deals fire, lightning, or cold damage, you can spend 1 additional tech point and choose to swap the damage type to fire, lightning, or cold damage.

entries.name: Elemental Ingenuity, Mk II
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level, Elemental Ingenuity} When you cast a power that deals acid, ion, poison, or sonic damage, you can expend 1 additional tech point and choose to swap the damage type to fire, lightning, or cold damage.

entries.name: Elemental Shielding
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Cryo Amplifier, Explosive Amplifier, or Electrical Amplifier} You gain resistance to damage types for which you have a matching amplifier modification installed.

entries.name: Frailcasting Dynamics
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Hasty Translation
entries: You can cast the {@i Translation Program} power once without expending Tech Points. You can't do so again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Heightened Subroutine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} When you cast a power that forces a creature to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist its effects, you can spend 2 additional tech points to give one target of the power {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on its first {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} made against the power.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

entries.name: Improved Subroutine
entries: When you roll damage for a power, you can spend 1 additional tech point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). You must use the new rolls.
You can use Improved Subroutine even if you have already used a different Subroutine modification during the casting of the power.

entries.name: Lingering Subroutine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} WWhen you cast a power that requires {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} to maintain you can choose to spend 3 additional tech points. If you do, when you lose {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on the power, the power will not end until the end of your next turn.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

entries.name: Long Range Comms
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You can cast the {@i Sending} power, targeting a creature whose frequency is in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad}, without using tech points.  A willing creature can use its action to register its comm frequency on your device, which can contain a number of frequencies equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.
As an action, you can remove a frequency on the device by deleting it.

entries.name: Pinpoint Subroutine
entries: When you cast a power that allows you to force creatures in an area to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you can instead spend 1 tech point and make a ranged tech attack against a single target that would be in the range. On a hit the target suffers the effects as though they failed their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

entries.name: Quickened Subroutine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} When you cast a power that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 additional tech points to change the casting time to 1 {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} for this casting.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

entries.name: Refocused Subroutine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} When you are forced to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a power you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and spend 2 tech points to automatically succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.
You can use Refocused Subroutine even if you have already used a different Subroutine modification during the casting of the power.

entries.name: Rendcasting Dynamics
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Dexterity or Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Seeking Subroutine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} If you miss with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that calls for an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can spend 2 tech points to reroll the attack. You must use the new roll.
You can use Seeking Subroutine even if you have already used a different Subroutine modificatio during the casting of the power.

entries.name: Thermodynamic Conservation
entries: Once per round when you take cold, fire, or lightning damage from a force or {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to twice the power's level to potentially absorb the damage (minimum of 1). These points last until the end of your next turn.

If the Mk II upgrade of the affecting amplifier is installed, the temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} gained increase by an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).

entries.name: Twinned Subroutine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} When you cast a power that can only have one target and doesn’t have a range of self, you can spend a number of additional tech points equal to the power’s level to choose a second target in range with the same power (1 tech point if the power is at-will).
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

entries.name: Voltaic Screen
entries: You can cast the {@i Voltaic Shielding} power once without expending Tech Points. You can't do so again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Withercasting Dynamics
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your wrist as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Cybertech Engineering (Old)
entries: Those engineers who choose the Cybertech Engineering discipline focus on the ability to craft reusable consumables and items that augment and complement their {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} abilities.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Cybertech Engineering (Old):} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@item Cybertech's implements|sw5e-phb|cybertech's implements}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Cybertech's implements|sw5e-phb|cybertech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

entries.name: Cybertech Contraptions
entries: {@i {@b Cybertech Engineering (Old):} 3rd level} You learn modify gadgets and wristpads utilizing your cybertech knowledge. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad}. You must have a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} and {@item Cybertech's implements|sw5e-phb|cybertech's implements} in order to perform this modification.

Your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

entries.name: Potent Techcasting
entries: {@i {@b Cybertech Engineering (Old):} 3rd level} When you miss with a tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or a creature succeeds on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you can expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to overwhelm them. Roll the die, and either add it to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or subtract it from their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

entries.name: Adaptable Applications
entries: {@i {@b Cybertech Engineering (Old):} 6th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level} When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st level or higher, you can choose to deal additional damage or provide additional healing with that power. The additional damage or healing equals half your engineer level.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Combat Contrivances
entries: {@i {@b Cybertech Engineering (Old):} 14th level} When you use your action to a cast a 1st-level or higher {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the level of the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} + your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Perfected Purposing
entries: {@i {@b Cybertech Engineering (Old):} 18th level} When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can choose to deal maximum damage or provide maximum healing with that power.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Cybertech Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Advanced Biotic Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Biotic Amplifier} You further fine tune your biotic amplifier. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} from your biotic amplifier, it instead gains four times as many. This amount can't exceed the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} regained.

entries.name: Advanced Corrosive Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Corrosive Amplifier} You further fine tune your Corrosive Amplifier. When you activate this amplifier, the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made by that creature before the end of its next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Advanced Cryo Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Cryo Amplifier} You further fine tune your Cryo Amplifier. When you activate this amplifier, the creature is {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Advanced Explosive Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Explosive Amplifier} You further fine tune your Explosive Amplifier. When a creature takes fire damage while {@condition Ignited|sw5e-phb|ignited}, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the next Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Arakyd Vector
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Augmented Explosive
entries: You can augment a single grenade, mine, or {@item Thermal detonator|sw5e-phb|thermal detonator} to regain its charge. An augmented explosive can only be used by you, and it uses your tech save DC instead of its own. Once you've activated an explosive, it can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
You can select this modification multiple times. Each time you do so, you can maintain an additional augmented explosive, to a maximum equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Belasco Dynamics
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to your tech save DC. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Biotic Amplifier
entries: You integrate a biotic amplifier in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that increases the potency of your healing {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you can grant them temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount of tech points spent. This amount can't exceed the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} restored.
You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Climbing Gloves
entries: You craft a set of gloves with a powerful assisted grip. While wearing these gloves, you have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 20 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Corrosive Amplifier
entries: You integrate a booster in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that enhances your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that deal acid damage. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature takes acid damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you can choose to deal additional acid damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Cryo Amplifier
entries: You integrate a booster in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that enhances your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that deal cold damage. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature takes cold damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you can choose to deal additional cold damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Darkvision Goggles
entries: You craft a pair of sight-enhancing goggles. While wearing these goggles, you have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, this modification increases its range by 30 feet.

entries.name: Explosive Amplifier
entries: You integrate a booster in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that enhances your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that deal fire damage. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature takes fire damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you can choose to deal additional fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Imaging Amplifier
entries: You integrate a booster in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that enhances your illusionary {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature attempts an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) check against a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast to discern the illusion for what it is, you can force the creature to have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll (no action required). Alternatively, when you cast the {@i mirror image} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you create a fourth duplicate. While you have four duplicates, you must roll a 5 or higher on the {@dice d20} roll to change an attack's target to a duplicate.

You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Jet Boots
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} You find tune your augmented boots to give you temporary, limited flight. Activating or deactivating the boots requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

The {@item Rocket boots|sw5e-phb|rocket boots} last for 1 minute before deactivating. Once the boots have been activated, they can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Mechanical Arm
entries: You create a mechanical arm which mounts to your shoulder, which you can use independently. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time.
You can choose this modification twice.

entries.name: Prototype Biotic Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Biotic Amplifier} You fine tune your biotic amplifier. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} from your biotic amplifier, it instead gains twice as many. This amount can't exceed the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} regained.

entries.name: Prototype Corrosive Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Corrosive Amplifier} You fine tune your Corrosive Amplifier. When you activate this amplifier, the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made against that creature before the end of its next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Prototype Cryo Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Cryo Amplifier} You fine tune your Cryo Amplifier. When you activate this amplifier, the creature gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Prototype Explosive Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Explosive Amplifier} You fine tune your Explosive Amplifier. When you activate this amplifier, the creature is also {@condition Ignited|sw5e-phb|ignited} for 1 minute. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes additional fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier and then makes a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC, ending this effect on a success. If the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to put out the flames, or if some other effect douses the flames, the effect ends.

entries.name: Powered Grappling Hook
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Wrist-Mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|Grappling Hook}} While your wrist-mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook} is deployed, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with a range of touch, your hook can deliver the power as if it had cast it.

entries.name: Sentry Turret
entries: You learn how to craft small sentry turrets shaped like globes that can adhere to any surface. As an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} (your choice), you can throw a sentry to a point you can see within range (30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5). At the end of each of your turns, a deployed sentry automatically targets a hostile creature within 10 feet of it. If multiple targets are available, one is chosen at random. The target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 energy damage and gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of your next turn.

The sentries have 1 hit point, an {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} of 10, and can be repaired over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Each sentry lasts for 1 minute before deactivating. You can maintain a number of sentries equal to your Intelligence modifier. Once a sentry has been activated, it can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Truesight Goggles
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Darkvision Goggles} You modify your goggles with a toggle allowing you to briefly gain enhanced sight. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate the {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} feature of your goggles. When toggled on, for the next minute your goggles now automatically dispel illusions and can detect invisibility, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Wrist-Mounted Grappling Hook
entries: You craft a wrist-mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook} weapon attached to a tightly coiled cord. With this contraption, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d4 kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the hook. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the hook. Removing the hook requires a Strength check. While the hook is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While the hook is deployed, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is your size or larger. A creature or object smaller than you is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to release the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the hook as an action.

entries.name: Adept Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Adept Specialists tap into a latent Force-sensitivity to augment their martial prowess, blending the two to accelerate their bodies and blows. An adept speeds across the battlefield, attacking opponents in a flurry of blows before dashing off again.

entries.name: Forcecasting
entries: {@i {@b Adept Specialist:} 3rd level} You have learned powers, fragments of knowledge that imbue you with an abiding force ability. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 11|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for the {@book force powers list|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force Powers Known
entries: You learn 4 {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} column of the {@book Adept Specialist|sw5e-ec|1|Adept Specialist} {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table. You may not learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level, and you may learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at the same time you learn its prerequisite.

entries.name: Force Points
entries: You have a number of force points equal to your fighter level, as shown in the Force Points column of the {@book Adept Specialist|sw5e-ec|1|Adept Specialist} {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table, + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice). You use these force points to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. You regain all expended force points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} can be overpowered, consuming more force points to create a greater effect. You can overpower these abilities to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the {@book Adept Specialist|sw5e-ec|1|Adept Specialist} {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table.
You may only cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 4th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Forcecasting Ability
entries: Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} varies based on the alignment of the powers you cast. You use your Wisdom for {@book light side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, Charisma for {@book dark side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and Wisdom or Charisma for {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice). You use this ability whenever a power refers to your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Force save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier
{@b Force attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier

entries.name: Growing Momentum
entries: {@i {@b Adept Specialist:} 3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level} You can cast the {@i burst of speed} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} targeting yourself at 1st-level without expending force points. At 10th level, when you do so, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by an additional 10 feet. At 18th level, when you do so, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by an additional 10 feet.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Whirling Weapons
entries: {@i {@b Adept Specialist:} 7th level} Your constant blur of motion and attacks becomes an unending barrage as you build momentum. Once on your turn when you miss with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} you can make another {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, no action required.

entries.name: Focused Breathing
entries: {@i {@b Adept Specialist:} 10th level}  You learn to recover some of your expended power quickly. When you use your Second Wind you also regain a number of force points equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, a minimum of one).

entries.name: Unstoppable Force
entries: {@i {@b Adept Specialist:} 15th level} You learn to completely ignore many of the most devastating impediments of combat. You can expend a use of Indomitable to gain the effect of the {@i freedom of movement} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Instant Acceleration
entries: {@i {@b Adept Specialist:} 18th level} You reach the pinnacle of your training, moving faster than eyes or most sensors can track. When you use Action Surge feature, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can teleport before or after the additional action.

entries.name: Demolitions Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Demolitions Specialists are experts in using explosives in combat. They have an explosive for every situation, whether it be breaching a fortified bunker, taking down a walker, or simply demonstrating that in combat, standing too close to your squadmates can be fatal.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Demolitions Specialist:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit}. Additionally, when you would install a breaching charge, you can do so in half the time.

entries.name: Explosive Charge
entries: {@i {@b Demolitions Specialist:} 3rd, 7th, and 15th level} You learn to create a number of small explosives known as charges. Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can create a number of charges equal to your Intelligence modifier. You must have a {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit} in order to create these charges. Your charges can only be used by you, and they lose their potency at the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Once per turn, when you would make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can instead throw one of your charges. Your charges have a range equal to 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. You can throw a charge at a point you can see within range. Each creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier). A creature takes 2d4 + your Intelligence modifier kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
The damage of your charges increases to 3d4 at 7th level and 4d4 at 15th level.

entries.name: Cause and Effect
entries: {@i {@b Demolitions Specialist:} 7th level} You learn to throw grenades as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, when a creature fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a charge or grenade, you can expend a superiority die to apply one of your maneuvers. You can only use this feature once per grenade.

entries.name: Volatile Reflexes
entries: {@i {@b Demolitions Specialist:} 10th level} When a creature within 5 feet of you makes a melee attack against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and throw a charge behind the target. If the target fails its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the charge, you impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made against you.

entries.name: Backup Plans
entries: {@i {@b Demolitions Specialist:} 15th level} When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and have no charges remaining, you can create 2 charges. Additionally, whenever you create a charge, you can change the damage type to acid, energy, fire, ion, lightning, or sonic.

entries.name: Bombard
entries: {@i {@b Demolitions Specialist:} 18th level} When a creature fails its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a charge or grenade thrown by you, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the next Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes before the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Enhancement Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Enhancement Specialists learn to apply their technological prowess to their {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true}. With their deep understanding of both their weapon and how to manipulate its ammunition on the fly, they can often turn the tides of a battle with a single shot.

entries.name: Studied Shooter
entries: {@i {@b Enhancement Specialist:} 3rd level} You learn specialized theory typical for practitioners of the enhancement trade. You gain proficiency in your choice of the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skills. Additionally, you learn your choice of the {@i encrypted message} or {@i minor hologram} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Intelligence is your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for these powers.

entries.name: Special Ammunition
entries: {@i {@b Enhancement Specialist:} 3rd level} You learn ammunition enhancements that are fueled by amplified shots to unleash special enhanced effects.

entries.name: Ammunition Enhancements
entries: You know two ammunition enhancements of your choice, which are detailed under "Ammunition Enhancements" below, and you earn more at higher levels. Many ammunition enhancements boost an attack in some way. Once per turn when you fire a shot from a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} as part of the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can apply one of your Ammunition Enhancement options to that shot, You gain an additional Ammunition Enhancement option of your choice when you reach certain levels in this class: 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level. Each option also improves when you become an 18th-level fighter.
Each time you learn new ammunition enhancements, you can also replace one ammunition enhancement you know with a different one.

entries.name: Amplified Shots
entries: You have two amplified shots, which you use to activate your ammunition enhancements. An amplified shot is expended when you use it. When you fire an amplified shot, your weapon is treated as enhanced for overcoming resistance and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage. You decide to use the option when the shot hits a creature, unless the option doesn't involve an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. You regain all of your amplified shots when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Saving Throws
entries: Some of your ammunition enhancements require your target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the maneuver's effects. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC is calculated as follows:
{@b Ammunition save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Dexterity modifier

entries.name: Ammunition Enhancements
entries: The ammunition enhancements are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Carbonite Shot
entries: When this shot strikes its target, shards of carbonite wrap around the target. The creature hit by the shot takes an extra 2d6 cold damage, it gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level, and it takes 2d6 kinetic damage the first time on each turn it moves 1 foot or more without teleporting. The target or any creature that can reach it can use its action to remove the carbonite with a successful Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check against your Special Ammunition save DC. Otherwise, the carbonite lasts for 1 minute or until you use this option again.
The cold damage and kinetic damage both increase to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Coercing Shot
entries: You enhance your shot with chemicals that confuse the target. The creature hit by the shot takes an extra 2d6 poison damage, and choose one of your allies within 30 feet of the target. The target must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or it is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by the chosen ally until the start of your next turn. This effect ends early if the chosen ally attacks the {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} target, deals damage to it, or forces it to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.
The poison damage increases to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Explosive Shot
entries: You fire a shot set to explode on impact. The shot detonates after your attack. Immediately after the shot hits the creature, the target and all other creatures within 10 feet of it take 2d6 fire damage each.
The fire damage increases to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Hallucinogen Shot
entries: You enhance your shot with hallucinogenic chemicals. The creature hit by the shot takes an extra 2d6 psychic damage, and it must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be unable to see anything farther than 5 feet away until the start of your next turn.
The psychic damage increases to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Piercing Shot
entries: You enhance your shot with armor-piercing properties. When you use this option, you don't make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for the attack. Instead, the shot shoots forward in a line, which is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long, before disappearing. The shot passes through objects, ignoring {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}. Each creature in that line must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes damage as if it were hit by the shot, plus an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage.
The extra damage increases to 2d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Quell Shot
entries: You fire a shot enhanced with a debilitating poison. The creature hit by the shot takes an extra 2d6 poison damage. The target must also succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or the damage dealt by its weapon attacks is halved until the start of your next turn.
The poison damage increases to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Seeking Shot
entries: You apply a tracing signal to your shot. When you use this option, you don't make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for the attack. Instead, choose one creature you have seen in the past minute. The shot flies toward that creature, moving around corners if necessary and ignoring three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} and {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover}. If the target is within the weapon's range and there is a path large enough for the shot to travel to the target, the target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Otherwise, the shot disappears after traveling as far as it can. On a failed save, the target takes damage as if it were hit by the shot, plus an extra 1d6 kinetic damage, and you learn the target's current location. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and you don't learn its location.
The kinetic damage increases to 2d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Enhanced Shot
entries: {@i {@b Enhancement Specialist:} 7th level} You gain the ability to enhance your shots. Whenever you fire an unenhanced shot from a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}, you can make it enhanced for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage.

entries.name: Redirected Shot
entries: {@i {@b Enhancement Specialist:} 10th level} You learn how to direct an errant shot toward a new target. When you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with an enhanced shot and miss, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to reroll the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against a different target within 60 feet of the original target.

entries.name: Ever-Ready Shot
entries: {@i {@b Enhancement Specialist:} 15th level} Your enhanced ammunition is available whenever battle starts. If you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and have no uses of Special Ammunition remaining, you regain one use of it.

entries.name: Ammunition Upgrades
entries: {@i {@b Enhancement Specialist:} 18th level} Your ammunition enhancements improve.

entries.name: Exhibition Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Exhibition Specialists can't help but show off. Even where there isn't an audience, these warriors take command of the battlefield as though it were a stage.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Exhibition Specialist:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in one Charisma skill of your choice.

entries.name: In The Spotlight
entries: {@i {@b Exhibition Specialist:} 3rd level} You can overwhelm an opponent with your unique blend of skill and style. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target is marked for 1 minute. While the target is marked, you gain the following benefits:

items: You can add half your Charisma modifier (minimum of one) to any weapon damage roll you make against the marked target that doesn't already include that modifier.
Your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range against the marked target increases by 1.

If the marked target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your fighter level + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

entries: This effect ends early if you're {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Showoff
entries: {@i {@b Exhibition Specialist:} 3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level} You're a master at dazzling your friends and enemies alike. When you would make a Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma  check, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add it to the roll. On a success, you can immediately choose a number of creatures within 30 feet of you that can see you up to your Charisma modifier (no action required, minimum of one). Each creature must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier) or be {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you. This effects ends on a target after 1 minute, if it takes any damage, if you attack it, or if it witnesses you attacking or damaging any of its allies. If a target succeeds on this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the target has no hint you tried to charm it.
This die increases to 1d6 at 5th level, 1d8 at 9th level, 1d10 at 13th level, and 1d12 at 17th level.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Glory Kill
entries: {@i {@b Exhibition Specialist:} 7th level} As you defeat your enemies in combat, you can weaken the morale of other foes or bolster the resolve of your allies alike. When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} or reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can choose one or more creatures that you can see within 30 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of the chosen creatures are affected by one of the following effects of your choice:

items: The creature gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 temporary hit point).

The creature must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier) or be {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} of you until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Relentless Competitor
entries: {@i {@b Exhibition Specialist:} 10th level} Once on each of your turns, you can regain a use of your Action Surge (no action required). If you do so, you immediately suffer one level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.

entries.name: Glorious Defense
entries: {@i {@b Exhibition Specialist:} 15th level} Your glory on the battlefront can misdirect attacks. When a creature you can see hits you with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain a bonus to AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss you. The bonus equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). If the attack misses, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against the attacker as part of this {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: The Beauty of Violence
entries: {@i {@b Exhibition Specialist:} 18th level} You've perfected a fighting style that allows you to stylishly dominate the field of battle. When you mark a creature with your In The Spotlight feature, you can enhance it. For the duration of the mark, you gain the following additional benefits:

items: You can add your full Charisma modifier, instead of half, to any weapon damage roll you make against the marked target that doesn't already include that modifier.
You can add half your Charisma modifier (minimum of one) to any {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} roll you make against the marked target that doesn't already include that modifier.

If the marked target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to mark a new creature within 30 feet of you. The duration of the new mark is equal to the remaining duration of the existing mark.

entries: This effect ends early if you're {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Fireteam Specialist
entries: When charging onto the frontlines of the galaxy's harshest conflicts, it pays to have people you can trust at your side. Those fighters who choose to become Fireteam Specialists command the respect and loyalty of those beside them by guiding their squad through thick and thin.

entries.name: Improved Combat Superiority
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 3rd level} Your tactical skill in combat improves, granting bonuses to your Combat Superiority.

entries.name: Improved Maneuvers
entries: You know four maneuvers of your choice, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Maneuvers Known column of the Fireteam Superiority table.

entries.name: Improved Superiority Dice
entries: You have four {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Quantity column of the Fireteam Superiority table.

entries.name: Lead By Example
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 3rd level} Once per turn, when an ally that can see or hear you attacks a creature that you can see, you can expend a superiority die and enhance that ally's attack, using one of the maneuvers that you know.

entries.name: Rally the Troops
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 7th level} When you use your Second Wind feature, you can choose up to three allies within 60 feet of you that can see or hear you. Each ally gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your fighter level.
You can choose an additional ally at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

entries.name: On Your Six
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 10th level} You can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to begin a coordinated maneuver with an ally who is within 5 feet of you. For the next minute, while you and the chosen ally are within 5 feet of each other and neither of you are wielding a shield, you each gain a bonus to AC equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

When the chosen ally moves on their turn, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move with them. You must end this movement within 5 feet of the ally, and this movement can't exceed your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

This effect ends early if either you or your ally are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Tactical Advice
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 15th level} Over the course of one minute, you can share knowledge with up to five allies. For the next hour, the chosen creatures gain all of your weapon and armor proficiencies, and a single use of your Indomitable feature.
You can choose an additional ally at 17th level.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: No Soldier Left Behind
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 18th level} While under the effects of On Your Six, if either you or your ally are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can end On Your Six to have them drop to 1 hit point instead. When you do so, the effects of On Your Six persist until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Fireteam Specialist (Companion)
entries: When charging onto the frontlines of the galaxy's harshest conflicts, it pays to have people you can trust at your side. Those fighters who choose to become Fireteam Specialists work in tandem with a companion, becoming more than either could be on their own.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in your choice of the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Improved Combat Superiority
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 3rd level} Your tactical skill in combat improves, granting bonuses to your Combat Superiority.

entries.name: Improved Maneuvers
entries: You know four maneuvers of your choice, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Maneuvers Known column of the Fireteam Superiority table.

entries.name: Improved Superiority Dice
entries: You have four {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Quantity column of the Fireteam Superiority table.

entries.name: Humanoid Companion
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 3rd, 11th, and 17th level} You've been assigned a squadmate who is under your command, gaining a humanoid companion.
Create your humanoid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your companion gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your number of Hit Dice that can be spent to restore hitpoints is reduced by 1.

entries: Lastly, while your companion is bonded to you and within 10 feet of you, your companion can uses your {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} and maneuvers as if it knows them.
This radius increases to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

entries.name: Rally the Troops
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 7th level} When you use your Second Wind feature while your companion is within 10 feet of you, your companion regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} and gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your fighter level.
This radius increases to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

entries.name: On Your Six
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 10th level} While your companion is within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to begin a coordinated

entries.name: Fireteam Superiority
entries: maneuver. For the next minute, while you and your companion are within 5 feet of each other and neither of you are wielding a shield, you each gain a bonus to AC equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

This effect ends early if either you or your companion are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Indomitable in Tandem
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 15th level} When you and your companion are both forced to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the same effect, and one—but not both—of you fails, you can expend a use of your Indomitable feature to instead have you both succeed.

entries.name: No Soldier Left Behind
entries: {@i {@b Fireteam Specialist:} 18th level} While under the effects of On Your Six, if either you or your companion are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can end On Your Six to have them drop to 1 hit point instead. When you do so, the effects of On Your Six persist until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Heavy Weapons Specialist
entries: Some manned instruments of war require their user to have superior physical prowess to overcome their weight and encumbrance. Those fighters who choose to become Heavy Weapons Specialists use their powerful bodies, and powerful armaments, to overwhelm their foes.

entries.name: Rock Steady
entries: {@i {@b Heavy Weapons Specialist:} 3rd level} You have learned to use the heft of your weapon to root yourself in place. At the end of each of your turns, if you move less than half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} while wielding a weapon with the heavy or strength properties, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained}, moved, or knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}. This {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} lasts until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: My Little Friend Says Hello There
entries: {@i {@b Heavy Weapons Specialist:} 3rd level} You know how to use the sheer size of your weapon to strike fear in those around you. You can add your Strength modifier to any Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}) check you make while wielding a weapon with the heavy or strength properties.

entries.name: Maximum Output
entries: {@i {@b Heavy Weapons Specialist:} 7th level} When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action while wielding a weapon with the heavy or strength properties, you can forgo one or more attacks. If you do so, the first time you deal damage with the weapon before the start of your next turn, you deal additional damage of the same type as the weapon's damage. If this instance would deal damage to multiple creatures, you can only apply this additional damage to one of them.
