For each attack you forgo, you deal additional damage equal to 1d12 + half your fighter level. If you miss with the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make before the end of your next turn, or one target succeeds on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your weapon's burst or rapid property, you instead deal normal weapon damage.

entries.name: Straight Through
entries: {@i {@b Heavy Weapons Specialist:} 10th level} When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} on your turn while wielding a weapon with the heavy or strength properties, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against a creature within 5 feet of the target using your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Overwhelm
entries: {@i {@b Heavy Weapons Specialist:} 15th level} When you use your Second Wind while wielding a weapon with the heavy or strength properties, if you hit with the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make, or if one creatures fails the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your weapon's burst or rapid property, before the end of your next turn, you treat the hit as a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}. If you miss with the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make before the end of your next turn, or one target succeeds on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your weapon's burst or rapid property, you instead deal normal weapon damage.

entries.name: Pure Performance
entries: {@i {@b Heavy Weapons Specialist:} 18th level} At 18th level, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make while wielding a weapon with the heavy or strength properties can't suffer from {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Mounted Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Mounted Specialists excel at mounted combat. Mounted Specialists are most dangerous from the seat of a speeder or saddle of a varactyl, though they can hold their own from the ground. Their versatility often has them leading the charge or protecting the team.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Mounted Specialist:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Born to the Saddle
entries: {@i {@b Mounted Specialist:} 3rd level} Your mastery as a rider becomes apparent. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off your mount and descend no more than 10 feet, you can land on your feet if you're not {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}.
Finally, mounting or dismounting a creature or vehicle costs you only 5 feet of movement, rather than half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

entries.name: Unwavering Mark
entries: {@i {@b Mounted Specialist:} 3rd level} You can menace your foes, foiling their attacks and punishing them for harming others. When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can mark the creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or you die, or if someone else marks the creature. While it is within 5 feet of you, a creature marked by you has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on any {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} that doesn't target you.

Additionally, if a creature marked by you deals damage to anyone other than you, you can make a special {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against the marked creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your next turn. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, and if it hits, the attacks weapon deals extra damage to the target equal to half your fighter level.

Regardless of the number of creatures you mark, you can make this special attack a number of times equal to your Strength modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Warding Maneuver
entries: {@i {@b Mounted Specialist:} 7th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level} You learn to fend off strikes directed at you, your mount, or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is dealt damage by an attack, you can roll 1d8 as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} if you're wielding a melee weapon or a shield. Roll the die, and add the number rolled to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has resistance against the attack's damage.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Hold the Line
entries: {@i {@b Mounted Specialist:} 10th level} You become a master of locking down your enemies. Creatures provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach, and if you hit a creature with an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, the target gains 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels until the end of the current turn.

entries.name: Ferocious Charger
entries: {@i {@b Mounted Specialist:} 15th level} You can run down your foes, whether you're mounted or not. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attacking a creature and you hit it with the attack, that target must succeed on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength modifier) or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

entries.name: Vigilant Defender
entries: {@i {@b Mounted Specialist:} 18th level} You respond to danger with extraordinary vigilance. In combat, you get a special {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} that you can take once on every creature's turn, except your turn. You can use this special {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} only to make an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, and you can't use it on the same turn that you take your normal {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Praetorian Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Praetorian Specialists seek perfection of both body and mind. These warriors master the art of warfare, and are often sought as bodyguards for the galaxy's elite. They are engines of destruction and resilience, able to fight on to their last breath.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiency
entries: {@i {@b Praetorian Specialist:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

entries.name: Fighting Spirit
entries: {@i {@b Praetorian Specialist:} 3rd level} Your intensity in battle can shield you and help you strike true. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn, you can give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on all {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack rolls} until the end of the current turn. When you do so, you also gain 5 temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. The number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to 10 at 10th level and 15 at 15th level.
You can use this feature three times. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Resilient Retainer
entries: {@i {@b Praetorian Specialist:} 7th level} Your discipline and attention to detail allow you to excel in social situations. You gain proficiency in {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}.

Additionally, your self-control also causes you to gain proficiency in Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} (your choice).

entries.name: Tireless Spirit
entries: {@i {@b Praetorian Specialist:} 10th level} When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, you regain one use.

entries.name: Rapid Strike
entries: {@i {@b Praetorian Specialist:} 15th level} You learn to trade accuracy for swift strikes. If you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn and have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against one of the targets, you can forgo the {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} for that roll to make an additional {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against that target, as part of the same action. You can do so no more than once per turn.

entries.name: Strength Before Weakness
entries: {@i {@b Praetorian Specialist:} 18th level} Your fighting spirit can delay the grasp of death. If you take damage that reduces you to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to delay falling {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb|unconscious}, and you can immediately take an extra turn. While you have 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} during that extra turn, taking damage causes {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throw} failures as normal, and three {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throw} failures can still kill you. When the extra turn ends, you fall {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb|unconscious} if you still have 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Totem Specialist
entries: Those fighters who become Totem Specialists tap into a primal attunement to the Force, applying tribal ceremony to create powerful talismans that enhance their abilities.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Totem Specialist:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency with your choice of artist's implements or jeweler's implements.

entries.name: Totem Creation
entries: {@i {@b Totem Specialist:} 3rd level} You've learned to create powerful talismans infused with the Force. Your totems can take the form of sigils painted directly onto your equipment, or adornments attached to it, as you see fit. Regardless of the form they take, only you can benefit from them. You learn two totems of your choice, which are detailed under "Totems" below. When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace one totem you know with a different one.

When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can touch a number of weapons, armor, or shields equal to the number of totems you know, affixing a different totem to each object. Your totem remains affixed until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, and an object can only bear one totem at a time. You must be wielding or wearing the object to benefit from a totem affixed to it.
Each totem can be invoked to grant an effect. Once you've invoked a totem in this way, you can't do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Totem Options
entries: The totems are listed in alphabetical order. If a totem requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice).

entries.name: Totem of the Acklay
entries: This totem evokes the ferocity of an acklay, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}) checks and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}) checks.

Additionally, you can invoke the totem as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. For 10 minutes, your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles, and your Strength score increases by 2. This increase can cause your score to exceed 20.

entries.name: Totem of the Hawk
entries: This totem is inspired by the visage of a hawk, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks, and {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, its range increases by 30 feet.

Additionally, when a creature you can see ends its turn within 30 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to invoke the totem and force the creature to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} by emitting a powerful sound. Unless the save succeeds, the creature is dazed, suffering from the {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} condition, for 1 minute. While {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} in this way, the creature has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 0 and is {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}. The effect ends if the {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} creature takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its haze. Once you invoke the totem, you can't do so again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. A deaf creature automatically succeeds on its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

entries.name: Totem of the Loth-wolf
entries: This totem emulates the near etherealness of a loth-wolf, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) checks and Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) checks.

Additionally, when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to invoke the totem and cause that attack to target a different creature within 30 feet of you (other than the attacker) that you can see, using the same roll. This ability can transfer the attack regardless of the attack's range.

entries.name: Totem of the Rancor
entries: This totem bestows a resilience reminiscent of a mighty rancor, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} and resistance to poison damage.
Additionally, you can invoke the totem as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, gaining resistance to energy and kinetic damage for 1 minute.

entries.name: Totem of the Sarlacc
entries: This totem channels the experience of an ancient sarlacc, granting you {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in any one tool in which you are proficient.

Additionally, when you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can invoke the totem to summon the tentacles of the creature: The target must succeed on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} for 1 minute. While {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} by the tentacles, the target takes 2d6 acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, tearing free on a success.

entries.name: Totem of the Vornskr
entries: With this totem you are able to access the Force-enhanced senses of the vornskr, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) checks, and you can't be surprised as long as you are not {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}.

Additionally, you can invoke the totem as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to enter a state of hyper awareness for 1 minute or until you're {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}. Until the state ends, when you or another creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cause the roll to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Totemic Might
entries: {@i {@b Totem Specialist:} 3rd level} You can channel the power of your Force awareness temporarily. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can gain the following benefits for 1 minute. You can invoke a totem as a part of this same {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

items: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength checks and Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. You can use this feature twice. You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Guardian Spirit
entries: {@i {@b Totem Specialist:} 7th level} You learn to invoke your totems to protect your allies. When another creature you can see within 60 feet of you is hit by an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to grant a bonus to the creature's AC against that attack. The bonus equals 1 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +2).

entries.name: Primal Avatar
entries: {@i {@b Totem Specialist:} 10th level} You learn a third totem. Additionally, the bonus damage of your Totemic Might feature increases to 1d8. Lastly, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} checks you make about tribal cultures.

entries.name: Spirit Guide
entries: {@i {@b Totem Specialist:} 15th level} You can invoke each of your totems twice, instead of once. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Blessing of the Tree of Light
entries: {@i {@b Totem Specialist:} 18th level} You learn how to share your totem's power with your allies. When you use your Totemic Might feature, you can choose one willing creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The chosen creature also gains the benefits of your Totemic Might feature. If you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or killed, this effect immediately ends for both of you.

entries.name: Aqinos Form
entries: {@optfeature Aqinos Form|sw5e-phb}, also know as Adaptation Form, is named after a Jedi Master who sought to merge technology with Force use. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Aqinos Form|sw5e-phb} adopt these tenets to employ clever exploits using technology and the aid of a droid companion.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Aqinos Form:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} and the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Aqinos Form:} 3rd level} You gain the Aqinos {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, detailed in the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb} Forms section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: Techcasting Secrets
entries: {@i {@b Aqinos Form:} 3rd level} You have learned to blend your technological aptitude with the Force. Choose two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of no higher level than your Max Power Level, as shown in the guardian table. The chosen powers count as both universal {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for you, but are not included in the number in the Powers Known column of the guardian table.

You learn two additional powers at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you know and replace it with another {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of no higher level than your Max Power Level.

entries.name: Droid Companion
entries: {@i {@b Aqinos Form:} 3rd, 5th, 9th, 11th, 13th, and 17th level} You learn to employ all the knowledge you've accumulated to create, customize, and bond with your own droid companion.

Create your droid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} in order to create your droid.

If your companion is irreparably destroyed, or you want a companion, you must first break the bond with your current companion. Bonding with a new companion takes 8 hours spent in an appropriate location. You may only have one companion at a time.
In addition to its traits and features, your droid companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your companion is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

Your companion gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each companion trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your force point maximum is reduced by 2. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace or remove a number of companion traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, your companion can cast the {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you know without expending tech points. If your companion casts an at-will power in this way, it does not scale normally at higher levels. Instead, if it would scale at 5th level, it instead scales at 11th level, and if it would scale at 11th level, it instead scales at 17th level. If your companion casts a power of 2nd-level or higher, it consumes a number of uses of this feature equal to that power's level. At 11th level, your droid companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your droid companion must be within 60 feet. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Aqinos Form:} 7th level} You learn your choice of the Cause Harm or Lend Aid Channel the Force options, and when you use either of these options, you gain additional benefits.

entries.name: Cause Harm
entries: You can choose to deal ion damage instead of necrotic.

entries.name: Lend Aid
entries: Droids and constructs are now valid targets.

entries.name: Adaptive Calibration
entries: {@i {@b Aqinos Form:} 15th level} When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, or you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a friendly creature that is at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you regain an expended use of your Channel the Force, and you gain temporary force points equal to the power's level.

entries.name: Master of Adaptation
entries: {@i {@b Aqinos Form:} 20th level} Your masteries of the Force and technology have achieved equilibrium. Your Constitution and Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) scores increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to ion damage, and you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against ion or lightning damage.

You can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make as a part of a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, and enemies can't have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.
You add your governing ability modifier (minimum of +1) to any damage or healing you do with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast that don't already include that modifier.

entries: While you are conscious and your droid is within 60 feet of you and conscious, it also gains these benefits.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Ataru Form
entries: {@optfeature Ataru Form|sw5e-phb}, also know as Aggression Form, is a kinetically active form that relies on {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, acrobatics, and power. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Ataru Form|sw5e-phb} utilize high energy tactics to confuse and distract their opponents, quickly moving about the battlefield.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Ataru Form:} 3rd level} You gain the Ataru {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of the Player's Handbook. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: The Way of the Hawk-Bat
entries: {@i {@b Ataru Form:} 3rd level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can take an aggressive stance, leaping around the battlefield for 1 minute. As a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns, you can cast the {@i force jump} power at 1st-level without expending force points. Additionally, when you cast {@i force jump}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make against each creature within 5 feet of where you land.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Ataru Form:} 3rd level} You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Retreating Leap
entries: When a creature makes a melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force and your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to jump 10 feet in a direction of your choice, imposing {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll. This movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}. You can wait until after the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} is made, but before the DM determines whether the attack hits.

entries.name: Hawk-Bat Swoop
entries: {@i {@b Ataru Form:} 7th level} You gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces without falIing during the move. If you end your turn in the air, you fall immediately to the ground.
Additionally, you no longer take damage when falling from a distance no greater than your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

entries.name: Whirlwind Attack
entries: {@i {@b Ataru Form:} 15th level} You can use your action to make melee attacks against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for each target.

entries.name: Master of Aggression
entries: {@i {@b Ataru Form:} 20th level} Your presence on the field of battle is as a graceful blur of deadly blades and daring acrobatics. Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage from weapons.
When an ally within 30 feet of you takes the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, they can make one additional attack as a part of that same action.
When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can move up to 10 feet. This movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Jar'Kai Form
entries: {@optfeature Jar'Kai Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Domination Form, utilizes two weapons to overwhelm their foes. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Jar'Kai Form|sw5e-phb} know that two weapons offer greater versatility than one, and capitalize on the twin angles from which they attack to subdue their enemies.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Jar'Kai Form:} 3rd level} You gain the Jar'Kai {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of the Player's Handbook. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: The Way of the Acklay
entries: {@i {@b Jar'Kai Form:} 3rd level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a destructive stance for one minute. While in this stance, you can add half your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice, minimum of one) to any melee weapon damage roll you make that doesn't already include that modifier. Additionally, when you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Jar'Kai Form:} 3rd level} You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Twin Strike
entries: Once per turn, when you miss with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force to immediately make another {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against the same target (no action required).

entries.name: Eye of the Storm
entries: {@i {@b Jar'Kai Form:} 7th level} When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you regain an expended use of your Channel the Force.

entries.name: Rising Whirlwind
entries: {@i {@b Jar'Kai Form:} 15th level} As an action, you can rush forward up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}. Each creature within 5 feet of your path must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with your weapon). A creature takes normal weapon damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If you are wielding separate two light- or vibro-weapons in each hand with which you are proficient, or a weapon with the double property, a creature makes this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and takes additional damage equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice, minimum of one) on a failed save if it doesn't already include that modifier.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Master of Domination
entries: {@i {@b Jar'Kai Form:} 20th level} You are a whirlwind of strikes, eviscerating all who step within your reach. Your Strength and Dexterity scores increase by 2. Your maximum for these scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage from weapons.

When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} roll you make against that creature, and that creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} from you even if they take the {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb} action before leaving your reach until the end of your next turn.
Creatures provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} from you when they enter your reach.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Juyo/Vaapad Form
entries: Juyo/{@optfeature Vaapad Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Ferocity Form, revels in the satisfaction of battle and victory. Those guardians who focus on Juyo/{@optfeature Vaapad Form|sw5e-phb} channel their emotions into their fighting, making heavy, sweeping strikes.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Juyo/Vaapad Form:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Juyo/Vaapad Form:} 3rd level} You gain your choice of the Juyo or Vaapad {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of the Player's Handbook. If you already know the chosen form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: The Way of the Vornskr
entries: {@i {@b Juyo/Vaapad Form:} 3rd level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can take a savage stance, designating one creature you can see within 10 feet of you as your prey for 1 minute. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against the creature. If the target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on a subsequent turn to mark a new creature.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Juyo/Vaapad Form:} 3rd level} You gain one of the following Channel the Force options. Choose Snap Aggression for Juyo or Assertive Defense for Vaapad.

entries.name: Snap Aggression
entries: If you are surprised at the start of combat and aren't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force to act normally on your first turn.

entries.name: Assertive Defense
entries: When you reduce the damage dealt by a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} to 0 using the {@i saber reflect} power, and you're wielding a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} or {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force to reflect the attack at a target within range, regardless of what type the damage is.

entries.name: Fury
entries: {@i {@b Juyo/Vaapad Form:} 7th level} You gain one of the following features. Choose Relentless for Juyo or Punishing {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb} for Vaapad.

entries.name: Relentless
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} checks, and gain a 10 foot bonus to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} on your first turn of combat.

entries.name: Punishing Charge
entries: When a hostile creature you can see or hear within 30 feet of you casts a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started. If you end this movement within 5 feet of the creature, and the triggering {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} required a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll.

entries.name: Vengeance
entries: {@i {@b Juyo/Vaapad Form:} 15th level} You gain one of the following features. Choose Devastating Critical for Juyo or Their Power, My Strength for Vaapad.

entries.name: Devastating Critical
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you gain a bonus to that weapon's damage roll equal to your guardian level.

entries.name: Their Power, My Strength
entries: When you are dealt damage by a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can reduce that damage by an amount equal to your guardian level (no action required).
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Master of Ferocity
entries: {@i {@b Juyo/Vaapad Form:} 20th level} You are a paragon of extraordinary martial prowess. Your Strength and Dexterity scores increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to all damage.
When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack as part of that action.
Your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range with weapons increases by 1.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Shii-Cho Form
entries: {@optfeature Shii-Cho Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Determination Form, uses wild, unpredictable attacks designed to distract and disarm their foes. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Shii-Cho Form|sw5e-phb} make seemingly random, yet deliberate, attacks to knock their opponents off-balance.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Shii-Cho Form:} 3rd level} You gain the Shii-Cho {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of the Player's Handbook. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: The Way of the Sarlaac
entries: {@i {@b Shii-Cho Form:} 3rd level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a frenetic stance for one minute. While in this stance, the first time you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} on your turn, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the next melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} it makes against you before the start of your next turn. Additionally, if that creature is within 5 feet of you, it must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength or Dexterity modifier). On a failed save, it is pushed back 5 feet, and you can immediately move into the space it just vacated without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Shii-Cho Form:} 3rd level} You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Disarming Slash
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force (no action required)  to attempt to disarm the target, forcing it to drop one item of your choice that it's holding. The creature must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, it drops the object you choose. If you are within 5 feet of the target, and you have a free hand, you can catch the item. Otherwise, the object lands at its feet.

entries.name: Unpredictable Motion
entries: {@i {@b Shii-Cho Form:} 7th level} While you are wielding a light- or vibro-weapon, {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} against you are made at {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Sarlaac Sweep
entries: {@i {@b Shii-Cho Form:} 15th level} When a creature moves to within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against that creature. If the attack hits, you can attempt to damage another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.

entries.name: Master of Determination
entries: {@i {@b Shii-Cho Form:} 20th level} The erratic fluidity of your movement confounds even the most determined of foes. Your Strength or Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for these scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage from weapons.
Attack rolls made against you can't have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

When more than one creature is within 5 feet of you, you gain a bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb} equal to the number of creatures within 5 feet of you, up to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one).

When you use your Sarlaac Sweep feature, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, and you can apply the bonus damage to every creature within 5 feet of you.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Sokan Form
entries: {@optfeature Sokan Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Persistence Form, uses determined movements followed by swift strokes to keep their opponents' footing unsteady. Those guardians who focus on Persistence Form make use of the terrain, trying to maneuver their opponents into vulnerable areas before dispatching them.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Sokan Form:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Sokan Form:} 3rd level} You gain the Sokan {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of the Player's Handbook. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: The Way of the Varactyl
entries: {@i {@b Sokan Form:} 3rd level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter an unyielding stance for one minute. While in this stance, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to shove, trip, and avoid being moved, and you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}. Additionally, once per turn, when you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can attempt to shove the target up to 10 feet away from you (no action required).

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Sokan Form:} 3rd level} You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: High Ground Defense
entries: When an opponent within 5 feet of you makes a melee attack against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a use of your Channel the Force to move to another space within 5 feet of that creature without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}, imposing {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll. If the attack misses, you can attempt to shove the creature up to 10 feet away from you as a part of that same {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Unwavering Self
entries: {@i {@b Sokan Form:} 7th and 15th level} If you fail a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can reroll the die. You must use the new roll.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again. At 15th level you can use this feature twice between long rests.

entries.name: Unhindered Charge
entries: {@i {@b Sokan Form:} 15th level} Wen you move at least 10 feet before making a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you deal additional damage equal to your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Master of Persistence
entries: {@i {@b Sokan Form:} 20th level} You are an unrelenting force on the field of battle. Your Strength and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for these scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage from weapons.
You ignore effects that would reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

Once per turn, when you push a creature, you can move up to 10 feet as a part of this push without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}. If you end this movement within 5 feet of that creature, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} (no action required).

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Trakata Form
entries: {@optfeature Trakata Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} Form, capitalizes on a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}'s ability to quickly be toggled on and off. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Trakata Form|sw5e-phb} perform dazzling tricks with their {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, confusing their opponents before dispatching them.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Trakata Form:} 3rd level} You gain the Trakata {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of the Player's Handbook. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: The Way of the Monkey-Lizard
entries: {@i {@b Trakata Form:} 3rd level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a confusing stance for one minute. As a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns, when you take the {@action Dodge|sw5e-phb} action, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against a creature within range. Additionally, when you make this {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can flourish your weapon to attempt to distract your target. Make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check contested by a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check of the target of your attack. On a success, you make this {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Trakata Form:} 3rd level} You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Unbalancing Block
entries: When you are hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, and you are wielding a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} with which you are proficient, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a use of your Channel the Force to add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1) to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

entries.name: Duplicitous Force
entries: {@i {@b Trakata Form:} 7th level} When you make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check, you gain a bonus to that check equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one).

entries.name: Pass the Blade
entries: {@i {@b Trakata Form:} 15th level} When a creature misses you with an attack, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one), and you add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) to the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} and damage rolls you make against that creature before the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Master of Deception
entries: {@i {@b Trakata Form:} 20th level} Your skill with a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} is both mesmerizing and confounding. Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for these scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage from weapons.
Your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} can't suffer from {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.
Whenever a creature misses you with a melee attack, it takes 5 energy damage.
Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes damage equal to half of the damage you take from the attack.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Vonil/Ishu Form
entries: Vonil/{@optfeature Ishu Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Unity Form, focuses on fighting in tandem with your allies. Those guardians who focus on Vonil/{@optfeature Ishu Form|sw5e-phb} utilize teamwork to move swiftly, strike quickly, and protect each other from harm.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 3rd level} You gain your choice of the Vonil or Ishu {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, detailed in the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb} Forms section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. If you already know the chosen form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: The Way of the Hydra
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 3rd, 11th, and 17th level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a synchronized stance with one ally of your choice within 10 feet of you for 1 minute. While in this stance, once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack, the chosen ally has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next attack it makes against the same target before the end of your next turn. Additionally, once per turn, when the chosen ally hits a creature with an attack, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next attack you make against the same target before the end of your next turn.

This effect ends early if either you or the chosen ally are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die, or if the chosen ally is ever more than 10 feet away from you. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
At 11th level, the chosen ally must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, the chosen ally must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 3rd, 11th, and 17th level} You gain one of the following Channel the Force options. Choose Smite for Vonil or shield for Ishu.

entries.name: Smite
entries: Once per turn, when an ally is within 10 feet of you and it hits a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force and expend force points to have the chosen ally deal additional damage to the target, which is the same type as the weapon's damage. The additional damage is 1d8 for each point spent in this way. You can't deal more additional damage than the amount shown in the Focused Strikes column of the guardian table.
At 11th level, the chosen ally must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, the chosen ally must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Shield
entries: When an ally is hit by a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} while within 10 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a use of your Channel the Force to attempt to divert the attack. When you do so, the damage the chosen ally takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) + your guardian level.
At 11th level, the chosen ally must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, the chosen ally must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Amplified Auras
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 7th, 11th, and 17th level} Once on each of your turns, you can choose an ally within 10 feet of you. While the chosen ally is within 10 feet of you, your auras emit from that ally as if you were standing in that ally's space. A creature in the area of more than one instance of your auras is affected only once.
At 11th level, the chosen ally must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, the chosen ally must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Teamwork
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 15th level} You gain one of the following features. Choose Takedown for Vonil or Rebuttal for Ishu.

entries.name: Takedown
entries: When an ally within 30 feet of you takes the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and helps you, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next two {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make before the start of their next turn, instead of only one. When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and help an ally within 30 feet of you, the chosen ally has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next two {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} it makes before the start of your next turn, instead of only one.

entries.name: Rebuttal
entries: When an ally within 30 feet of you takes the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and helps you, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your guardian level that last until the start of their next turn. When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and help an ally within 30 feet of you, it gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your guardian level that last until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Master of Unity
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 20th level} You and your allies are a paragon of harmony. Your Strength or Dexterity (your choice) and Constitution scores increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action and choose an ally within 60 feet of you to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You and the chosen ally have resistance to kinetic and energy damage.
Neither you nor the chosen ally can have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}.
Both you and the chosen ally's {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} ranges increase by 1.

entries: This effect ends early if either you or the chosen ally are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die, or if the chosen ally is ever more than 60 feet away from you. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Vonil/Ishu Form (Companion)
entries: Vonil/{@optfeature Ishu Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Unity Form, focuses on fighting in tandem with a partner as a warpair. Those guardians who focus on Vonil/{@optfeature Ishu Form|sw5e-phb} utilize teamwork to move swiftly, strike quickly, and protect each other.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in your choice of {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 3rd level} You gain your choice of the Vonil or Ishu {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, detailed in the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb} Forms section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. If you already know the chosen form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: Humanoid Companion
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 3rd, 11th, and 17th level} You've adopted a partner, gaining the services of your own humanoid companion.
Create your humanoid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your companion gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your force point maximum is reduced by 2.

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, when you or your companion are dealt damage by an external effect, you can choose to have you or your companion gain resistance to that damage. If you do so, the other of the two takes the same damage as true damage.
At 11th level, your companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your companion must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: The Way of the Hydra
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 3rd level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a synchronized stance with your companion for 1 minute, as long as your companion is within 10 feet of you. While in this stance, once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack, your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next attack it makes against the same target before the end of your next turn. Additionally, once per turn, when your companion hits a creature with an attack, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next attack you make against the same target before the end of your next turn.

This effect ends early if either you or your companion are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die, or if your companion is ever more than 10 feet away from you. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
At 11th level, your companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your companion must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 7th, 11th, and 17th level} You gain one of the following Channel the Force options. Choose Smite for Vonil or shield for Ishu.

entries.name: Smite
entries: Once per turn, when your companion is within 10 feet of you and it hits a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force and expend force points to have your companion deal additional damage to the target, which is the same type as the weapon's damage. The additional damage is 1d8 for each point spent in this way. You can't deal more additional damage than the amount shown in the Focused Strikes column of the guardian table.
At 11th level, your companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your companion must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Shield
entries: When your companion is hit by a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} while within 10 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a use of your Channel the Force to attempt to divert the attack. When you do so, the damage your companion takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) + your guardian level.
At 11th level, your companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your companion must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Teamwork
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 15th level} You gain one of the following features. Choose Takedown for Vonil or Rebuttal for Ishu.

entries.name: Takedown
entries: When your companion takes the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and helps you, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next two {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make before the start of your next turn, instead of only one. When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and help your companion, your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next two {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} it makes before the start of its next turn, instead of only one.

entries.name: Rebuttal
entries: When your companion takes the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and helps you, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your guardian level that last until the start of your next turn. When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and help your companion, it gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your guardian level that last until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Master of Unity
entries: {@i {@b Vonil/Ishu Form:} 20th level} You and your companion are a paragon of harmony. Your Strength or Dexterity (your choice) and Constitution scores increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute, as long as your companion is within 60 feet of you:

items: You and your companion have resistance to kinetic and energy damage.
Neither you nor your companion can have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}.
Both you and your companion's {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} ranges increase by 1.

entries: This effect ends early if either you or your companion are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die, or if your companion is ever more than 60 feet away from you. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Ysannanite Form
entries: {@optfeature Ysannanite Form|sw5e-phb}, also know as the Unorthodox Form, pairs the use of lightsaber with {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true}, seamlessly blending the two weapons to perform impressive feats. Those guardians who focus on the {@optfeature Ysannanite Form|sw5e-phb} are able to cut enemies down as efficiently with {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} as with blade.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i {@b Ysannanite Form:} 3rd level} You gain proficiency in {@filter simple blasters|items|firearm=true|weaponcategory=simple} and martial {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} that lack the two-handed property.

entries.name: Form Basics
entries: {@i {@b Ysannanite Form:} 3rd level} You gain the Ysannanite {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, detailed in the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb} Forms section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

entries.name: The Way of the Yerdua
entries: {@i {@b Ysannanite Form:} 3rd level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can take a meditative stance for 1 minute, granting you {@feat Supreme Accuracy|sw5e-phb|supreme accuracy} as you guide your shots to their target through the Force. While in this stance, you add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1) to one ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} and damage roll you make each turn. Additionally, when making a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Channel the Force
entries: {@i {@b Ysannanite Form:} 3rd level} You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Force-Empowered Shots
entries: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force and expend force points to deal additional damage to the target, which is the same type as the weapon's damage. The additional damage is 1d8 for each point spent in this way. You can't deal more additional damage than the amount shown in the Focused Strikes column of the guardian table.

entries.name: Improved Force-Empowered Shots
entries: {@i {@b Ysannanite Form:} 7th level} Your familiarity with {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons has granted you greater insight into their function and usage. Once on each of your turns, drawing or stowing a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} no longer requires your object interaction. Additionally, you no longer require a free hand to reload.

At 11th level, once per turn, when you hit a creature with a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage. If you also use your Force-Empowered Shots with an attack, you add this damage to the extra damage of your Force-Empowered Shots. The damage is the same type as the weapon's damage.

entries.name: Phasestorm
entries: {@i {@b Ysannanite Form:} 15th level} You can use your action to dart across the battlefield, striking up to six such creatures that you can see within 30 feet. You immediately move to each creature in succession without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}, after which you return to the space in which you started. Each creature must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with your weapon). A creature takes normal weapon damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If you are wielding separate weapons in each hand with which you are proficient, a creature makes this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and takes additional damage equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) on a failed save if the damage doesn't already include that modifier.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Master of the Unorthodox
entries: {@i {@b Ysannanite Form:} 20th level} You've mastered the unity between {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} and blade. Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for these scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage from weapons.

When you hit a creature with a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} you make against that creature. When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} you make against that creature.

When you roll below half the maximum on a damage die, you can treat the roll as if you'd rolled half the maximum on the damage die. You can only affect a number of dice up to half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) in this way.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Aing-Tii Order
entries: Monks of the Aing-Tii Order blend an attunement to the Force with their supreme focus to become a blur of motion in the heat of battle.

entries.name: Forcecasting
entries: {@i {@b Aing-Tii Order:} 3rd level} You have learned powers, fragments of knowledge that imbue you with an abiding force ability. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 11|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for the {@book force powers list|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force Powers Known
entries: You learn 4 {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} column of the Aing-Tii Order {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table. You may not learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level, and you may learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at the same time you learn its prerequisite.

entries.name: Force Points
entries: You have a number of force points equal to your monk level, as shown in the Force Points column of the Aing-Tii Order {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table, + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice). You use these force points to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. You regain all expended force points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} can be overpowered, consuming more force points to create a greater effect. You can overpower these abilities to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the Aing-Tii Order {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table.
You may only cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 4th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Forcecasting Ability
entries: Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} varies based on the alignment of the powers you cast. You use your Wisdom for {@book light side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, Charisma for {@book dark side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and Wisdom or Charisma for {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice). You use this ability whenever a power refers to your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Force save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier
{@b Force attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier

entries.name: Flow-Walking
entries: {@i {@b Aing-Tii Order:} 6th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level} You can cast the {@i phasestrike} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} without expending force points. When you reach 11th level, the damage bonus of the special attack made during {@i phasestrike} increases to 2d8, and at 17th level it increases to 3d8.

entries.name: Aing-Tii Order Forcecasting
entries: Additionally, when you use your action to cast an at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can use your Martial Arts or Focus features.
You can use these features a combined three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Prismatic Step
entries: {@i {@b Aing-Tii Order:} 11th level} When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can teleport up to 10 feet before each attack to an unoccupied space you can see.
If you attack at least two different creatures with the action, you can make one additional attack against a third creature (no action required).

entries.name: Iridescent Strikes
entries: {@i {@b Aing-Tii Order:} 17th level} When you use your action to cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can spend 2 focus points to teleport to a space within 5 feet of a creature affected by the power and make two {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} against that creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Jal Shey Order
entries: Monks of the Jal Shey order, driven by the pursuit of knowledge, maintain one of the most well-respected and heavily guarded repositories of history and knowledge across the galaxy: the Archives of the Jal Shey. Here, young folk of all species seeking the clarity of truth and the strength of knowledge pledge to learn the arts of seeking enlightenment by understanding the world around them, and mastering the techniques to defend it. To become a Jal Shey monk is to give one's self to the quest for unveiling the deepest mysteries of the galaxy, to bring light to the secrets of the dark, and guard the most powerful and dangerous of truths.

entries.name: Mystical Erudition
entries: {@i {@b Jal Shey Order:} 3rd level} You've undergone extensive training in lore from the Jal Shey's collected knowledge. You learn one language of your choice, and you gain proficiency in your choice of {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}. You learn an additional language and an additional skill proficiency from the above list at 11th level.

Additionally, you can strike multiple pressure points to extract crucial details about your foe. Whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can learn learn certain information about its capabilities. The GM tells you if the creature has one of the following characteristics of your choice:

entries.name: Extort Truth
entries: {@i {@b Jal Shey Order:} 6th level} You can hit a series of hidden nerves on a creature with precision, temporarily causing them to be unable to mask their true thoughts and intent. When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can have the attack deal no damage and spend 1 focus point to force them to make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your focus save DC. On a failed save, the creature is unable to speak a deliberate lie for 1 minute and all Charisma checks directed at the creature are made with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} for the duration.
On a success or failure, a creature is aware that you attempted to influence them. They can choose to avoid answering questions to which they would normally respond with a lie.

entries.name: Preternatural Counter
entries: {@i {@b Jal Shey Order:} 6th level} Your quick mind and study of your foe allows you to use their failure to your {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. When a creature within 5 feet of you misses you with a melee attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make an unarmed strike against that creature.

entries.name: Mercurial Mind
entries: {@i {@b Jal Shey Order:} 11th level} You've honed your awareness and reflexes through mental aptitude and pattern recognition. Once per turn, if you've already used your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}, you can spend 1 focus point to take an additional {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. You can only take one {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} per turn.

entries.name: Debilitating Barrage
entries: {@i {@b Jal Shey Order:} 17th level} You've gained the knowledge to temporarily inhibit a creature's fortitude by striking a series of pressure points. Whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 focus points to cause the creature to become vulnerable to a damage type of your choice. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until they take damage of the chosen type.

entries.name: Kage Order
entries: Monks of the Kage Order, known as Kage warriors, have mastered fighting in darkness, using that which others fear as a weapon against them. Kage warriors learn tricks to create darkness where none exists, fighting using their intuition rather than relying on sight.

entries.name: Darkness Charges
entries: {@i {@b Kage Order:} 3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level} You learn to create a number of small charges that create enhanced darkness. Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can create two charges. You can create an additional charge at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. Your charges can only be used by you, and they lose their potency at the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Once per turn, when you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} or unarmed strike, you can instead throw one of your charges. Your charges have a range equal to 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. You can throw a device at a point you can see within range. The charges create a pocket of darkness in a 10-foot radius sphere centered on that point. The darkness spreads around corners. It lasts for 1 minute or until an enhanced source of bright light dispells it.

entries.name: Disruptive Shock
