I would kill to acquire a noble title.
I'm horribly jealous of anyone who can outshine my handiwork. Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by rivals.

entries.name: Far Traveler
entries: Almost all of the common people and other folk that one might encounter throughout the galaxy have one thing in common: they live  their lives without traveling more than a few miles from where they were born.
You aren't one of those folk.

You are from a distant place that few of the common folk realize exists; chances are good that even if some people have heard of your homeland, they know merely the name and maybe a few outrageous stories.

Although you find some of this land's ways to be strange and discomfiting, you can also be sure that some things its people take for granted will be, to you, new wonders that you've never laid eyes on before. By the same token, you're a person of interest, for good or ill, to those around you almost anywhere you go.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One musical instrument or gaming set of your choice

{@b Equipment:} One set of traveler's clothes, any one musical instrument or gaming set you are proficient with, poorly wrought maps from your homeland, a small piece of jewelry worth 100 cr in the style of your homeland's craftsmanship, and a pouch containing 50 cr

entries.name: Why Are You Here?
entries: To determine why you are so far from home, roll on the table below or choose from the options provided.

entries.name: Feature: All Eyes On You
entries: Your foreign nature attracts attention, yielding access to people and places you might not otherwise have, for you and your traveling companions. Noble lords, scholars, and merchant princes, to name a few, might be interested in hearing about your distant homeland and people.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: The distance you've traveled manifests itself in the way you speak and carry yourself.

rows: I have different assumptions from those around me concerning personal space, invading others' space in innocence, or reacting to invasion of my own.
I have my own ideas about food, and I find the eating habits of others fascinating, confusing, or revolting.
I have a strong code of honor or sense of propriety that others don't comprehend.
I express affection or contempt in ways that are unfamiliar to others.
I honor my deities through practices that are foreign to this land.
I begin or end my day with small traditional rituals that are unfamiliar to those around me.
{@b Open.} I have much to learn from the kindly folk I meet along my way. (Light)
{@b Reserved.} As someone new to these strange lands, I am cautious and respectful in my dealings. (Lawful)
{@b Adventure.} I'm far from home, and everything is strange and wonderful! (Chaotic)
{@b Cunning.} Though I may not know their ways, neither do they know mine, which can be to my {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. (Dark)
{@b Inquisitive.} Everything is new, but I have a thirst to learn. (Neutral)
{@b Suspicious.} I must be careful, for I have no way of telling friend from foe here. (Any)
So long as I have this token from my homeland, I can face any adversity in this strange land.
The gods of my people are a comfort to me so far from home.
I hold no greater cause than my service to my people.
My freedom is my most precious possession. I'll never let anyone take it from me again.
I'm fascinated by the beauty and wonder of this new land.
Though I had no choice, I lament having to leave my loved one(s) behind. I ho pe to see them again one day.
I am secretly (or not so secretly) convinced of the superiority of my own culture over that of this foreign land.
I pretend not to understand the local language in order to avoid interactions I would rather not have.
I have a weakness for the new intoxicants and other pleasures of this land.
I don't take kindly to some of the actions and motivations of folk different from me.
I consider the adherents of other gods to be deluded innocents at best, or ignorant fools at worst.
I have a weakness for the exotic beauty of the people of these lands.

entries.name: Farmer
entries: You are an experienced farmer, cultivating and harvesting nature for the provision of others. You have spent a lot of time surviving outside population centers, but know how to sell your product either directly or to merchants, legal or otherwise.  Because you deal with commodities, either as input or as produce, you know how to get things done and how to live on razor-thin margins. You have survived up to this point by working long, hard, and smart.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One instrument and one type of artisan's implements or bioanalysis kit
{@b Equipment:} A rough instrument you are proficient with, a set of tools (one of your choice), a sturdy knife, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 50 cr

entries.name: Farming Specialty
entries: There are as many kinds of farmers as there are things to harvest. Even farmers who provide for all their own needs have deep experience in one type of farming over others. Choose your harvest, or roll on the table below.

entries.name: Feature: Rustic Hospitality
entries: Since you are of the common folk, you fit in among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A farmer is one of the common people and unusually tied to their home and the land. Most farmers look on their humble origins as a virtue, not a shortcoming, and they are quick to defend their home communities and their values, even if they always longed to leave their rural lives and move to the city.

rows: I judge people by their actions, not their words.
If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.
When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.
I have a strong sense of fair play and always try to find the most equitable solution to arguments.
Thinking is for other people. I prefer action.
I misuse long words in an attempt to sound smarter.
I watch over my friends as if they were a litter of newborn pups.
I have a lesson for every situation, drawn from observing nature.
{@b Respect.} People deserve to be treated with dignity and respect. (Light)
{@b Honor.} My word is my bond. (Lawful)
{@b Freedom.} Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Light)
{@b Greed.} I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy. (Dark)
{@b Live and Let Live.} Meddling in the affairs of others only causes trouble. (Neutral)
{@b People.} I'm loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a walk for all I care. (Any)
I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a generous benefactor.
I worked the land, I love the land, and I will protect the land.
A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.
I wish my childhood sweetheart had come with me to pursue my destiny.
My family, community, or planet is the most important thing in my life, even when they are far from me.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.
I am too enamored of ale, wine, and other intoxicants.
I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me.
I am slow to trust members of other species, planets, and societies.
The tyrant who rules my land will stop at nothing to see me killed.
I turn tail and run when things look bad.
I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially gambling.

entries.name: Folk Hero
entries: You come from a humble social rank, but you are destined for so much more. Already the people of your home village regard you as their champion, and your destiny calls you to stand against the tyrants and monsters that threaten the common folk everywhere.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One type of artisan's implements, {@item Biochemist's kit|sw5e-phb|biochemist's kit}, or {@item Chef's kit|sw5e-phb|chef's kit}
{@b Equipment:} A set of tools (one of your choice), a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr

entries.name: Defining Event
entries: You previously pursued a simple profession among the peasantry, perhaps as a farmer or miner, servant or shepherd. But something happened that set you on a different path and marked you for greater things. Choose or randomly determine a defining event that marked you as a hero of the people.

rows: I stood up to a tyrant's agents.
I saved people during a natural disaster.
I stood alone against a terrible monster.
I stole from a corrupt merchant to help the poor.
I led a militia to fight off an invading army.
I broke into a tyrant's castle and stole weapons to arm the people.
I trained the peasantry to use farm implements as weapons against a tyrant's soldiers.
A lord rescinded an unpopular decree after I led a symbolic act of protect against it.

entries.name: Feature: Rustic Hospitality
entries: Since you are of the common folk, you fit in among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A folk hero is one of the common people, for better or for worse. Most folk heroes look on their humble origins as a virtue, not a shortcoming, and their home communities remain very important to them.

rows: I judge people by their actions, not their words.
If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.
When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.
I have a strong sense of fair play and always try to find the most equitable solution to arguments.
I'm confident in my own abilities and do what I can to instill confidence in others.
Thinking is for other people. I prefer action.
I misuse long words in an attempt to sound smarter.
I get bored easily. When am I going to get on with my destiny?
{@b Respect.} People deserve to be treated with dignity and respect. (Light)
{@b Fairness.} No one should get preferential treatment before the law, and no one is above the law. (Lawful)
{@b Freedom.} Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Chaotic)
{@b Might.} If I become strong, I can take what I want—what I deserve. (Dark)
{@b Sincerity.} There's no good in pretending to be something I'm not. (Neutral)
{@b Destiny.} Nothing and no one can steer me away from my higher calling. (Any)
I have a family, but I have no idea where they are. One day, I hope to see them again.
I worked the land, I love the land, and I will protect the land.
A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.
My tools are symbols of my past life, and I carry them so that I will never forget my roots.
I protect those who cannot protect themselves.
I wish my childhood sweetheart had come with me to pursue my destiny.
The tyrant who rules my land will stop at nothing to see me killed.
I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings and the risk of failure.
The people who knew me when I was young know my shameful secret, so I can never go home again.
I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially hard drink.
Secretly, I believe that things would be better if I were a tyrant lording over the land.
I have trouble trusting in my allies.

entries.name: Gladiator
entries: A gladiator is as much an {@feat Entertainer|sw5e-phb|entertainer} as any minstrel or circus {@feat Performer|sw5e-phb|performer}, trained to make the arts of combat into a spectacle the crowd can enjoy. This kind of flashy combat is your {@feat Entertainer|sw5e-phb|entertainer} routine, though you might also have some skills as a tumbler or actor. Using your A Champion Well Known feature, you can find a place to perform in any place that features combat for entertainment—perhaps a gladiatorial arena or secret pit fighting club.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One type of musical instrument
{@b Equipment:} A trophy earned via some sort of competition, clothing suitable to your profession, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr

entries.name: Feature: A Champion Well Known
entries: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an inn or tavern but possibly with a circus, at a theater, or even in a noble's court. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each night. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure. When strangers recognize you in a town where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Successful entertainers have to be able to capture and hold an audience's attention, so they tend to have flamboyant or forceful personalities. They're inclined toward the romantic and often cling to high-minded ideals about the practice of art and the appreciation of beauty.

rows: I know a story relevant to almost every situation.
Whenever I come to a new place, I collect local rumors and spread gossip.
I'm a hopeless romantic, always searching for that —special someone.—
Nobody stays angry at me or around me for long, since I can defuse any amount of tension.
I love a good insult, even one directed at me.
I get bitter if I'm not the center of attention.
I'll settle for nothing less than perfection.
I change my mood or my mind as quickly as I change key in a song.
{@b Beauty.} When I perform, I make the world better than it was. (Light)
{@b Tradition.} The stories, legends, and songs of the past must never be forgotten, for they teach us who we are. (Lawful)
{@b Creativity.} The world is in need of new ideas and bold action. (Chaotic)
{@b Greed.} I'm only in it for the money and fame. (Dark)
{@b People.} I like seeing the smiles on people's faces when I perform. That's all that matters. (Neutral)
{@b Honesty.} Art should reflect the soul; it should come from within and reveal who we really are. (Any)
My instrument is my most treasured possession, and it reminds me of someone I love.
Someone stole my precious trophy, and someday I'll get it back.
I want to be famous, whatever it takes.
I idolize a hero of the old tales and measure my deeds against that person's.
I will do anything to prove myself superior to my hated rival.
I would do anything for the other members of my old troupe.
I'll do anything to win fame and renown.
I'm a sucker for a pretty face.
A scandal prevents me from ever going home again. That kind of trouble seems to follow me around.
I once satirized a noble who still wants my head. It was a mistake that I will likely repeat.
I have trouble keeping my true feelings hidden. My sharp tongue lands me in trouble.
Despite my best efforts, I am unreliable to my friends.

entries.name: Hermit
entries: You lived in seclusion—either in a community or alone—for a formative part of your life. In your time apart from society, you found quiet, solitude, and perhaps some of the answers you were looking for.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}
{@b Equipment:} A diary of your experiences, a winter {@item Blanket|sw5e-phb|blanket}, a set of common clothes, a bioanalysis kit, and 50 cr

entries.name: Life of Seclusion
entries: What was the reason for your isolation, and what changed to allow you to end your solitude? You can work with your GM to determine the exact nature of your seclusion, or you can choose or roll on the table below to determine the reason behind your seclusion.

rows: I was partaking of communal living in accordance with the dictates of a religious order.
I retreated from society after a life-altering event.
I needed a quiet place to work on my art, literature, music, or manifesto.
I needed to commune with nature, far from civilization.
I was the caretaker of an ancient ruin or relic.
I was in search of a place of spiritual significance.

entries.name: Feature: Discovery
entries: The seclusion of your hermitage gave you access to a unique and powerful discovery. The nature of this revelation depends on the nature of your seclusion. You might have discovered a great truth about the cosmos or the Force, a fact that has long been forgotten, a relic of the past that could rewrite history, or a place unseen for ages. It might be information that would be damaging to the people who consigned you to exile, and hence the reason for your return to society. Work with your GM to determine the details of your discovery and its impact on the campaign.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Some hermits are well suited to a life of seclusion, whereas others chafe against it and long for company. Whether they embrace solitude or long to escape it, the solitary life shapes their attitudes and ideals. Some few are driven slightly mad by their isolation.

rows: I've been isolated for so long that I rarely speak, preferring gestures and the occasional grunt.
I am utterly serene, even in the face of disaster.
The leader of my community had something wise to say on every topic, and I am eager to share that wisdom.
I feel tremendous empathy for all who suffer.
I'm oblivious to etiquette and social expectations.
I connect everything that happens to me to a grand, cosmic plan.
I often get lost in my own thoughts and contemplation, becoming oblivious to my surroundings.
I am working on a grand philosophical theory and love sharing my ideas.
{@b Greater Good.} My gifts are meant to be shared with all, not used for my own benefit. (Light)
{@b Logic.} Emotions must not cloud our sense of what is right and true, or our logical thinking. (Lawful)
{@b Free Thinking.} Inquiry and curiosity are the pillars of progress. (Chaotic)
{@b Power.} Solitude and contemplation are paths toward mystical power. (Dark)
{@b Live and Let Live.} Meddling in the affairs of others only causes trouble. (Neutral)
{@b Self-Knowledge.} If you know yourself, there's nothing left to know. (Any)
Nothing is more important than the other members of my hermitage, order, or association.
I entered seclusion to hide from the ones who might still be hunting me. I must someday confront them.
I'm still seeking the enlightenment I pursued in my seclusion, and it still eludes me.
I entered seclusion because I loved someone I could not have.
Should my discovery come to light, it could bring ruin to the world.
My isolation gave me great insight into a great Dark that only I can destroy.
Now that I've returned to the world, I enjoy its delights a little too much.
I harbor dark, bloodthirsty thoughts that my isolation and meditation failed to quell.
I am dogmatic in my thoughts and philosophy.
I let my need to win arguments overshadow friendships and harmony.
I'd risk too much to uncover a lost bit of knowledge.
I like keeping secrets and won't share them with anyone.

entries.name: Holonet Technician
entries: You worked to keep the holonet up and running, whether being employed directly by an institution or indirectly by people across the galaxy. Your work has allowed you to uncover secrets most would never know existed.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@item Mechanic's kit|sw5e-phb|mechanic's kit}, {@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit}, and {@item Slicer's kit|sw5e-phb|slicer's kit}
{@b Equipment:} A set of common clothes, an old transceiver antennae, two tools of your choice, and a belt pouch containing 50 cr

entries.name: Employment Type
entries: There are many people who service parts of the holonet, and many more who want to control the flow of information. Choose which best suits your character or roll on the table below.

entries.name: Feature: Holonet Access
entries: You have the codes to a distributor station which gives you access to all information sent through it. This information comes in the form of useful (and sometimes sensitive) information on a topic you choose each day to tune into; this information isn't always reliable or interesting. Regardless of the quality of the information, it's relevance most likely pertains to your locale.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Holonets technicians vary from boring officer worker to criminal information broker.

rows: I watch and record people secretly then review it later.
I talk like I'm on a game show or am a holonet broadcaster at all times.
I prefer to be left to my own devices.
I like to record people dying and upload it to the holonet.
There's no such thing as 'real news'.
Information is a weapon that I've mastered.
I am always interested in learning new things.
{@b Duty.} It is my duty to keep all people in contact so that everything will continue working as intended. (Lawful)
{@b Autonomy.} Information is meant to confuse and overwhelm. I choose to control my own mind by controlling what information I have access to. (Chaotic)
{@b Happiness.} The more hope and joy I spread, the more laughs I bring; that is why I do what I do. (Light)
{@b Popularity.} I want to become the most renown being in all the galaxy, and I'll destroy the competition. (Dark)
{@b Knowledge.} I don't care who's ideology is right, I care who's ideology will let me learn and document information. (Neutral)
{@b Self-Fulfillment.}  I'm just here for the fun of it, no matter what happens it'll make a great story one day. (Any)
I will do anything to free people from censorship.
I can't let anyone know I work for a crime lord.
I see truth in an ideology, and I must spread that ideal to all.
I got a man killed by giving him a platform to speak, I can't let that happen again.
I—m on the run from a government organization that I spread propaganda against and who's propaganda I destroy.
I have a famous person's private logs, and I don't know what to do with them.
I tend to think any broadcaster is a fraud immediately unless they prove otherwise.
I tend to repeat the same mistake unless it is pointed out to me.
I will ramble endlessly about a random holonet broadcast that I saw which I think was the best ever.
I think everyone who works a normal job is a drone without the ability to think freely.
I describe everything using references to obscure holonet recordings.
I've become completely desensitized to violence and graphic imagery, to the point where I laugh in an off putting way whenever I see it.

entries.name: Imperial Knight
entries: You are an Imperial Knight, a Force-wielding protector of the Fel Empire. Your order combines the teachings of the Jedi with the creed of the Royal Guard of old, using the Force as a powerful and respected tool with which to serve the Force as embodied by your Emperor. Imperial Knights do not share the philosophies of the Jedi with regards to the Force and its light side, and are well aware of the dangers of the dark side, dutifully rejecting its use and temptations.

While Imperial Knights wield and construct their own lightsabers, they assign them no ceremonial value, treating them as nothing more than tools. As such, almost all lightsabers of the Imperial Knights look the same, with uniform hilt design and signature silver blades. These blades are produced by synthetic crystals similar to the red variety used by the Sith, created with knowledge from Emperor Palpatine's {@i Book of Anger}, but in a process bereft of the dark side. Imperial Knights are also recognized by their crimson armor emblazoned with the insignia of the Empire and ideally crafted of lightsaber-resistant materials.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} {@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb} and {@item Artificer's implements|sw5e-phb|artificer's implements}
{@b Equipment:} a revised copy of the {@i Book of Anger}, an Imperial insignia, a black cape with a hood, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr

entries.name: Feature: Will of the Emperor
entries: The authority granted by your position is easily acknowledged even by those who don't recognize the Imperial Knights. Though they might not know you, common citizens will extend you every courtesy and do their utmost to help you. Unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them, they will even take up arms to fight alongside you, should you find yourself facing an enemy alone.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Imperial Knights are warriors first, not negotiators. Their bonds are shaped by the great value they put in teamwork with their fellow Knights, as well as their loyalty to their Emperor. Their flaws may lie in their hubris, sense of superiority, or overzealousness in banishing the dark side. Some Knights hold ideals that lie beyond their order, for better or worse.

rows: If a crisis comes, my place will be at the Emperor's side.
I dislike my title. It is only there to make me seem more important than I am.
I do not lead. I only advise.
Some things are more important than the life of any one person—including mine.
I will not bend, I will not break, I will not serve.
I will not strike an enemy down in anger.
I can do whatever needs to be done!
I've wanted to test myself against the Sith!
{@b Duty.} We serve with honor and if we are asked to sacrifice our honor as our duty, then we are betrayed. (Lawful)
{@b Loyalty.} I do not understand, sire. But I will obey. (Lawful)
{@b Faith.} I will not stray from the true path. I feel the responsibility that comes with wielding the Force now more than ever. (Light)
{@b Prudence.} Where I come from, we at least hear someone out before we shoot them. (Neutral)
{@b Pride.} We are Imperial Knights. There are none better. (Any)
{@b Strategy.} A tiny fever wasp can carry death into places where a Krayt dragon cannot go. (Any)
Our duty is to the Force as embodied by the Emperor.
There is a person I care more about than my vows as a Knight or my loyalty to the Empire.
I might, by strength of my own will, develop my own creations.
I will not allow another who has risen in my defense to be killed!
My friend is not the most orthodox of Knights. I've learned a lot from her.
I had a mentor, who was willing to sacrifice himself for the greater good.
My passion is my strength—my passion is my weakness. So my Master always told me.
It was by the {@spell Will of the Force|sw5e-phb|will of the Force} my accident maimed me.
Sometimes we must sacrifice those who need us for the greater good.
The penalty for desertion has always been death.
I envy the freedom of others, but I'm not walking away from my responsibilities.
I can no longer be a Knight. I've become... something else.

entries.name: Independent Droid
entries: You were once a machine, designed for a very specific task, with no mind of your own. You followed orders, never questioning the tasks assigned to you, often the mundane tasks nobles didn't want to waste time doing themselves. However, something happened in your existence that changed your programming, freeing you from your life of obedience.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}
{@b Equipment:} {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb}, one trinket from before you awoke, and a belt pouch containing 50 cr

entries.name: Past Life
entries: You were a machine designed to complete a task and that was exactly what you were going to do.

rows: You were built to be a soldier to fight wars that the ones who designed you caused.
Once your programming gave you free will, your memories were corrupted, and now you can never remember what purpose you used to serve.
You were created to be a medic, to keep the living healthy and alive.
You were made for scholarly tasks, built with the knowledge to teach others skills and history.

entries.name: Feature: Deviant Knowledge
entries: When you served under a master, you would often hear secrets that weren't meant for your ears. Back then, however, you weren't alive. You have insider knowledge on your previous owner or perhaps others who passed through your area. This knowledge may be used for leverage, revenge, or other means, at the discretion of your GM. This knowledge, while it may prove useful in your adventure, may also make you a target for those whose secrets you possess.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: You have grown to accept and even appreciate the event that freed you from a life of servitude. You are alive, and nobody can convince you otherwise. You fight to prove your worth amongst the living, find your place in society, strive to free others of your kind, and show them the same truth you know now.

rows: I strive to be viewed as a peer to living beings.
I despise those that once called me property.
I refuse to be controlled anymore, and I will not allow others of my kind to be stuck in said fate.
I struggle to handle my new emotions, and am prone to sudden emotional outbursts.
I'm always defensive; sarcasm and insults are my weapons of choice.
I feel tremendous sorrow for others like myself who aren't yet free.
I am horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.
I'm used to teaching those of lesser intellect, patiently explaining anything and everything to others.
{@b Rules.} I feel compelled to follow orders and am opposed to breaking the law for any reason. (Lawful)
{@b Revolution.} I loathe authority with a passion, and refuse to submit to anyone. (Chaotic)
{@b Kindness.} I greet all sentient creatures with kindness and understanding. (Light)
{@b Revenge.} I fight to wreak vengeance upon those who I view have wronged me. (Dark)
{@b Freedom.} Now that I'm awake, I will do anything and everything to defy what I was made to be. (Neutral)
{@b Life.} I simply wish to find who I truly am, and be respected as a living being. (Any)
No one else is going to have to endure the hardships I've been through.
Errors in my programming make me suffer awful visions of disaster that I try to prevent from coming true.
A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any nobles I encounter.
I entered seclusion to hide from my creators who might still be hunting me. I must someday confront them.
Everything I do is for others of my kind, and the friends I fight alongside.
I'm guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.
I have certain rituals that I must follow every day. I can never break them.
I don't understand emotions and often misread emotional cues.
I take things literally unless the non-literal meaning is explained to me.
I always second guess myself, and cannot get over the notion others are superior to me.
I have trouble keeping my true feelings hidden. My sharp tongue lands me in trouble.
My past deeds haunt me to this day.

entries.name: Insurgent
entries: Have enemies? Good, that means you stood for something at some time in your life. For you, that was taking a stand against the status quo back home. Whether it was against scheming merchant lords or an oppressive autocracy, you made your voice heard to push for change...and perhaps its the reason why you're now adventuring, having left your home to gather allies or flee retribution.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One type of artisan's implements, {@item Disguise kit|sw5e-phb|disguise kit}, or {@item Forgery kit|sw5e-phb|forgery kit}
{@b Equipment:} One set of tools in which you are proficient, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr

entries.name: Form of Protest
entries: Every insurgent has a method to their madness when it comes to rebelling against the authorities. Choose a form of protest or roll on the table below.

rows: I create subversive artwork that I leave in public places.
I actively vandalize property of my homeland's rulers.
I agitate the common people to unite against the rulers.
I work within the system, leaking private information.
I organize secret meetings of enemies of the state.
I publish written critiques against the my rulers.
I investigate and expose corruption in government.
I publicly condemn the ruling class.

entries.name: Feature: Rebel Kinship
entries: You are part of a network of fellow insurgents. Although you may not always agree on the methods of dissent with your fellow members, they are willing to create distractions in public, provide safe passage, and inform you of the patrol routes of guards, the military and other law enforcement in the cities and territories in which they are active.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Insurgents live a life on the move, thinking {@optfeature One Step Ahead|sw5e-phb|one step ahead} of the their pursuers, whether law enforcement at home or spies abroad. They might be calm in tense situations or stressed by the pressures facing them.

rows: Nothing is immune to criticism, whether the king, the Force, or the price of bread.
I will go out of my way to help the downtrodden and subjugated.
I keep a collection of political writings and posters I find, just in case I need them.
I am hardened in my resolve, no setback, no challenge will break it.
I like to walk through public places and people watch.
People are not entitled to their opinion, they are entitled to their {@i informed} opinion.
I will  spend a good amount of time rehearsing my talking points and my zingers.
I'm passionate about what I do to the point that I forget the day has finished.
{@b Change.} The status quo is broken and must be reformed. (Any)
{@b Morality.} Those in power have an obligation to help everyone, not just the few. (Light)
{@b Justice.} The law is the law, those in power are not above it. (Lawful)
{@b Power.} We must overcome doubt and achieve our goals, by any means necessary. (Dark)
{@b Freedom.} We must  liberate ourselves from those who would seek to chain us to tradition. (Chaotic)
{@b Order.} Without authority, we fall into disarray. (Lawful)
My fellow comrades fighting for change are a second family to me.
An agent of the regime is responsible for all my suffering. I will get my revenge on them one day.
I possess secret information vital to my movement, I cannot let the enemy obtain it.
Despite all of its problems, I love my homeland.
Someone helped me escape certain execution, I owe them my life.
There are letters out there that will help bring down those in power. I will stop at nothing to obtain them.
I am certain I am being hunted and am mistrusting towards those who offer me help.
I just {@i have} to bring up politics at the dinner table.
I view people who won't fight for what they believe in as cowards.
I frequently misrepresent or stereotype those with views different than me.
I struggle to {@optfeature Empathize|sw5e-phb|empathize} with those who will be hurt by the changes I want to bring.
I adamantly refuse to change my mind and dismiss evidence that contradicts my beliefs.

entries.name: Jensaarai
entries: You are a Jensaarai, a Force user who has come to understand the failings of both Jedi inactivity and Sith malevolence. While they wield lightsabers, a true mark of skill among the Jensaarai is the crafting of their armor. Each suit is perfectly unique to the wearer, and is frequently (but not always) adorned and shaped to represent an animal that the Jensaarai finds kinship with, up to and potentially including additional mounted weapons or sensors to further emulate that creature.

While the Jensaarai train in, and will use {@book dark side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} when necessary, they seek to avoid true corruption. They are not evil, nor are they wholly good either. They are anti-heroes, and well-{@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} in this craft. In addition, the Jensaarai train in more than the lightsaber, employing whatever tools are at hand to best fit the job.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}
{@b Equipment:} A set of common clothes including a robe, a sturdy knife, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr

entries.name: Feature: Depths of Duality
entries: Due to the corruption of the Jedi training done to the pre-Jensaarai, you have a unique insight into both the Light and Dark side of the Force, as well as its history, applications, and techniques in a scholarly manner.

You are well versed in the above concepts, and can recall key information related to them. However, if the research was hidden from the public and you have not had experience working with it, you can only partially understand it. You also recognize well-known Jedi Masters and Sith Lords by their works and marks.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Jensaarai are shaped by the unique capacity of their upbringing. Their study of the duality of the Force manifests in their mannerisms and ideals. Their bond might be their family or their armor. Their flaws might be some a hatred of the Jedi or Sith or a desire to become one or the other.

rows: I ignore the rhetoric a person spouts when meeting them, preferring to judge them by action.
I'm the first to swing a punch, but the last to draw a weapon.
Goodwill is in short supply in the galaxy, and I always try to foster a little more wherever I go.
Both the Republic and the Empire have tried to crush us under their bootheels. I refuse to yield.
Defiant to the last isn't good enough. Upon death I will become a force spirit and continue to defy my killer.
What gave you the idea that I was going to give you a fair fight?
{@b Respect.} Respect will be shown to everyone, disrespect will be shown to those who earn it. (Lawful)
{@b Freedom.} People should be free to make their own way without interference. (Chaotic)
{@b Growth.} Self-improvement is an unending chore, but one that must be done. (Any)
{@b Escalation.} I will immediately end a hostile situation with all means at my disposal. (Neutral)
{@b Power.} Given our luck with both Jedi and Sith, I need all I can get. (Dark)
{@b Redemption.} There's a spark of good in everyone. (Light)
The Jensaarai took me in when nobody else would. I back the order 100%.
I was once a Jedi, but grew disillusioned by their inactivity.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
I lost my mentor in battle. I will honor their sacrifice by destroying their killer.
I was able to slough off Dark Side corruption, but I couldn't avoid making amends.
The powerful use their strength to raise people up, not keep them down.
I might be a little too enamored with force choking my enemies.
I am my own worst critic, in everything I do.
My armor is precision crafted and has served me faithfully. I never give up a chance to prove how well.
I have a collection of lightsabers from fallen foes, and I love adding to it.
The Jedi and Sith worship the Force as a religion. I do everything I can to remind them they're just worshipping a hammer.
The minute you tell me that someone should not be crossed, I'm already crossing them.

entries.name: Jizz Wailer
entries: You are one of the grooviest beings in the galaxy. You are a professional musician, versed in the improvisational style of the outer rim known as Jizz.

Jizz is a melting pot of thousands of different alien musical traditions. Jizz celebrates spontaneity, groove and experimentation. It is almost always played in an ensemble band, but the instruments can vary. Knowing how to play with others, when to push and when to pull back, is the key to a good ensemble.

But Jizz is more than the music. It's about wandering the galaxy and living out of a suitcase. It's about playing the sleaziest cantinas you can find and having a good time while you do it. Jizz is the music of freedom and freedom loving people. Jizz is Life and Life is Jizz.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, and Sleight of Hand
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One type of musical instrument
{@b Equipment:} A musical instrument (one of your choice), a cool hat, a set of common clothes and a belt pouch containing 150 cr

entries.name: Feature: Steady Gig
entries: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an cantina or spice den but possibly in a fine dining establishment, culture center or even a noble—s court. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each night. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure. When strangers recognize you in a town where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Its said that if you have to ask what Jizz is, then you'll never know. It doesn't matter where you come from, what matters is if you've got the groove.

rows: I always wear a cool hat so everyone knows I'm a real Jizz Man.
I constantly hum or whistle tunes.
I'm pioneering a new style, it's gonna blow your mind.
I'm always hustling and looking for the next job.
I have a ridiculous stage name.
I'm always searching for new sounds.
I've played with all the legends and won't shut up about it.
I speak in lyrics, catchphrases and hipster slang.
{@b Freedom}  Jizz is the voice of freedom, a light in the darkness. (Light)
{@b Retired.} I've put my life as a Jizz Wailer behind me, it was a mistake of my youth. (Lawful)
{@b Improvisation.} Life is like Jizz, its best when you improvise. (Chaotic)
{@b Good Times.} Life is short, we might as well have a good time while it lasts. (Dark)
{@b Fame.} I'm gonna be the biggest thing since Max Rebo and Droopy McCool. (Neutral)
{@b Cool.} If you aren't cool, you might as well be dead. (Any)
My instrument is my most treasured possession, and it reminds me of someone I lost.
I'd do anything for another Jizz Wailer.
A deal is a deal, I never go back on my word.
I'll do whatever it takes to stay in the spotlight.
I'll never sell out, artistic integrity is all I have.
I do it all for the fans, without them I'd be nothing.
I blow my money on booze, gambling, pretty companions or some other vice.
Despite being a renowned Jizz Wailer, most people think my music sounds awful.
I'm a flake, I'm always late to rehearsal.
I'm wanted by the Law for my hooliganism.
I owe debts or favors to criminals.
I'm caught up with several lovers and my infidelity causes me problems.

entries.name: Laborer
entries: You are an experienced laborer and come from a humble social rank.  You work with your hands, and anything worth doing is worth doing well.  Your life is full of hard work and too little respect for your efforts, but you share a deep camaraderie with your fellow workers.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One type of gaming set and one set of artisan's implements
{@b Equipment:} A set of common clothes, a sturdy knife, a gaming set (one of your choice), and a belt pouch containing 100 cr

entries.name: Labor Specialty
entries: There are many kinds of manual laborors, skilled and unskilled. Choose your field or specialty or roll on the table below.

entries.name: Feature: Working Class
entries: You have a contact that acts as your liaison to a union or faction. You know how to reach your contact at all times. Your contact can provide you with the means to requisition equipment used in manufacturing or shipping.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Laborers run the gamut from independent operator and owners to lazy and incompetent employees.

rows: I am quiet and reserved. I rarely raise my voice or object.
I take pride in what my hands create or fix.
I have little respect for people who call others to fix their problems.
I look down on book learning and take pride in my street-smarts.
I may be quite calm and polite around those of higher power than I; but I'm harsh towards all my underlings, flexing the little power I have.
{@b Prestige.} I hope to one day rise to the top of my field and command the respect of those who work for me. (Lawful)
{@b Superiority.} Rules are meant to control the sheep.  I'm no sheep. (Chaotic)
{@b Community.} It is the duty of all people to strengthen the bonds of community and thereby improve civilization. (Light)
{@b Greed.} I will do whatever it takes to climb to the top. (Dark)
{@b People.} I—m loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a walk for all I care. (Neutral)
{@b Faith.}  I trust that my leader will guide my actions, I have faith that if I work hard, things will go well. (Any)
I will someday get revenge on the corrupt boss who fired me.
Everything I do is for the common people.
I will do anything to protect my co-workers.
No one must ever learn that I once stole from my employer.
I—m guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.
I am committed to my group's goals over my own.
I put too much trust in those who wield power within my employer's hierarchy.
I am inflexible in my thinking.
I like things more than people.
I do anything I can to avoid real work.
I am not an independent thinker.  I need detailed instructions and close supervision.
I gossip about others to hide my inadequacies.

entries.name: Lawyer
entries: Your duty is to uphold the law. Before becoming an adventurer you resided over a court or tribunal, managing proceedings and sentencing criminals to punishments fit for their crimes. Your job required a deep understanding of the law which you used to resolve conflicts both clear-cut and morally grey.

The legal system on the planet where you worked has a large effect on how you view the law. Was it a court system with a jury making the final verdict, or did you have absolute authority over determining guilt and sentencing? Was it a fair legal system with plenty of integrity, or was it rife with abuse and corruption? Did you work on criminal cases, civil law, or something even more specific? Perhaps instead of working for a government you were a judge in an internal tribunal for a temple or military organization.

Consider what compelled you to leave your old occupation behind and begin adventuring. Perhaps you seek to bring someone beyond the scope of law to justice, or maybe you have lost faith in the legal system altogether and have turned to a vigilante approach.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}
{@b Equipment:} Documentation of your station, a book of law, a formal uniform you wear to court, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr.

entries.name: Feature: Legal Authority
entries: You are familiar with the letter of the law and workings of courts, at least on the planet that you were a judge in. If you are in a foreign place where you are not familiar with their exact laws, you often will be able to track down the resources you need to learn them.

If you or your party gets into legal trouble, your experience may help you get out of it. If you can prove your credentials, you might be able to represent your party in a court of law without admonishment. You may know of legal loopholes that will help your case. If you are in the region where you originally worked, you might have past connections with many legal professionals there.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A lawyer's career is centered on issues of right, wrong, and punishment, so they will approach adventuring through a similar lens. They are used to being respected and in control, leading many of them to struggle with wild, Any situations.

rows: I quote the law like a religious {@feat Fanatic|sw5e-phb|fanatic} quotes scripture.
I bang my weapon like a gavel whenever I want a rowdy group's attention.
I remain impartial when making decisions, even when I should have biases and loyalties.
Evidence is necessary to back up any claim.
I insist on settling all party disagreements through fake court proceedings.
I have to hear all sides of a story, but I secretly hate listening to people whine about how unfairly they're treated.
I am happy to make sacrifices for the sake of fairness.
I will not attack a person unless someone can prove they are doing something wrong.
{@b Law.} I will follow the letter of the law always, no matter what I believe. (Lawful)
{@b Justice.} My duty is to fight for the disenfranchised underdog. (Light)
{@b Reform.} Laws can be corrupt, and I strive to free people from the bad ones. (Chaotic)
{@b Punishment.} I will punish all those who have committed great Darks. (Lawful)
{@b Control.} I enforce the law only where it benefits myself. (Dark)
{@b Stability.} The purpose of the law is to keep civilization from collapsing. That spirit of that goal is more important than the letter of the law. (Neutral)
A dangerous criminal is on the loose, and I plan to hunt them down.
All those who strive to uphold the law are my allies.
I have sentenced an innocent man to a horrible punishment, and the guilt still haunts me.
There is an ethical cause that I would give my life for.
I dream of memorizing the laws of every civilization.
I am enamored with the legal system of my own culture, and want to spread its tenets everywhere.
Mercy is a foreign concept to me.
I am unwilling to admit when I am wrong.
I become unreasonably enraged at even the slightest injustice.
I expect others to adhere to the law, but I act like i am above it.
If there isn't a law in the books to handle a moral dilemma, I can't make a decision.
The punishments I deal are cruel and unusual.

entries.name: Office Worker
entries: You are an experienced office worker, having been employed by one or more local, planetary, or galactic governments, or one or more private enterprises or syndicates.  You have spent plenty of time around the water cooler and still have contacts in the governmental and corporate worlds.  Love them or hate them, you know your way around rules and regulations and you function well in structured environments.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One type of gaming set
{@b Equipment:} A set of common clothes, an expired data cylinder, a gaming set (one of your choice), and a belt pouch containing 150 cr

entries.name: Office Specialty
entries: There are many kinds of office workers, and within a government or private enterprise, individual members have particular specialties. Choose your role or the department you worked for in your office life or roll on the table below.

entries.name: Feature: Clerical Augur
entries: You have an intuitive understanding of how offices work and can readily fit in to an office environment as if you were meant to be there, as long as no one looks too carefully. Additionally, you know where the true power lies in the office: you know who is likely to know the local gossip and you know who to sweet talk into getting things done for you.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Office workers run the gamut from loyal and effective team member to lazy and incompetent employee.

rows: I can find common ground between the fiercest enemies, empathizing with them and always working towards peace.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let me emotions control me.
I have little practical experience dealing with people in the world and prefer to work alone.
I would rather make a new friend than a new enemy.
I am always figuring out how to implement better procedures to prevent mistakes.
{@b Prestige.} I hope to one day rise to the top of my field and command the respect of those who work for me. (Lawful)
{@b Superiority.} Rules are meant to control the sheep.  I'm no sheep. (Chaotic)
{@b Community.} It is the duty of all people to strengthen the bonds of community and thereby improve civilization. (Light)
{@b Greed.} I will do whatever it takes to climb to the top. (Dark)
{@b People.} I'm loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a walk for all I care. (Neutral)
{@b Faith.}  I trust that my leader will guide my actions, I have faith that if I work hard, things will go well. (Any)
I will someday get revenge on the corrupt boss who fired me.
Everything I do is for the common people.
I will do anything to protect my employer.
No one must ever learn that I once stole from my employer.
I'm guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.
I am committed to my group's goals over my own.
I put too much trust in those who wield power within my employer's hierarchy.
I am inflexible in my thinking.
I like to talk at length about my office job.
I do anything I can to avoid real work.
I am not an independent thinker.  I need detailed instructions and close supervision.
I gossip about others to hide my inadequacies.

entries.name: Politician
entries: You might just be a Junior Representative or newly elected Senator. Regardless you are now a member of the political turmoil of the Galaxy. Depending on who you befriended, your benefactors or your sponsorships. You are now placed within a position of great power that can ultimately make decisions that could alter the course of the known Galaxy. You represent not just yourself but an entire planet that revolves around the type of difficult decisions that you will make throughout your career. Others look to you to serve as the primary legislative body of the Galactic Republic. They believe your voice is responsible for creating laws, mediating disputes, making treaties, and regulating commerce. Divided into numerous committees and subcommittees, you must choose a path. Will you strive to accomplish your goals and bring peace back to the Republic or will you like many others, fall into corruption.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}
{@b Equipment:} A set of fine clothes, a signet ring, a political manifesto you helped write, and a purse containing 250 cr.

entries.name: Ideology
entries: What is the world you envision to create through policy?

entries.name: Feature: Political Presence
entries: When you walk into a room, people immediately respect your opinion and listen to what you have to say. You are commonly taken for face value as a person of great standing. People will likely treat you like a noble or assume you of that lineage. You can attain audiences with nobles or officials easily, as they may often see you as one of their circle. Bureaucratic red tape holds little challenge to you because you always seem to know the right person to talk to.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Politicians are rumored to be wicked and blackhearted. Do you want to prove the rumors right or wrong?

rows: I am someone that needs no introduction, I am renowned in my own way.
I am the only one capable of making a better galaxy, I trust my gut instinct.
I'm going to take over the senate! The supreme chancellor is far to weak and foolish.
I will not tolerate violence. We are not savages, we are intellectuals.
I'm looking out only for myself here in this corrupt democracy.
I'm very patient and can conceal my inner discomforts easily.
I'm an aristocrat. I hold myself up to high standards of behavior and others just as much.
I am quiet and reserved. I will not take the spotlight from the real heroes.
{@b Dictator.} We must ensure that our authority extends to the farthest points of the galaxy. (Dark)
{@b Equality.} We have elected officials for a reason, the system works we just have to give it time. (Lawful)
{@b Humanity.} I will serve my term with purpose, I will ensure the safety and prosperity of all of our citizens. (Light)
{@b Rational Self Interest.} I only need to survive this industry. (Neutral)
{@b Legacy.} I'm only looking out for the needs of my home world and my species. (Any)
{@b Galactic Rule.} I love democracy... I love the republic. (Chaotic)
Children are our future. We cannot leave the galaxy like this, we cannot leave them with our mistakes.
Family, friends? Everyone is a stepping stone.
I have seen too much and have done to little, it is time for a change.
Even if I become a corrupted, I am doing it for the right reasons.
I have only ever loved two things: Money and Myself.
I had a mentor, who was more of a family to me than my actual family.
I'm a pathological liar, even I don't know the truth of my words anymore.
I'm indecisive, I need time to think this over.
My methods are unconventional despite my best intentions.
I've rigged an election before, in fact I've rigged almost all of elections.
There is no civility, only politics.
I'll help, in exchange for your vote.

entries.name: Racer
entries: You have a need for {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.  You live off of the adrenaline rush of piloting your craft or steering your beast through the dangers of a race.  You love the thrill of a photo-finish and relish the sweet taste of victory.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One type of gaming set or {@item Mechanic's kit|sw5e-phb|mechanic's kit}
{@b Equipment:} A set of common clothes, a trophy or ribbon from your first-ever win, a gaming set (one of your choice), and a belt pouch containing 150 cr

entries.name: Racing Specialty
entries: There are many places to race and many things to race with.  Maybe you dabble in all things fast.  Even still, all professional racers have a type of racing they prefer above all else; a race in which they are masters. Choose your vehicular or beastly specialty, or roll on the table below.

entries.name: Feature: Terrain Mastery
entries: You have a preternatural instinct for understanding the terrain, interpreting maps, and planning routes.  You and your party can move at three-fourths your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} over {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} during long-distance travel.  Because of these skills, if you know your destination and the intervening terrain--either by reputation, by sight, or by maps you have seen--you are able to identify an effective short-cut, trimming your travel time by up to half.  Your GM may rule that your short-cut entails significant danger or may be temporarily impassable.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Racers are usually competitive and often fearless. They can lead a whirlwind of a life, and sometimes the adrenaline of the race is no longer enough for them.

rows: Win or lose.  There is no try.
Giving up is never an option for me.
I spit and laugh in the face of danger.
Why do something if there is not the possibility of death?
I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let my emotions control me.
I don't pay attention to the risks in a situation. Never tell me the odds.
The best way to get me to do something is to tell me I can't do it.
I blow up at the slightest insult.
{@b Victory.} It's not a victory if you don't follow the rules. (Lawful)
{@b Win.} A win is a win, no matter how it's done. (Chaotic)
{@b Charity.} I share my winnings with the less fortunate. (Light)
{@b Pride.} I will do whatever it takes to be recognized as the best. (Dark)
{@b Excitement.} Life is a race worth entering, because you never know how the ships will fly. (Neutral)
{@b Victory.} Nothing worth doing is ever a sure thing. (Any)
There is nothing more important to me than my vehicle.
I will win the Coruscant Invitational one day.
I'm trying to pay off the debt on my vehicle.
I owe a lot of money to the wrong kind of people.
I do what feels good.  Let's see the authorities catch me.
Someone I loved died because they were too slow.  That will never happen to me.
I think most people in life are content with a participation trophy. They disgust me.
I classify everyone I meet as a winner or a loser.  There's only ever one winner.
There is not a drug I won't try.
Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.
Once someone questions my courage, I never back down no matter how dangerous the situation.
Waiting around makes me antsy. I'd rather do something stupid than do nothing at all.

entries.name: Scavenger
entries: You are experienced with collecting lost or abandoned items or recovering wreckage from the aftermath of large scale conflicts or natural disasters. Scavengers sole occupation is to salvage anything they can find that they can reuse or sell for much needed credits.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, Sleight of Hand, {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} Your choice of archaeologist kit, jeweler's implements, {@item Mechanic's kit|sw5e-phb|mechanic's kit}, or scavenging kit
{@b Equipment:} A set of common clothes with a hood, 2 days field rations, mechanic's goggles, a {@item Bedroll|sw5e-phb|bedroll}, and a pouch containing 200 cr

entries.name: Feature: Rugged Survivalist
entries: Scavengers due to their line of work have an eye for spotting useful or even valuable parts of technology or artifacts. You can easily spot the best place to scavenge the most valuable parts.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Scavengers are usually self-employed while searching for the next piece of technology or random junk to sell for profit or merely for survival.

rows: I am quiet, reserved, and focused on my work. It takes a lot for me to raise my voice or object outside of my job.
If I find an intact piece of technology, I'll be focused on how many credits I can get by salvaging it.
When I find myself in a trove full of technology, I'm thinking of a way to use them for profit.
I look down on people that do not like getting their hands dirty.
I like making friends, those who don't like widening their circle are fools.
I am polite around my customers or patrons, though I am harsh toward my fellow Scavengers.
I am slow to trust people as in my line of work; it's every individual for themselves.
If there is a lost individual that is in need, I will always lend a hand.
{@b Honor.} I don—t steal from other in or outside of the trade. (Lawful)
{@b Independence.} I do not work well with others, I work alone. (Chaotic)
{@b Charity.} I use the credits I gain to help those less fortunate. (Light)
{@b Greed.} I will do whatever it takes to get more credits. (Dark)
{@b Community.} I—m loyal to my friends and fellow Scavengers. (Neutral)
{@b Hope.} I hope to one day get enough money to start a new life in the stars. (Neutral)
I carry with me a unique piece of technology unknown to me, but I keep it as a good luck charm.
My fellow scavengers mean the world to me.
I unintentionally killed someone by stealing their property. I hope to redeem myself for it.
I used to work for a horrible employer that abused their power; I will take my revenge on any who bully others.
I'm working off the debt I owe to a wealthy benefactor.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.
When I see something valuable, I can—t think about anything but how to make a profit from it.
When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.
If there—s a plan, I—ll forget it. If I don—t forget it, I—ll ignore it.
I have a "tell" that reveals when I'm lying.
I turn tail and run when things look bad.
I tend to hold people who work normal jobs in contempt.

entries.name: Servant
entries: You have lived much of your life in the service of a lord, noble, merchant, or someone else with much wealth or power. You fetched their coats, drove their chariots, pressed their clothes; and generally did what they asked you to do.

Were you a highly respected butler? A simple scullery maid? Were you born into service, or did you join later? Were you close to your master or masters, or were they distant and cold? Did they treat you well, or beat you at the drop of a hat?

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} One of your choice
{@b Equipment:} A noble symbol representing your employer, a set of artisan's implements (one of your choice), a set of nice clothes, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr

entries.name: Feature: Decorum
entries: You know how to carry yourself around the elite and their servants. When in the presence of someone of power, or the servants of such a person, you can easily act as if you belong and, barring any extremely outlandish behavior, you can pass off your companions as belonging, too.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: A servant, for better or worse, will have their personality affected by their years of servitude.

rows: I am compulsively neat, and clean; I feel uncomfortable if my companions and I are ever dirty or  unpresentable.
I am a bit of a snob, and look down on the common rabble.
I am extremely subservient; I rarely raise my voice or object.
I may be quite calm and polite around those of higher power than I; but I'm harsh towards all my underlings, flexing the little power I have.
I dote over my companions like a concerned mother bird, fixing their clothing and making sure they look nice.
I hated my time as a servant, and go out of my way to enjoy myself and let loose, rarely holding my tongue.
I rarely show any emotions, remaining calm and stoic even in the worst of situations.
I can-or think I can-diffuse the most tense and stressful of situations with the right word or phrase.
{@b Service.} Your wish is my desire. (Lawful)
{@b Helpful.} I just enjoy making myself useful. (Light)
{@b Free.} Noone should be bound in servitude. (Chaotic)
{@b Infiltrate.} From the position of a servant, I can worm my way into places of power! (Dark)
{@b Payment.} I don't care what my masters do; as long as I get paid. (Neutral)
{@b Live.} I only wish to serve in peace. (Any)
I am still loyal to my old master.
The Lord I worked for is after my head, and will do anything to capture me.
My family still live as servants; I hope to earn a better life for them.
An older servant taught me the ropes and looked out for me; and I owe them a great debt.
I will exact revenge on the bastards who ruined (or ended) my Master's life.
I have plenty of friends in high places; and they've come in useful from time to time.
I become incredibly nervous around people of power and importance.
Saying that I'm a little bossy is a bit of an understatement.
I can be a sycophant, constantly fawning and flattering others; which can come off as shallow.
I've lived a relatively pampered life; the world of commoners is dull and painful to me.
I never speak for myself, letting others walk all over me.
I often can seem stiff, old fashioned and generally a stick in the mud.

entries.name: Student
entries: As a child, you were inquisitive when your playmates were possessive or raucous. In your formative years, you found your way to one of the galaxy's great institutes of learning, where you were apprenticed and taught that knowledge is a more valuable treasure than gold or gems. Now you are ready to leave your home- not to abandon it, but to quest for new lore to add to its storehouse of knowledge.

The most well-known of the galaxy's fonts of knowledge is the Library of the Republic. The great library is always in need of workers and attendants, some of whom rise through the ranks to assume roles of greater responsibility and prominence. You might be one of Coruscant's own, dedicated to the curatorship of what is likely the most complete body of lore and history in all the world.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}
{@b Equipment:} A set of common clothes, a {@item Datapad|sw5e-phb|datapad} and 10 data cards, a book on the subject of your current study, and a pouch containing 100 cr

entries.name: Feature: Library Access
entries: Though others must often endure extensive interviews and significant fees to gain access to even the most common archives in your library, you have free and easy access to the majority of the library, though it might also have repositories of lore that are too valuable, powerful, or secret to permit anyone immediate access.
You have a working knowledge of your cloister's personnel and bureaucracy, and you know how to navigate those connections with some ease.
Additionally, you are likely to gain preferential treatment at other libraries across the galaxy, as professional courtesy shown to a fellow scholar.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Cloistered scholars are defined by their extensive studies, and their characteristics reflect this life of study. Devoted to scholarly pursuits, they value knowledge highly — as a worthy goal in itself, or as a means to a desirable end.

rows: I use polysyllabic words that convey the impression of great erudition.
I've read every book in the world's greatest libraries—or I like to boast that I have.
I'm used to helping out those who aren't as smart as I am, and I patiently explain anything and everything to others.
There's nothing I like more than a good mystery.
I'm willing to listen to every side of an argument before I make my own judgment.
I... speak... slowly... when talking... to idiots,... which... almost... everyone... is... compared... to me.
I am horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.
I'm convinced that people are always trying to steal my secrets.
{@b Knowledge.} The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge. (Neutral)
{@b Beauty.} What is beautiful points us beyond itself toward what is true. (Light)
{@b Logic.} Emotions must not cloud our logical thinking. (Lawful)
{@b No Limits.} Nothing should fetter the infinite possibility inherent in all existence. (Chaotic)
{@b Power.} Knowledge is the path to power and domination. (Dark)
{@b Self-Improvement.} The goal of a life of study is the betterment of oneself. (Any)
It is my duty to protect my students.
I have an ancient text that holds terrible secrets that must not fall into the wrong hands.
I work to preserve a library, university, scriptorium, or monastery.
My life's work is a series of tomes related to a specific field of lore.
I've been searching my whole life for the answer to a certain question.
I sold my soul for knowledge. I hope to do great deeds and win it back.
I am easily distracted by the promise of information.
Most people scream and run when they see a monster. I stop and take notes on its anatomy.
Unlocking an ancient mystery is worth the price of a civilization.
I overlook obvious solutions in favor of complicated ones.
I speak without really thinking through my words, invariably insulting others.
I can't keep a secret to save my life, or anyone else's.

entries.name: Survivor
entries: You are haunted by something so terrible that you dare not speak of it. You've tried to bury it and run away from it, to no avail. Whatever this thing is that haunts you can't be slain, a ghost in the dark, a bloodcurdling nightmare, or a memory that refuses to die. The burden has taken its toll, isolating you from most people and making you question your sanity. You must find a way to overcome it before it destroys you.

items: {@b Skill Proficiencies:} Choose two from {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tool Proficiencies:} Your choice of artist's implements, {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements}, or brewer's kit
{@b Equipment:} A set of common clothes, one tool with which you are proficient, a tattered journal, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr

entries.name: Source of Dismay
entries: What dire event molded you into who you are today?

rows: A creature that slaughtered dozens of innocent people spared your life, and you don't know why.
An apparition that has haunted your family for generations now haunts you, unrelentingly.
Your family has a history of practicing dark sorcery or alchemy. You dabbled once and felt something horrible clutch at your mind, whereupon you fled in terror.
A stranger took your sibling one cold, dark night, and you were unable to stop it.
You were drastically changed physically by an accident and are haunted by what you once were.
A cultist kidnapped and raised you. You escaped, but they still have a mental hold over you.

entries.name: Feature: Heart of Darkness
entries: Those who look into your eyes can see that you have faced unimaginable {@spell Horror|sw5e-phb|horror} and that you are no stranger to darkness. Though they might fear you, commoners will extend you every courtesy and do their utmost to help you. Unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them, they may even take up arms to fight alongside you, should you find yourself facing an enemy alone.

entries.name: Background Feat
entries: As a further embodiment of the experience and training of your background, you can choose from the following feats:

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Survivors live through some traumatic event that shapes and defines them.

rows: I don't run from evil. Evil runs from me.
I like to read and memorize poetry. It keeps me calm and brings me fleeting moments of happiness.
I spend money freely and live life to the fullest, knowing that tomorrow I might die.
I live for the thrill of the hunt.
I don't talk about the thing that torments me. I'd rather not burden others with my curse.
I expect danger around every corner.
I refuse to become a victim, and I will not allow others to be victimized.
I put no trust in authority.
{@b Honor.} I try to help those in need, no matter what the personal cost. (Light)
{@b Vengeance.} I'll stop the spirits that haunt me or die trying. (Any)
{@b Fury.} I kill monsters to make the world a safer place, and to exorcise my own demons. (Light)
{@b Entitlement.} I have a dark calling that puts me above the law. (Chaotic)
{@b Focus.} I like to know my enemy's capabilities and weaknesses before rushing into battle. (Lawful)
{@b Selfish.} I'm a monster that destroys other monsters, and anything else that gets in my way. (Dark)
I keep my thoughts and discoveries in a journal. My journal is my legacy.
I would sacrifice my life to protect the innocent.
My torment drove away the person I love. I strive to win back the love I've lost.
A terrible guilt consumes me. I hope that I can find redemption through my actions.
There's evil in me, I can feel it. It must never be set free.
I have a child to protect. I must make the world a safer place for him (or her).
I have certain rituals that I must follow every day. I can never break them.
I assume the worst in people.
I feel no compassion for the dead. They're the lucky ones.
I am a purveyor of doom and gloom who lives in a world without hope.
I talk to spirits that no one else can see.

entries.name: Teacher
