{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Anzellan. Anzellan is characterized by its bouncy sound and emphasis on alternating syllables.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: An amphibious species native to the planet Ando, the Aqualish people have two facial tusks which curve down over their mouths; a trait which added to their appearance as arachnids. These facial tusks are highly sensitive to heat and cold and are used for cracking open the hard shells of shellfish or burrowing through the swampy loam of their homeworld. Having finned hands and two bulbous black eyes, Aqualish are unable to manipulate most machinery or equipment developed by the galaxy's many species which designed these tools for beings with digits. As a result, Aqualish tend to remain on their homeworld. Aqualish are well known for their hair-trigger tempers that flare without reason.
While Force-sensitive Aqualish are rare, members of the species have trained as both Sith and Jedi, though they typically gravitate toward the former.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Aqualish hate the image they have in the galaxy as thugs, regardless of its veracity, and blame it on any- and everyone else. Because of this, the species are considered pariahs on Ando, which has a lower population of Aqualish than the galaxy itself. All Aqualish speak mutually intelligible dialects of the same language. Quarrelsome and thug-like, the Aqualish culture revolved around aggression and toughness, with diplomacy being one of their weakest attributes.

entries.name: Names
entries: Aqualish names are intended to sound strong. Surnames are not familial, but are chosen by each individual Aqualish.
{@b Male Names.} Bung, Gu, Opege, Soni, Tubop {@b Female Names.} Cestirki, Duni, Iftu, Sifre, Umi {@b Surnames.} Dogomurra, Julo, Kronem, Nidoal, Utix

entries.name: Aqualish Traits
entries: As an Aqualish, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Aqualish reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Aqualish' aggressive personalities cause them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Aqualish stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 190 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Arms Dealers.}} Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check related to buying or selling weapons, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Aggressive.}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Menacing.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Aqualish. Aqualish is a harsh, guttural language. It's rare that other species bother to learn it unless they regularly interact with Aqualish.

rows: Green, blue, pink, gold when addicted

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Arcona have anvil-shaped heads, claws, marble-like eyes, and protective skin. Cona is always hot, and has very little water, but the atmosphere is filled with ammonia vapor. Arcona adapted to this environment by eating the ammonia-converting roots of flora as a source of water. Arcona depended on the ammonia to live and, as a result, arcona living offworld have to take ammonia supplements. Despite their large eyes, arcona have very poor eyesight. Their eyes, made up of thousands of photoreceptors, can not detect fine shapes, only seeing blurry objects. To aid this, they have a small sensory organ between their eyes. Often mistaken for their nose, this organ detects heat patterns from living beings. Thus, arcona can recognize things by its heat pattern.
Arcona are highly susceptible to addiction to spice and common salt, which serves as a hallucinogen with effects resembling that of intoxication. Their eyes shift to gold after prolonged addiction.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Arcona normally think of themselves not as individuals but as a collective whole. Largely forsaking individuality, they often refer to themselves as "we" even when alone. The arcona live in loose, family-based communities called nests, which are ruled by a Grand Nest. Because arcona are born in nests underground, they obtain a close sense of family living in close quarters with siblings. Males raise the young, since females are typically impulsive thrill-seekers.

entries.name: Names
entries: Arcona names are quite diverse, named by their fathers in the nest. Surnames are either familial or nest-based.
{@b Male Names.} Bijrik, El, Jat, Kazat, Onalol, Shle {@b Female Names.} Ak, Cimam, Cuten, He, Madan, Omik {@b Surnames.} Cheen, -drell, -faxel, Shran, Takonak, -voll

entries.name: Arcona Traits
entries: As an arcona, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Arcona reach adulthood in their late teens and live for more than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Arcona tend toward no particular alignment. They can vary from the chaotic thrillseekers to the orderly lawkeepers. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Arcona typically stand 5 and a half to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your sharp talons are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.
{@b {@i Clever.}} You have proficiency in one Intelligence skill of your choice.

{@b {@i Easily Addicted.}} Arcona are susceptible to spice addiction, and as a result you are taught to identify it from an early age. Additionally, consuming salt can cause them to hallucinate, potentially replicating the effects of spice. Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} related to identifying salt or spice or seeing whether something contains salt or spice, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to hot climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.
{@b {@i Keen Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve smell.

{@b {@i Reptilian Senses.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sensing heat, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Arconese. Arconese is spoken through complex, guttural squeaks from the back of the throat. However, arcona born and raised in colonies outside of Cona often did not learn Arconese, but the local language instead.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Ardennians are sentient humanoid simians hailing from the tropical paradise of Ardennia. They are covered in fur from head to their wrists and ankles, with brown and grey being the most common fur colors. Ardennians sport four arms and prehensile feet. All six of their limbs are equally dexterous.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Ardennian people themselves are a friendly communal species that are well known for welcoming visitors and inviting newcomers to traditional feasts and dances on the sandy beaches of Ardennia. Rural Ardiennan's live in modern tree-villages in the thick, dim jungle canopy on the majority of the islands. Ground level accommodations are available for off world visitors even in the smaller villages. Most off-worlders stay in the large modern resort complexes which boast having miles of private beaches or in the modern cities. Several large cities exist, scattered around the world, which typically encompass an entire island or a series of smaller islands joined together.

Ardennia's distance from the main hyperlanes makes it one of the lesser-known vacation destinations, but it's a popular one for those who don't mind the extra travel time. Some affluent visitors prefer the solitude that Ardennia offers, and occasionally end up purchasing one of the smaller islands to build their own home. Ardennia is notable for having the most beach per square meter in the galaxy.

entries.name: Names
entries: Ardennian's names are typically concise and rarely more than two syllables, with a familal surname.
{@b Male Names.} Rio, Jakar, Hul, Lup, Quil, Jerno {@b Female Names.} Rac, Bras, Nuc, Kua, Karta, Sanya {@b Surnames.} Betal, Durant, Jabut, Karon, Rambuan

entries.name: Ardennian Traits
entries: As an Ardennian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Ardennians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Ardennians' peaceful nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Ardennians typically stand 4 to 4 and a half feet tall and weigh around 60 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Four-Armed.}} Ardennians have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).
{@b {@i Jungle Dweller.}} Growing up in the tree-villages of Ardennia has left an impact. You don't treat jungle terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.
{@b {@i Mask of the Wild.}} You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.
{@b {@i Prehensile Feet.}} You have supreme control over your feet and can use them to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

{@b {@i Strong-Legged.}} When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

{@b {@i Treeclimber.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ardennian. Ardennian has a bubbly, energizing tone to it.

rows: Four clawed digits, extreme intelligence, infrared vision

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Arkanians are a robust near-human species with solid white eyes and clawed, four-fingered hands.

Arkanians are capable of seeing into the infrared spectrum, and their eyes are sensitive to sources of extreme heat. This proved helpful on their dark and frigid homeworld, but when traveling offworld, many must wear blinders on planets with hotter, younger suns. It is not unheard of for arkanians to undergo genetic or cybernetic manipulation of their own bodies, enhancing themselves so as to be better than "lesser" species.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Arkanians are notoriously arrogant, a trait which came from generations of producing some of the galaxy's greatest advancements in genetics and technology. Their homeworld, Arkania, has vast quantities of precious gems; thus, the arkanians have never wanted for much in trade. This wealth went into funding their ambitious scientific projects, the most elaborate of which take generations to be completed.

Many arkanians have come to see their species as the pinnacle of evolution, and amongst the most—if not {@i the} most—intelligent beings in the galaxy. Those species that are not already put off by their aloof nature often fear them, as tales of "mad scientists" and horrific experiments tend to surround them.

entries.name: Names
entries: Arkanian names are simultaneously dignified and succinct. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Arkoh, Hyrim, Zeta, Suprin {@b Female Names.} Shenna, Elizie, Cratala, Hanna {@b Surnames.} Focela, Barzane, Nasdra, Athacorr

entries.name: Arkanian Traits
entries: As an arkanian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Arkanians reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 100 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Due to their arrogance and unscrupulous experimentation, arkanians tend towards lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Arkanians typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Arkanian Brilliance.}} Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Intelligence, you can choose to add 1d4 to the result. You can choose to do this after the check is rolled, but before the DM determines if you've passed or failed the check. You cannot do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Crafters.}} You have proficiency in one tool of your choice.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Honed Mind.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against force and {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

{@b {@i Infrared Sight.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sight, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Sunlight Sensitivity.}} You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Arkanian. Arkanian, when spoken, has an airy tone, and is regarded as one of the most difficult written languages to learn.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Physically similar to humans, balosars appear to be sickly and gaunt when compared with the galaxy's most common species due to the heavy pollution of their homeworld. The most striking difference between balosars and humanity is a pair of antennapalps which sprouts from underneath the thick, coarse hair on their skulls. Retractable, these atennapalps allow them to listen into the subsonic range and give the species physical intuition and preternatural reflexes, which members of the Jedi Order sometimes mistook for Force-sensitivity. Balosars also possess an acute tolerance for poisonous substances, a byproduct of life on their toxic homeworld.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Early in its history, the balosar homeworld was overrun by galactic megacorporations eager to exploit the world's lax ecological protection laws. The planet was home to the balo mushroom, a key ingredient in death sticks, one of the galaxy's most infamous narcotics. After its discovery, Balosar was wrought with corruption, addiction, and pollution from the production and usage of death sticks.

Since there is little opportunity to flourish on their homeworld, balosars often leave in search of fortune elsewhere. Their natural resistance to the lethal—but not the addictive—effects of the drug encourages some to enter the death stick business.

entries.name: Names
entries: Balosar names have a slight exotic tinge to them—often because Balosar parents name their children while on a death stick high. Their surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Barin, Elan, Fantes, Zerba {@b Female Names.} Delaana, Ferrika, Reki, Vetyl {@b Surnames.} Cher'dak, Mer'darro, Sel'Sabagno

entries.name: Balosar Traits
entries: As a balosar, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Balosars reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 70 years naturally, though death stick addiction has lead to a general decline in their lifespan.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Balosars are notoriously cynical, selfish, and pragmatic, causing most to be neutral dark side. However, there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Balosar stand at an average height of about 5 feet, and weigh about 115 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing.}} Your antennapalps give you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks based on hearing.

{@b {@i Snap Senses.}} Through your antennapalps, you can sense incoming danger and react accordingly. When you roll for {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, you can choose to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Alternatively, if you are surprised, you may act normally on your first turn. Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Spicer.}} You are proficient in spicer's kit.

{@b {@i Toxin Resistance.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage (explained in chapter 9).

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Balosur. Balosur is known by its throaty rasps and deep vocalizations, and is considered crude as a written language.

rows: Four-fingered hands, two inch long teeth

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Barabel are a bipedal species of reptilians who are covered in very tough dark colored scales. Evolved from nocturnal lizards, the Barabel adapted a thick layer of fat which allowed them to remain active and not sluggish when temperatures dropped. A {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} set on stun would not damage them at all or slow them down, as it would merely bounce off their scales. Barabel are able to shed their tails if necessary, an ability that proved the undoing of many startled foes. They also possess heavy retractable claws along with needle sharp teeth which can grow to be 2 inches in length. A carnivorous species, Barabel possess two stomachs in order to process the massive amount of food they required to survive.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Living in low tech communities ranging from a few dozen individuals to no more than ten thousand, the Barabel community is built around a warren where the group thrives and hunted from. The Barabel species is noted for its hunting and tracking prowess; many of their actions are fueled by their hunting instincts, leading to the general feeling that Barabel are always angry. They are well known for their aggression but are also extremely loyal. They also have a great deal of respect for the Jedi because of their first experiences with a Jedi Master who settled a dangerous clan dispute. Apologies, whether for a misdeed or in sympathy, are an unknown concept to Barabel and are considered insulting.

entries.name: Names
entries: Barabel names are harsh and gutteral. Female names are often softer. Surnames are warren-based.
{@b Male Names.} Anidroks, Bridiz, Trurzuk, Vilzinok {@b Female Names.} Alge, Bulzo, Ekthamo, Inako, Nolku {@b Surnames.} Akken, Dutarca, Khigta, Srabulgid, Zhomo

entries.name: Barabel Traits
entries: As a barabel, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Barabel reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Barabel aggression causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Barabel typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.
{@b {@i Hunter.}} You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Prehensile Tail.}} You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

{@b {@i Tooth and Nail.}} Your sharp teeth and claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special claw attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1), and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Barabel. The Barabel language is characterized by its barks and hisses.

rows: Hunchback, large heads, strong sense of smell

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: A hunchbacked species of sentient reptilians, the bipedal baragwin are easily recognized across the galaxy. Noted for their thick, wrinkled skin which can resist most physical attacks and their shuffling gait, the large-headed race have no obvious differences between male and female baragwin. An acute sense of smell give the species enough sensitivity to detect another being's mood and feelings. This leads some of them into careers as big-game hunters, or even as bounty hunters. Due to their ponderous movement, many non-baragwin believe the race to be a dull-witted people while, in fact, they are quite intelligent. Despite this fact, the baragwin frequently keep this intelligence hidden, using the misconceptions of others to their own {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Baragwin culture, since it does not derive from a single homeworld, is highly dependent on a baragwin's planet of origin, with Tatooinian baragwin behaving quite differently from those from Denuhi-Eight. Baragwin generally have little prejudice, treating all other beings equally regardless of species, culture, or planetary origins; though criminal baragwin will exploit all beings equally instead. Baragwin settlements are generally small and anarchic, with short-term leaders selected by informal democratic processes. Baragwin are famous as skilled weapon-smiths and introduced many different weapons to different worlds. Baragwin-made {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} and vibroblades are among the most powerful personal weapons in the galaxy.

entries.name: Names
entries: Baragwin have names with wide tones, spoken using the entire mouth, that don't differentiate by gender. Baragwin use familial surnames.
{@b First Names.} Dagel, Eskaul, Idalli, Migo {@b Surnames.} Fadani, Igara, Kodrue, Wylbas

entries.name: Baragwin Traits
entries: As a baragwin, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Baragwin reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Baragwin tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Baragwin typically stand 5 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Arms Dealers.}} Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check related to buying or selling weapons, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.
{@b {@i Keen Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve smell.

{@b {@i Natural Empathy.}} Baragwin's powerful sense of smell allows them to sense the emotions in those around them. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.
{@b {@i Travelers.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Weapon Developers.}} Baragwin are famous throughout the galaxy for their quality arms manufacturing. You have proficiency with {@item Armstech's implements|sw5e-phb|armstech's implements}, munitions kits, or two weapons of your choice.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Baragwinian. Baragwinian is a deep language with low rumbling vocalizations. The baragwin themselves, however, are not especially fond of this language. Most of them learn the languages used on whatever planet they were born, so Baragwinian is not very common. Baragwinian is still considered useful as a trade language, however.

rows: Bony headcrest, four arms, inflatable wattle

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Male Besalisks' heads sported prominent crests and four arms hung at their sides; females of the species could have as many as eight arms, but like Humans had a primary hand and a limited range of functionality with the others. The addition of the extra appendages required a hearty metabolism, and these bulky beings were able to store food and water for many days, and if the need arose, they could survive for long periods without either. Scruffy sensory whiskers lined the area below their noses, just above the robust wattle most adult Besalisks possessed.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Because of Ojom's harsh environment, large cities were never developed on the world; instead small communes of about a thousand families claim territories around the world and are each led by an elected leader. The communes have a strict policy of keeping the size of their groupings equal to avoid conflict. When too many families grow in one area, the leader would ask certain families to break away and start a new community on another glacier.

While not involved in galactic politics and because they do not produce any of their own technology, the Besalisks established large orbital space stations where offworlders could come to do business. Trading and making deals, any violence on these stations is committed by offworlders as Besalisks avoid confrontation.

entries.name: Names
entries: Besalisk name's are generally words that embody them, with a surname attached to their commune.
{@b Male Names.} Darius, Dexter, Plun, Pong {@b Female Names.} Delia, Mora, Ren, Teen {@b Surnames.} Jettster, Kil, Krell, Ugg

entries.name: Besalisk Traits
entries: As a Besalisk, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Besalisks reach adulthood in their early teens and generally live to be about 70.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Besalisks tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

{@b {@i Size.}} Besalisks tower over almost all other species, with the smallest standing at 6 feet tall and weighing 200 lbs., and the largest approaching 8 feet tall and 400 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Four-Armed.}} Besalisks have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).
{@b {@i Long-Limbed.}} When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.
{@b {@i Powerful Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Besalisk.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: A species of furry mammalians, the caamasi are covered in dense fur and have a spicy, woody body scent that is similar to that of Corellian whiskey. They have long arms with three-fingered hands, and pointed ears which stick out from the sides of their heads. They also have extremely acute senses of smell, with their nose positioned at the end of a tooth-filled snout. Caamasi have the interesting ability to share vivid memories called memnii with their near relatives and Force-sensitives. A memnis is as vivid to one who receives it as it was to the one who participated in the event remembered. Their peace-loving natures are in part due to memnii, as having a memory of killing or harming will be particularly strong, becoming unbearable in time, and something caamasi will seek to avoid except in defense of themselves or others, for which case they would accept their burden.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: A pacifist race, culture on Caamas evolved around the basic tenets of peace and social justice; influencing the evolution of the Jedi Order. Working as explorers, diplomats, and artists, the caamasi are a monogamous people who value single partners while mating and starting a family. However following the devastation of their homeworld by the Empire, caamasi who were off-world at the time considered evolving to a position of polygamy so as to regrow the population. While the argument is one of survival, many sociologists familiar with the culture of the caamasi believe that they will not accept the idea.

entries.name: Names
entries: Caamasi surnames are often composed of two parts, with the second part designating clan membership.
{@b Male Names.} Althanic, Gelerit, Ryg'gos, Shren {@b Female Names.} Eeshraq, Heshrisa, Nulana, Yr'na {@b Surnames.} A'kriy, I'tela, O'Tul, Sho'cyl

entries.name: Caamasi Traits
entries: As a caamasi, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Caamasi reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Caamasi's peaceful and just nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Caamasi typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Call for Peace.}} As an action on your turn, you can emphatically demand that your foes embrace peace, thereby distracting them. Until the end of your next turn, enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you gain {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against your allies. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Diplomatic.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Keen Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

{@b {@i Memnii Transfer.}} As an action, while touching a creature, you can initiate a memnii transfer. The creature must make an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier), a creature can choose to fail this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} if it wishes. On a failed save the target is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}, and you can share vivid memories with the target as if they were their own for 1 minute or until your {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} ends (as if you were concentrating on a power). The transfer ends if you stop touching the target. At the end of each of its turns, the creature can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the transfer. On a success, the transfer ends. Otherwise, you may end the transfer on your turn (no action required). Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. This feature has no effect on droids, constructs, or Force-Insensitive creatures.
{@b {@i Scholarly.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Caamasi. Caamasi uses smooth tones and low volumes, making it soothing to listen to. Many popular nursery rhymes have been written in Caamasi to help children to sleep.

rows: Large ears, flat noses with four nostrils

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Chadra-Fan are covered from head to foot in fur. Their species evolved from small, arboreal rodents. The two different sexes of Chadra-Fan are indistinguishable to other species, though the Chadra-Fan could readily tell the difference using their powerful sense of smell. Chadra-Fan also have involuntary pheromones that conveyed information about their family line and created an aura of attractiveness. Other voluntary pheromones often conveyed a Chadra-Fan's state of emotion-anger, fear, or joy. Chadra-Fan even create more complex messages using their pheromones, though the pheromones when mixed sometimes caused confusion. They are unique in the fact that they had clear blood.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The society of Chadra-Fan is divided into a clan structure in which every member is responsible for parenting the clan's children; a fact of life is that every household is open at any time. Leadership within the clan is a temporary role that is passed from one individual to another as the situation calls for a particular {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}. Children are the centerpiece of a Chadra-Fan community, and only leave when wed. However the new Chadra-Fan couple remain with the smaller clan so it was possible that a Chadra-Fan never leaves his or her home.
Chadra-Fan left by themselves suffer depression, so they regularly seek the company of others; thus, Chadra-Fan are not very picky when it came to friends and prefer complete strangers to loneliness

entries.name: Names
entries: Chadra-Fan names do not vary significantly based on sex. Surnames are clan based.
{@b First Names.}  Dubi, Kattar, Naska, T'yabah, O'yasha {@b Surnames.} Abalomm, Fandy, Nemm, Nuz, Yedit

entries.name: Chadra-Fan Traits
entries: As a chadra-fan, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Chadra-Fan reach adulthood by 15 and live an average of 40 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Chadra-Fan's open, clan-based culture cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Chadra-Fan stand 3-4 feet tall and weigh about 45 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.
{@b {@i Climb.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing and Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.

{@b {@i Second Heart.}} When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Tinker.}} You have proficiency with {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements}. You can use these and spend 1 hour and 100 cr worth of materials to construct a Tiny Device (AC 5, 1 hp). You can take the {@action Use an Object|sw5e-phb} action to have your device cause one of the following effects: create a small explosion, create a repeating loud noise for 1 minute, create smoke for 1 minute, emit an onerous smell for 1 minute. You can maintain a number of these devices up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} at once, and a device stops functioning after 24 hours away from you. You can dismantle the device to reclaim the materials used to create it.

{@b {@i Trance.}} You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Chadra-Fan. The Chadra-Fan language is characterized as being nasally and squeaky.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Chagrians are born as tadpoles in clutches of three or more and raised in tubs of water in a family's private home. During this time, their arms, legs, and air-breathing lungs develop. Adult Chagrians are truly amphibious, retaining their ability to breathe underwater while also able to function without difficulty in air. They also possess acute low-light vision.

The average Chagrian stands taller than a Human. They are distinguished by two fleshy growths protruding from the sides of their heads, which they call lethorns. As they age, the lethorns thicken. Males also sport two horns growing from the top of their skulls. These were once used in underwater duels to attract a mate, and are seen as a sign of the males' strength and virility. Females lack the superior cranial horns, but had more pronounced and longer posterior head plates; these can reach halfway down their back. Chagrians also have very long black forked tongues.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: As a species, Chagrians are generally peaceful and law-abiding to the point of becoming stoic and obstinate. Many Chagrians are motivated only by basic desires such as sustenance, shelter, and healthcare. Chagrian government ensures that every citizen is cared and provided for, so the standard of living for the poorest Chagrian is high compared to the members of other species. Chagrians who expect violence often wear red.

entries.name: Names
entries: Chagrian names have a very melodic tone. Male names are typically shorter than female names. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Bom, Chen, Fiet, Nedd, Touk {@b Female Names.}  Chavik, Dabai, Fisil, Oolya, Tinto {@b Surnames.} Kassin, Molya, Nigna, Onirali, Treen

entries.name: Chagrian Traits
entries: As a Chagrian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Chagrians reach adulthood in their late teens and live an average of 75 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Chagrians' peace-loving nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Chagrians typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Natural Resistance.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage (explained in chapter 9).
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Chagri.

rows: Black, brown, blond, grey, or white (usually with age)
Stocky build, large heads, long snouts, long arms, three-fingered hands, four-toed feet

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Chevin have long snouts which hang down nearly to their ankles. Combined with their intellect, this makes them skilled hunters of animals such as backshin, because they can smell out their prey or feed while keeping their eyes on the horizon. It is also their hunting prowess which allowed them to dominate their homeworld and conquer the Chevs. Chevin have thick legs, massive wide bodies, thin rope-like tails, and arms so long their three-fingered hands often brushed the ground.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Chevin live in small, mobile communities, with homes mounted on great wheeled carts. Even after they gained access to galactic technology, they continued to live as nomads (though more affluent Chevin mounted their lodges on large repulsorlift vehicles instead.) Their Chev slaves are usually forced to follow on foot. Nomadic groups of Chevin keep in touch via comlinks, and often converge on a single location to deal with danger.

The only Chevin settlements that stay in place for more than one standard month are the Government Villages, where Chevin dictators live with their hand-picked advisors. Even these settlements are movable when necessary. Each of the roughly two dozen Government Villages rules a Chevin nation.

entries.name: Names
entries: Chevin names do not vary significantly based on gender. Surnames are based on community.
{@b First Names.} Buula, Ephant, Perre, Phylus, Reseros {@b Surnames.} Meh, Mon, Nen, Needmo, Phrusaani

entries.name: Chevin Traits
entries: As a Chevin, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Chevin reach adulthood in their thirties and live up to 200 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Chevin warmongering and slavetrading cause them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Chevin stand between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh up to 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to both hot and cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.
{@b {@i Nomadic.}} You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Thick Skull.}} Your skull is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Chevin. The Chevin language is characterized by grunts and low-pitched rumblings. Chevin typically have deep voices, even when speaking Basic.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The chironian lower body has four legs, similar to that of a horse, and each ends in a dainty, cloven hoof. A chironian can sit down by folding his or her horse-like legs underneath the body. Chironians can also kick backward with both hind legs; this strong kick is sufficient to knock over other beings. A chironian's pace can vary between a walk, a canter, and a gallop.

Each year, chironian heads grows two horns above the temples. These horns start as small knobs covered by red-furred velvet: a vascular tissue. Once the knobs have grown sufficiently, they break through the velvet naturally, emerging as transparent horns, as bright as diamond, cool to the touch and with smooth ridges. However, if the velvet is cut artificially, chironians can die from the injury. Over time, the horns grow long and sharp enough that adolescent chironians can use them to gore opponents.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Chironians express emotions through the mannerisms of their hooves: when impatient, they stamp them; when excited, they tap them in a quick dance, or canter in a spot. The centauriforms frequently shake their heads and manes, and when angry, their faces flush a deeper shade. Young chironians, when {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}, are known to rub or press their velvet-covered horns against the foreheads of other beings to whom they are emotionally close.

entries.name: Names
entries: Chironian names are soft and melodic, despite the thick nature of their native language. Important family names are passed down through generations. They don't use surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Jefin, Slaturn, Cinall, Leathes {@b Female Names.} Olachi, Luna, Sinall, Trespen

entries.name: Chironian Traits
entries: As a chironian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Chironians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Chironians tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Chironians typically stand 6 to 8 feet tall and generally weigh about 600 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 40 feet.
{@b {@i Cultured.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Equine Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples. Additionally, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your hooves. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet, instead of the normal 1 extra foot. Finally, a Medium or smaller creature can ride on your equine back if you allow it. In such a situation, you continue to act independently, not as a controlled mount.

{@b {@i Hooves and Horns.}} Your hooves (and depending on your age, horns) are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Powerful Charge.}} If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line before hitting with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can attempt to trip the target prone as part of the same attack. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Chironan. Chironan is characterized by its soft, melodic sounds.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: In their natural form, clawdites resemble reptilian humanoids, having evolved from reptomammals. They have sunken cheeks with a narrow nose, a small mouth, large eyes with slit-like pupils, and a thin line that runs down their foreheads, creasing their nose. Clawdites possess an extremely rare ability to change their appearance. They can change the color and texture of their skin and eyes, and even grow hair, to mimic other species, though they cannot add significant physical mass to their bodies.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: By nature, clawdites are quiet and solitary beings, often shunning the company of others unless it benefits them. Due to their nature as shapeshifters, they are often mistrusted by strangers. Consequently, they view the galaxy pragmatically, and are often harsh realists.

Not all clawdites use their shapeshifting abilities due to the pain the transformation causes. These clawdites are often inclined to remain on their homeworld of Zolan, avoiding the company of other species.

On Zolan, clawdites are feared and shunned by the zolanders, who are a deeply religious people, believing that clawdites are impure and sinful. Zolanders force clawdites to live in slums scattered across the planet.
Those clawdites who leave their homeworld tend to gravitate toward professions that celebrate their shapeshifting, such as smuggling, bounty hunting, or espionage.

entries.name: Names
entries: Clawdite names often have a rolling or hissing quality to them. Surnames are familial, though clawdites rarely use them.
{@b Male Names.} Nuri, Pol, Renneyn, Rosat, Turman {@b Female Names.} Bargu, Cato, Murna, Sora, Zam {@b Surnames.} Durra, Noviee, Parasitti, Virten, Wesell

entries.name: Clawdite Traits
entries: As a clawdite, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Clawdites reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Clawdites' pragmatism cause them to tend towards neutral balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Clawdites typically stand 5 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Changeling Instincts.}} You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} {@b {@i Shapechanger.}} As an action, you can change your appearance and your voice. You determine the specifics of the changes, including your coloration, hair length, and sex. You can also adjust your height and weight, but not so much that your size changes. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your game statistics change. You can't duplicate the appearance of a creature you've never seen, and you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs that you have. Your clothing and equipment aren't changed by this trait. You stay in the new form until you use an action to revert to your true form or until you die.

{@b {@i Unsettling Visage.}} When a creature you can see makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll. You must use this feature before knowing whether the attack hits or misses. Using this trait reveals your shapeshifting nature to any creature within 30 feet that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Clawdite, and one more language of your choice. Clawdite is characterized by its rolling sounds paired with hissing sibilants.

rows: Black, brown, gray, or white (usually with age)

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Codru-Ji are humanoids generally near-human in their adult appearances, save for their four arms. While their hair, eye, and skin pigmentations tend towards earthen hues, brighter colorations such as blonde hair or blue eyes, though uncommon, also exist. Rarer still, some adults maintain a light coat of fur or elongated, pointed ears. These eccentric attributes result from their unusual childhood forms.

Codru-Ji children are actually sapient, six-legged canid creatures that cannot speak. Codru-Ji in this stage of their lives are called Wyrwulves: they mature to their more recognizable figures after reaching puberty. At that point, a blue, rubbery substance cocoons a Wyrwulf for several weeks before it emerges as a humanoid adolescent. They do, however, retain both the natural resilience and the enhanced hearing of their previous selves.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Codru-Ji are proud and protective of their ancient customs, and they carefully manage their homeworld's economy to keep a degree of anonymity from the galaxy at large. They fear the tainting of their long-held practices by outside influence as well as prejudice against them for the almost barbaric level of callousness they will display towards one another in pursuit of personal gain. The kidnapping of a political rivals' children or the ransoming of off-worlders back to their people are both common practices.

entries.name: Names
entries: Codru-Ji names are often kept to two syllables. Clan names are appended to the given name as a hyphenated affix.
{@b Male Names.} Kossok, Tirrit, Uttar, Yunnan {@b Female Names.} Davvi, Kella, Russa, Zollu {@b Clan Names.} -Fa, -Mu, Ro-, -Sy, Yi-

entries.name: Codru-Ji Traits
entries: As a codru-ji, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Codru-Ji reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Steeped in selfish tradition, Codru-Ji tend towards the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Codru-Ji stand 5 to 6 feet tall and weigh around 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Four-Armed.}} Codru-Ji have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).
{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

{@b {@i Natural Grappler.}} Whenever you make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check to grapple you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Trance.}} You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Codruese, which has a solemn and stately cadence to it.

rows: Carnivorous insectoids, four legs, defensive "ball mode"

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Colicoids are tall insectoids that held multiple appendages. Their bodies are chitinous and include a powerful stinging tail. A colicoid's physiology allows them to curl up into a protective ball and unfurl suddenly which allow them to catch their prey unaware. This rolling method of locomotion is second nature to the colicoids. Their insectoid minds provide them a natural defense against mind tricks.

Some members are colicoid queens that are different as they are more than twice the size of even the largest warrior breeds. This makes them extremely dangerous and are the only colicoids that possess a unique poisonous stinger. This combined with their strength and size makes them deadly combatants, especially when within their nests. However, a queen tends to only fight when her young are being threatened.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Though highly intelligent, colicoids are emotionless and cannibalistic in nature. Their ruthless cunning serves them well on the battlefield as it does on the negotiating table. It is known that long ago that they transferred these ruthless characteristics to their commerce activities. As a result, they are known to be brutally efficient in their business practices. They are noted for being vicious and calculating creatures that are driven by greed whilst showing little regard for others. The colicoids have numerous successful commercial ventures and hold strict business protocols.

entries.name: Names
entries: Colicoid names are typically very short and gender neutral, with surnames being based on the queen from which they spawned.
{@b First Names.} Gal, Het, Kaf, Lyp, Nok, Yin {@b Surnames.} Bek, Dor, Set, Tel, Wim, Zal

entries.name: Coilicoid Traits
entries: As a colicoid, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Strength or Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Colicoids reach adulthood by 8 and live to be about 65.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Colicoid's emotionless nature causes them to tend towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Colicoids typically stand 6 to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.
{@b {@i Acute Senses.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Cannibalize.}} If you spend at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one). Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

{@b {@i Closed Mind.}} Colicoid brains have an unusual composition which gives them a natural defense against the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

{@b {@i Defensive Ball.}} You are able to curl into a rolling ball for extra protection. When you take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action while you aren't wielding a shield, you gain a bonus to AC equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} until the start of your next turn.

{@b {@i Natural Armor.}} Due to your carapace and the shape of your body, you are ill-suited to wearing armor. Your carapace provides ample protection, however; it gives you a base AC of 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You gain no benefit from wearing armor, but if you are using a shield, you can apply the shield's bonus as normal.

{@b {@i Stinger.}} Your stinger is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Colicoid. The Colicoid language uses sounds produced by the antennae and jointed legs of the colicoids, including humming sounds and clicks, which makes it difficult for other species to speak.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The culisetto are an insectoid species, with a close resemblance to the common fly. Their long snouts are not truly proboscises, but function much the same, allowing them to drain blood with the aid of two tendrils, one on either side of the snout. They move by crawling about on their hands and feet, and are adept at leaping and climbing.
Despite their appearance, culisetto are an exceptionally hygenic species, with an evolved habit of rubbing their hands and legs to rid them of germs from the ground.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Culisetto are often shunned by other species, if not for their grotesque appearance, then usually for their habit of drinking blood. They prefer to do so while their victims are alive, but tolerate it if they are recently dead. While they have evolved beyond needing to drink blood to survive, its taste remains quite enticing to many culisetto, who will indulge in it at their pleasure.
Culisetto tend to favor the company of their own kind, particularly their siblings. Broodlings frequently travel in groups of three or more, inseparable from birth.

entries.name: Names
entries: Culisetto names are distinctively antiquated in their etymology. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Kreon, Sosilu, Ocyto, Phino {@b Female Names.} Hecuba, Anophe, Xeina, Adeia {@b Surnames.} Dengue, Chontos, Kazan, Vazil

entries.name: Culisetto Traits
entries: As a culisetto, you have the following traits: {@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Culisetto reach adulthood at 8 years old, and live to be about 60.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Culisettos' thirst for blood cause them to tend towards the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Culisetto stand between 3 and 4 feet tall and weigh about 45 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Cannibalize.}} If you spend at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.
{@b {@i Climb.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet.

{@b {@i Compound Eyes.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sight, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Powerful Leap.}} If you jump at least 10 feet in a straight line before hitting with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can attempt to trip the target as part of the same attack. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Prehensile Feet.}} You have supreme control over your feet and can use them to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

{@b {@i Strong-Legged.}} When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.
{@b {@i Surprise Attack.}} If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

{@b {@i Torpor.}} You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields or {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Culisetto. Culisetto is composed of high pitched whines made from the snout.

rows: Black, dark gray, or Olive green

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Dashade are a hulking reptillian species known for their strength and aggression. They have three fingers on each hand, each tipped with a long, curving claw.

Their most notable feature is their natural resistance to the power of the Force. Along with their resistance to the Force, Dashade possess a high tolerance for radioactive energy, able to withstand contact with radioactive materials much longer than other species.
Despite the thick skin Dashade possess, they have the uncanny ability to control the rate that heat dissipates from their skin. This allows them to regulate their body temperature at will.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Dashade's brute strength and Force resistance makes them prime candidates for mercenary and assassin work.
Dashade society is clan-based. Theses clan's often feud over honor and reputation, a trait that the dashade as a species exhibit.

entries.name: Names
entries: Many dashade names are short, dominated by harsher sounds, while others are longer and seperated by an apostrophe. Dashade names are gender neutral. Surnames are clan-based, but most dashade don't share or use them.
{@b First Names.} Anarin, Rak'vhul, Set, Vattix, Vos {@b Surnames.} Ferrex, Gusar, Kruyel, Orath, Xeng, Zath

entries.name: Dashade Traits
entries: As a dashade, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Dashade reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Dashade's aggressive yet loyal nature causes them to tend toward lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Dashade typically stand 5 and a half to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh around 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Force Contention.}} Due to their unique physiology, dashade hardiness allows them to overcome use of the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

{@b {@i Heat Dissipation.}} Whenever you make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check to avoid detection by electronic sensors and cameras, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Menacing.}} You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Radiation Resistant.}} Dashade are naturally able to resist radiation. You have resistance to necrotic damage.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Dashadi. Dashadi is characterized by its low pitch and elongated growls.

rows: Blue to yellow in ultraviolet light, black to dark brown in visible light
Ability to absorb light, light blindness, claws

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: While defel appear to be visually similar to the shistavanen, they are very different on a biological level. Defel have the ability to bend waves of light in such a manner that it renders them practically {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} to the human eye. Despite this ability, they could be still be spotted by force-users and keen-eyed individuals.

Defel have extremely high perceptive ability because of their large ears, sensitive noses, and keen eyes. Because of the heightened levels of visual stimuli their eyes experience, defel are nearly {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} by sunlight but  can see rather well in the dark.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Defel live in tight-knit, interdependent communites underground. The harsh environment on Af'El turned the defel into rugged survivors, able to hold their own in the Galaxy.
Defel have a strong sense of honor and will not associate with individuals that do not keep their word.
Because defel have yet to achieve interplanetary travel, they are a rare sight in the galaxy.

entries.name: Defel Names
entries: Defel names tend to sound dark and mysterious, and are mostly composed of multiple syllables. Defel surnames are familial, using stern and simple sounds.
{@b Male Names.} Alustair, Claustro, Tenebris, Varsiin {@b Female Names.} Lhantra, Soliel, Stroika, Zavtra {@b Surnames.} Gauss, Neura, Tume, Vecherom

entries.name: Defel Traits
entries: As a defel, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Defel reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Defel tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Defel typically stand 4 to 5 feet tall and generally weigh around 100 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Hidden Step.}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can turn {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Miners.}} You have proficiency in scavenging kits.

{@b {@i Sunlight Sensitivity.}} You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.
{@b {@i Sneaky}} You are proficient in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Surprise Attack}} If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Defel. Most defel refuse to speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} while on their home planet of Af'El unless they have a specific need for it.

rows: Six wings, yellow aura, hypnotic abilities

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Diathim are a mysterious species of winged sentients famed for their radiance and beauty. They often make appearances as angelic figures in the folklore of numerous species. Their bodies naturally give off an intense light, obfuscating their physical forms to the naked eye. They have three pairs of thin, translucent wings that appear fragile, but are more than capable of flight. Diathim have been known to survive in the vacuum of space without the need for protective gear, and have a mild hypnotic effect on others in their presence, adding to the legends surrounding them.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The diathim give off an aura of kindness, and are consistently described as benevolent by spacers, causing tales of their rare appearances to morph over time into the grandiose mythology of the "Angels." The diathim are reputed for their beauty, and the way in which they appear varies depending on the beholder. Diathim are fascinated by spacecraft, which often prompted them to mob any ships that found themselves in the vicinity of their homeworld Iego and its largest moon Millius Prime.

Diathim have only commonly been seen gathering in flocks to welcome arriving ships, and knowledge of their habitat remains a mystery to outsiders. Although they have no apparent language of their own, they have readily adopted {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, the common language of the galaxy.

entries.name: Names
entries: Traditional diathim names are difficult to pronounce. When among other species, they tend to simply go by shortened nicknames for others to refer to them by.
{@b Birth Names.} Aiubhirr'merh, D'yz'xarh, Ihuithrhe, Vyxendel'ahitraxr {@b Nicknames.} Mirra, Diz, Huu, Vix

entries.name: Diathim Traits
entries: As a diathim, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Diathim reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 100 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Diathim are naturally empathetic, causing them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Diathim typically stand 6 to 9 feet tall and generally weigh about 100 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Type.}} Your creature type is both aberration and humanoid.
{@b {@i Celestial Physiology.}} You can survive for one day within the vacuum of space.

{@b {@i Enthralling Hypnosis.}} You can use your psychic aura to influence individuals of both sexes. Whenever you roll a 1 on a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Additionally, once per short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower on a Charisma check as a 10. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

{@b {@i Flight.}} You have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.

{@b {@i Fragile.}} Diathim are too weak to pack much of a punch. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when determining your bonus to attack and damage rolls for weapon attacks using Strength, you can—t add more than +3.

{@b {@i Luminescent Aura.}} Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to amplify your radiant aura, causing a searing light to radiate from you. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. During it, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, you and each creature within 10 feet of you take psychic damage equal to half your level (rounded up). In addition, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra psychic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a power. The extra psychic damage equals your level.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice.

rows: Chin horns, thick skin, imposing build, never stop growing

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Dowutin species evolved from a type of omnivorous herd animal on the planet Dowut. They were large, aggressive-looking humanoids with chin horns, sharp claws, thick skin, and had poor eyesight but superior senses of hearing and smell. Dowutin are massive humanoids who can live for centuries, and dying of old age is unheard of for them. While most other species become frail as they age, Dowutin never stop growing and getting stronger.
