As teenagers, Dowutin resemble Wookiees in size and strength, but by their fifth century, they are a mountain of muscle weighing a metric ton, with loud footsteps and voices warning other species away.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Dowutin are a very straightforward people, and their society is among the most simple in the galaxy. They have few cities, governments, or even organized social structures, as they often survive entirely on their own. Children are left behind by their families at a very young age and must learn to fend for themselves. Because of this, those who quickly learned hunting skills survived. Their size and strength made them prized as hired muscle, but most Dowutins' pride dissuaded them from such work, as they viewed other species as weak, absolutely refusing to take orders from anyone who is physically weaker than them. As such, those who employ Dowutin will command them in more subtle ways, typically phrasing their commands as suggestions or advice. Strength in the literal sense is very important to them; it is a measure of worth and earns them respect.

entries.name: Names
entries: Dowutin names are harsh and guttural, and roll off the tongue like a rock slide. Dowutin do not use surnames.
{@b First Names.} Dursuc, Grimgorl, Maucro, Tornak

entries.name: Dowutin Traits
entries: As a dowutin, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Dowutins are considered a child until around the age of 75 in which they are a full fledged adult. Dowutins can live upwards of 900 years with even more ancient ones exceeding that.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Dowutins are aggressive and brash, causing them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

{@b {@i Size.}} Dowutins have a unique special characteristic; from birth to death, they never stop growing. Even as an adolescent, dowutins tend to tower over other species, reaching heights over 8 feet and weighing 400 pounds. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold.
{@b {@i Hunter.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing and Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.
{@b {@i Powerful Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Dowuta. Dowuta consists of deep, booming vocalizations and is considered difficult for members of other species to emulate.

rows: Four fingers, large teeth, telepathy, long life spans

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Draethos possess large teeth, which grow outside of their mouths. Coupled with their lack of lips, this leads to the appearance of an overbite. Their scaly skin ranged in color from blue to purple to black. Their hands retain an interstitial web between the fingers. Their fingers end in narrow tips which resemble claws. They possess low-light vision, springing from their cave-dwelling ancestors.
Draethos possess a limited telepathy, granting the ability to communicate with any sentient being. The ability is limited to communication; a Draethos can not invade the thoughts of others.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Partly due to their long lives, Draethos society was slow to evolve and relies heavily on tradition. The Draethos' culture is warrior-based, and those living on the homeworld are expected to demonstrate their martial or hunting prowess. Life on Draethos is harsh, with arrogant aristocrats squabbling among one another for social standing and wealth. Warriors are perpetually in high demand as gladiators, mercenaries, hunters, and soldiers. Those who make a conscious decision to abandon the way of the warrior are exiled to seek a new life among aliens. Consequently, despite their reputation as fierce combatants, most Draethos encountered offworld are peaceful and intellectual.

entries.name: Names
entries: Due to their lack of lips, Draethos names typically lack hard consonants. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Odan, Gyeto, Hurl, Jan, Talon {@b Female Names.} Gillen, Teria, Kat'h, Yul, Aswe {@b Surnames.} Urr, Slyter, Qelu'tlapa, Ayahu, Jek

entries.name: Draethos Traits
entries: As a draethos, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Draethos reach adulthood around their late teens and live up to 800 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Draethos tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Draethos typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 190 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Telepathy.}} You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet of you. You must share a language with the target in order to communicate in this way.
{@b {@i Way of the Warrior.}} You have proficiency with light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} as well as vibroblades and vibroswords.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Draethos. Draethos is characterized by its flurry of cacophonous sighs and clicks.

rows: Arms used as legs and legs used as arms

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Dugs are slender, powerfully built beings with a somewhat humanoid build and a unique method of walking that hailed from the high gravity world Malastare. Their primary means of locomotion is their strong arms, and their lower limbs and feet were used for grappling and other fine motor manipulation. They hardly ever walk on their lower limbs. Although most Dugs may walk on all four limbs, others like to use their strong arms as legs and their feet as hands like they would normally do.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Due to their oppression under their Gran rulers who colonized Malastare, many Dugs often feel the need to throw around their strength in bids to establish dominance. As a result, they are known for their ill-tempered demeanor, and many are bullying thugs.

On their homeworld of Malastare, the vast majority of Dugs are little more than laborers toiling for the enrichment of the Gran. With the species excluded from much of the power and money on Malastare, many Dugs turn to swoop racing or bounty hunting as their only means to achieve fame and fortune. In all other areas, the Dugs are exploited.

entries.name: Names
entries: Dug names are often 3 syllables long, mostly through big sounds rather than harsh tones. There are harsher tones in their names as well though, often in the forms of x's and k's. Female Dugs have softer names, but no one would call them beautiful. Surnames are usually passed down through family or clan.
{@b Male Names.} Bawugri, Gadwouhx, Rorgukwa, {@b Female Names.} Bosix, Grugne, Jiwous, Pragiba, {@b Surnames.} Brundaare, Gninsaidi, Kedwir, Randaine

entries.name: Dug Traits
entries: As a dug, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Dugs reach adulthood in their early teens and live an average of 75 years. Their violent nature often leads to violent ends.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Dugs' angry nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Dugs typically stand between 3 and 4 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.
{@b {@i Courageous.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}.
{@b {@i Fisticuffs.}} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

{@b {@i Fury of the Small.}} When you damage a creature with an attack or a power and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or power to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Menacing.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Strong and Small.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet.
{@b {@i Powerful Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Dug.

rows: Fair skin, white hair and eyes, remarkable familial similarity.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Echani are characterized by their white skin, hair, and eyes, and their remarkable tendency to look very much alike one another to outside observers, particularly amongst family members. It is thought that their origins stem from Arkanian experimentation on the human genome, a hypothesis that could explain their physical conformity.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: A matriarchal, caste-based society originating from the Inner Rim world of Eshan, the echani spread to encompass a confederacy of six worlds including Bengali and Thyrsus, known as the Six Sisters, governed by the all-female Echani Command.

Echani generals are sometimes seen by others as having the ability to predict their opponent's next move. This is no biologicial trait inherent to the species, but rather stems from the fact that combat is so ingrained into every level of echani culture; the echani hold to the idea that combat is the truest form of communication, and to know someone fully, you must fight them. While their combat rituals require complete {@spell Freedom of Movement|sw5e-phb|freedom of movement} and unarmed martial arts, in warfare, they tend towards {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor} and melee weapons, and are considered excellent craftsmen of such.

entries.name: Names
entries: Echani names tend to lack hard consonants, but are otherwise as variable as human ones. Echani surnames are tied directly to their place in the caste system.
{@b Male Names.} Caelian, Inarin, Losor, Uelis, Yusanis {@b Female Names.} Astri, Brianna, Isena, Raskta, Senriel {@b Surnames.} Authal, Elysi, Fenni, Kinro, Lsu

entries.name: Echani Traits
entries: As an Echani, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Echani reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Echani culture's emphasis on honor and combat cause them to tend towards lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Echani stand between 5 and a half and 6 feet tall and weigh around 150 lbs, with little variation between them. Your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Allies of the Force.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check against someone you know to wield the Force, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Unarmed Combatant.}} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

{@b {@i Echani Art.}} If a humanoid you can see makes a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check against the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}). On a success you learn one of the following traits about that creature: it's Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score; bonus to Strength, Dexterity or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}; {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class}; or current {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. On a failure, the target becomes immune to this feature for one day. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses on a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Combative Culture.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Martial Upbringing.}} You have proficiency in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, and gain proficiency with two martial {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} of your choice.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Esh-kha are a gray-skinned humanoid species with equine features, including muzzles and digitigrade legs. They also have small black eyes.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: In terms of society, their race's culture resembles that of a hive society though each individual retain their own thoughts and aspirations yet all being bred for a specific role that they were eager to fulfill. A caste system is present amongst the esh-kha which included Force-sensitive simple minded savants, more numerous skilled determined warriors that watched over them and finally the patriarchs that acted as leaders who provided their wisdom as well as decisions to their entire people. Esh-kha appear to outsiders as a savage violent species that care only for the destruction of all other races. This hatred for other sentient species is believed to had stemmed from their tightly-knit hive-like society. It is suspected that the esh-kha are simply unable to tolerate or even adapt to the existence of thinking of outsiders who only suffered their wrath. Their race only turns violent against one another in the most extreme of circumstances.

entries.name: Names
entries: Whilst their kind are individuals, esh-kha are not named at birth but instead earn their names through their actions. An esh-kha that displayed great skill in battle could be called "Swift Blade", or maybe "Deadly Cutter" or some other such name. It is believed that this partly explained an esh-kha's zeal in battle with young warriors seeking not only victory but an opportunity to lay claim to a name and forge their own identity. Esh-kha do not use surnames, as they believe they are one family.
{@b Names.} Bleeding Yell, Dormant Heart, Blue Survivor, Ancient Cull, Sharp Grip, Running Sun, Flame Walker

entries.name: Esh-kha Traits
entries: As an esh-kha, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength or Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Esh-kha reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} The esh-kha's stubborn and racially-centric mindsets cause them to tend toward lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Esh-kha typically stand 6 to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Force-Sensitive.}} You know your choice of the {@i turbulence}, {@i force disarm}, or {@i slow} at-will {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment).
{@b {@i Inquisitive.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Savage Attacks.}} When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}.
{@b {@i Skill Versatility.}} You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
{@b {@i Weapon Training.}} You have proficiency in two {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} or {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} of your choice.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kharan. Kharan contains many metaphorical expressions when translated to {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}. The language has many comparisons to music and singing, such as a galactic government being compared to a chorus.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Falleen are distinguished by their mottled green or red skin, ridged skulls, and their long, black hair which they typically wear in ponytails. The sleek symmetry of their features, calculating and cold demeanors, their exotic looks, and their ability to alter their skin pigmentation make the Falleen often considered to be among the most aesthetically pleasing beings in the galaxy. In addition to their strikingly beautiful appearance, the Falleen exude pheromones which makes them all but irresistible to both sexes.
The Falleen are semi-aquatic, being able to hold their breath underwater for an extended period of time. Fallen are one of few species that are resistant to manipulation by the Force.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Falleen society is of a feudal nature, with noble houses ruling over the lower classes. The upper echelons of Falleen aristocracy are rife with politics and intrigue, though they rarely spill blood over disputes or reduce themselves to open warfare.

As a cold-blooded species, the Falleen respect discipline and control, particularly self-control. They tend to shun public displays of emotion, and are very patient. As a result of this attitude, they tend to look down on the more openly passionate, whom they see as lacking self-control. Indeed, the Falleen as a species have a towering sense of superiority, reflecting on their view of Falleen as the civilized and cultural center of the galaxy, rather than Coruscant.

entries.name: Names
entries: Falleen favor names with Z and X sounds. They are usually accompanied by a surname, which is familial.
{@b Male Names.} Xomit, Xizor, Xist, Zenex, Zurros {@b Female Names.} Xora, Trezza, Mylla, Zule, Annaz {@b Surnames.} Grunseit, Croom, Moz, Xiss, Mythric

entries.name: Falleen Traits
entries: As a Falleen, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Falleen reach adulthood in their late teens and live up to 250 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Falleen societal structure causes them to tend to be lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Falleen typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh around 165 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Closed Mind.}} Falleen brains have an unusual composition which make them resistant to influence from the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

{@b {@i Enthralling Pheromones.}} You can use your pheromones to influence individuals of both sexes. Whenever you roll a 1 on a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Additionally, once per short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower on a Charisma check as a 10. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.
{@b {@i Hold Breath.}} You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour at a time.
{@b {@i Mask of the Wild.}} You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Falleen. Falleen is characterized by its common use of the Z and X sounds, of which the Falleen are fond.

rows: Gray, with blue, red, or yellow markings
Extra limb at elbow, innate Force-sensitivity

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Felucians are a tall, bipedal species. Both their arms and legs end in four, large webbed digits with suction-cup fingertips. Springing from the underside of each forearm is a second short arm, ending in three large and agile fingers. A Felucian's head is a thick mass of long flexible tendrils featuring illuminated tips. The eyes and mouth appear as black holes or openings within this mass.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Felucians are mysterious sentient beings native to the vast fungal swamps and jungles of Felucia. Though Felucia has long been colonized, the native Felucians avoided notice by living deep in the jungle. Such seclusion was easily maintained. Even the hardiest of colonists were loath to brave the perils of the dangerous wilderness without cause.

The Felucians are an unusual, amphibious species. They are highly adapted to surviving the wilds of their home planet, and fade easily into its confusing mass of plant life. They are equally at home on land or in the water, and they traverse the swamps with ease.

All Felucians are part of a single, planetwide tribe that is broken down into smaller villages and communities, each one led by shamans and chieftains. These shamans are very strong in the Force, using it to their own ends with incredible skill.

entries.name: Names
entries: Felucian names are usually two syllables and full of hard consonants. Surnames are a combination of tribe lineage.
{@b Male Names.} Gokkuul, Kargrek, Hagark, Ruggorn {@b Female Names.} Lakko, Taarell, Duuna, Frula {@b Surnames.} s'Gokuul, d'Lakko, s'Kargrek, d'Frula

entries.name: Felucian Traits
entries: As a Felucian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Felucians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Felucians' connection to the Living Force causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Felucians typically stand over 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Force-Sensitive.}} You know the {@i burst} at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i beast trick} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i plant surge} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. Wisdom is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for these powers.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.
{@b {@i Stealthy.}} You are proficient in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Mask of the Wild.}} You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Felucianese, and one more language of your choice. Felucianese is characterized by guttural, whisper-like vowels, interspersed with hard clicks.

rows: Horizontal eye stalks, horizontal spade-shaped head, tridactyl hands

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Flesh raiders are a more primitive, and more physically imposing subspecies of rakata that mutated prior to the end of the Infinite Empire. A life above ground and in caves has led the flesh raiders to lose their more amphibian traits, and are now more humanoid in their biological needs, though they seem to only be able to digest meats and flesh.

Flesh raiders keep many of their ancestral rakatan features, though they have experienced a form of gigantism that has lead to their interesting appearance, that of a flat topped, spade shaped head, with blade-like eye stalks coming off the side ends of the spade. Their body structure also more closely matches that of a trandoshan or dashade, being bulky and imposing in stature, towering over most other sentient creatures.
Unlike contemporary rakata, flesh raiders did not lose their ability to tap into the Force.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Flesh raiders are known to form small clan structures, with a war boss in charge of the clan. Those flesh raiders who are born Force-sensitive can be found imitating a temple structure, with a powerful Force-sensitive, usually from another species, leading them.
Flesh raiders still speak the rakatan language, though it has developed into a cruder variant.

entries.name: Names
entries: Flesh  raider names tend to be short and concise, embodying strength and virility. Flesh raider names make no distinction between male and female names. Surnames are clan-based, though they are rarely used.
{@b First Names.} Cha'nagh, Fashk, Gorshh, Keshk, Mar'govrok {@b Surnames.} Ban, Fel, Kuir, Penk, Teeshk

entries.name: Flesh Raider Traits
entries: As a flesh raider, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom or Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Flesh raiders reach adulthoood by 20 and rarely live longer than 90 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Flesh raiders' propensity towards war and aggression cause them to tend toward chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Flesh raiders typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Aggressive.}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

{@b {@i Cannibalize.}} If you spend at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one). Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Force Contention.}} Due to their unique physiology, flesh raider hardiness allows them to overcome use of the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.
{@b {@i Menacing.}} You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Hunters.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check to hunt for food, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rakata. Rakata is characterized by its deep tones and simplistic nature, using mainly consonants and long vowels. It's script seems to be a very ancient form of {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}.

rows: Varying shades of brown, green, and purple

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Gand are sentient, stocky humanoids whose insectoid bodies are covered in a chitinous exoskeleton. The natural armor allow the Gand to shrug off injuries that would cripple most other species. The exoskeleton provides extra protection in the clavicle region, which prevented most nerve or pressure-point strikes to the neck and shoulders. In addition, Gands have the remarkable ability to regrow lost limbs. If a Gand is dismembered, it can regrow a lost limb in a few days.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Gand society places heavy importance on the achievements of an individual and holds that an individual has no name, and thus no worth, until he or she proves otherwise. The speech patterns of Gands utilize third-person self-reference within each level of identity earned. Young or unproven Gands are all called "Gand," as they are considered merely aspects of the same whole. Major accomplishments earn the use of a family surname. Mastering a skill, such as becoming a findsman, allows for the use of the given name, all with third-person self-reference. This manner of speaking is common within the spoken and written Gand language but is more predominant when a Gand speaks Basic; it is often a source of amusement to outsiders.

entries.name: Names
entries: Until a Gand has earned the use of a name, they go simply by the term "Gand." Gand speak in the third person and refer to themselves by name. Often, when a Gand feels shamed, they will stop referring to themselves by their name and revert to calling themselves "Gand" until they prove themselves again. Male and female names are not distinct.
{@b First Names.} C'nyir, Dash, Iglid, Kyuffax, T'rix {@b Surname.} Diqlu, Krakee, Praafri, Quudya, Zooq

entries.name: Gand Traits
entries: As a Gand, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Gand reach adulthood when they earn their name, which is usually in their teens, and live to be about 70 on average.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Gand tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Gand stand 4 to 6 feet tall and weigh around 100 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Exoskeleton.}} You have a thick exoskeleton. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Gand Resilience.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage (explained in chapter 9).
{@b {@i Lungless.}} Gand do not have lungs, and therefore do not need to breathe.

{@b {@i Regenerative.}} When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gand. The Gand language does not use pronouns as Gand refer to themselves in the third person, so often Gand who speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} are difficult to understand.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The ganks are a species of fur-covered carnivores. The typical member of the species has a face that is squared-off and yellow in color, the expression trapped in a perpetual snarl that non-ganks find unattractive. Small, mean-looking eyes peer from above the maw, their head sitting atop a thick neck between broad, strong shoulders. These cap two thickset, powerful arms, which terminate in hands with five fingers each. Their heavy build affords ganks great strength, yet they are also spry runners. They augment their bodies with cybernetics, making them a species of cyborgs.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Precious little is known about gank culture. The exception is that the ganks are fabled for their violent and ruthless nature; even the slightest perceived insult is enough to throw a gank into a violent rage of retaliation. Outsiders similarly know little of the organization of gank society, or whether they have any central rulers at all. What is well known was that the ganks are a war-loving and regimented species, whose members enjoy occupations that allow them to fight and shed blood, such as that of assassin, bodyguard, bounty hunter, and mercenary. They are in particular demand by the hutts, who have enough ganks on retainer to constitute a small army. Their warlike ways and physical strength ranks the ganks among the galaxy's most redoubtable fighters. The species have no compunctions about premeditated murder, which lends them the nickname "Gank Killers."

entries.name: Names
entries: Gank names do not differentiate between genders, and instead of surnames, they give themselves epithets.
{@b First Names.} Darakk, Frent, Shett, Yorrath {@b Epithets.} the Feared, the Keen, the Slayer, the Tough

entries.name: Gank Traits
entries: As a gank, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity or Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Ganks reach adulthood in their late teens and live for slightly more than a century thanks to their cybernetics.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Ganks aggressive and hair trigger nature causes them to tend towards chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Ganks typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet. You ignore the strength property of {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

{@b {@i Aggressive.}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.
{@b {@i Athletic.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Gank Training.}} You have proficiency in light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} as well as two {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} or {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} of your choice.

{@b {@i Mercenary Specialization.}} You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gank. You can communicate with other ganks within 30 feet without speaking through use of cybernetic implants. Tech casters can detect the communication but can—t understand it.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Geonosians have a hard chitin exoskeleton that provided protection from physical impacts and bouts of radiation that occasionally shower their world. Geonosians are strong despite their thin builds, and are capable of constructing massive hives and factories in concert. The head of a Geonosian is elongated and large with their skulls ridged on the top and by the side where they have bulbous, thick-lidded eyes. Both are physically strong and covered with bony ridges which protected their arms, legs, and vital organs.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Geonosian society is caste-based with little upward mobility, though some of the lower caste do develop ambition. Workers are conditioned to loathe even the concept of separation from their hive and the system of control. A low-ranking worker's normal life is one of endless toil and labor to satisfy the aristocracy, who are known to make spectacular demands. The warrior caste tend to be highly competitive and are eager to prove themselves. They are born with an abnormal level of intelligence, and one of their only hopes of escape from their rigid duty is entering voluntarily into gladiatorial combat. Should they survive, they are granted freedom. Ultimately, their society exist to benefit those few members that reside in the upper caste. Members of the aristocratic classes are known to be ambitious, domineering, and manipulative. They constantly move towards improving their standing and holdings while sumultaneously working to ruin their rivals.

entries.name: Names
entries: Geonosian names are usually harsh sounding. Lower castes don't get surnames. Upper caste surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Buck, Goshey, Nik, Sozz, Techtu {@b Female Names.} Datte, Kida, Miri, Nare, Tenessi {@b Surnames.} Chak, Hor, Lur, Marpes, Zol

entries.name: Geonosian Traits
entries: As a geonosian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} You Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution or Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Geonosians reach adulthood at 10 and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Geonosians' greedy and self-serving nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Geonosians typically stand from 5 to 6 feet tall and rarely weigh more than 80 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Crafter.}} Geonosian culture promotes artisanry. You have proficiency in one set of artisan's implements of your choice.
{@b {@i Exoskeleton.}} You have a thick exoskeleton. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Flight.}} You have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.
{@b {@i Geonosian Weaponry.}} You have proficiency in {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} that deal sonic damage.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Geonosian. The Geonosian language consists of click consonants through use of a Geonosians' dual mandibles. This makes it difficult for other species to learn to speak it.

rows: Skeletal appearance, able to survive in a vacuum for short periods

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Givin are a species of white-skinned, hairless humanoids who are quite frequently likened to animated skeletons. Their facial features include many sharp downward angles, large triangular eye sockets, and sloped-up brows that meet together in the middle, lending them an appearance of permanent anguish. Because of the harsh environment of their homeworld, the Givins' organs are sealed against atmospheric exposure; thanks to this complex system, they can survive for about a day in a vacuum.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: In order to survive their homeworld's lunar tides, the Givin became extremely adept at calculating the trajectory of their celestial bodies. Over the ages, Givin have become so skilled at celestial navigation that they are able to calculate hyperspace jumps in their heads. As such, mathematics have become a cornerstone of Givin society. Two Givin will often greet each other by exchanging complex equations for the other to solve.

Due to their profound mathematical ability, Givin are skilled starship builders and astrogators. They create some of the most impressive, complex, and sleek ships in the galaxy. However, they frequently build their ships without the presence of a navcomputer or pressurization system, and so their buyers have to add these system in the starship aftermarket.

entries.name: Names
entries: Givin names are often derived by parents from favored mathematical equations. Male and female names do not significantly differ. Surnames are familial.
{@b First Names.} Daggibus, Lersia, Na-Soth, Nisil, Sladru {@b Surnames.} Alarin, Nalas, Narth, Larr, Scoritoles

entries.name: Givin Traits
entries: As a Givin, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Givin reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Givins believe power and respect are earned rather than expected, causing them to tend towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Givin typically stand around 6 feet tall and weigh 150 lb. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Hardened Exterior.}} You have a tough, bony exterior. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Mathematical Savants.}} Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check involving mathematics, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Stargazer.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Vacuum Sealed.}} You can survive for one day within the vacuum of space. You still require oxygen to breathe. You have resistance to cold damage.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Givin. Givin is characterized by its use of mathematical jargon and symbols, making it nigh incomprehensible to the less mathematically inclined.

rows: Frills on the face and body

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The gormak are green humanoids with flat, noseless faces adorned with frills, collecting in whorls on the sides of their heads. They have clawed, three-fingered, frilled hands, and tend to possess a muscular build. Females are slightly shorter than males and lacked a whorl located above their nose.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: An aggressive species, the gormak hold an innate love of warfare and competition, and are extremely hostile towards the other natives of their planet, the voss. The gormak hold a belief that in order for them to prosper, the voss, whom they view as a plague on the planet, must be destroyed. To achieve that goal, warriors have repeatedly assaulted the voss capital city over the course of centuries; however, despite their far greater numbers, their nature has kept them from uniting against their enemy. While their society and speech are considered primitive by galactic standards, their innate talent with technology rivals the top minds of the galaxy. From bits of scavenged electronics and equipment, the gormak construct advanced tools, heavy machinery, specialized weapons and even cybernetic implants. However, despite their incredible affinity for technology, the gormak remain a pre-spaceflight culture confined to their homeworld, which causes them to be viewed as a backward species despite being perfectly capable of repairing, modifying and improving tech created by more advanced cultures.

entries.name: Names
entries: Gormak are commonly named after heroes of their history by local shamans. Surnames are tribe-based, but optional.
{@b Male Names.} Damal, Henet, Wockuss, Yryu, Zenit {@b Female Names.} Finay, Heidith, Jhekon, Rakva, Sanas {@b Surnames.} -Du, -Fo, -Qa, -Ry, -Ve

entries.name: Gormak Traits
entries: As a gormak, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Gormaks reach adulthood in their late teens and live for more than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Gormaks' warlike nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Gormaks typically stand 5 and a half to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Adaptive Resilience.}} Their innate understanding of technology allow gormak to readily adapt to its effects. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

{@b {@i Aggressive.}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Technological Affinity.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill, one {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} and one {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} of your choice, and your choice of {@item Armstech's implements|sw5e-phb|armstech's implements}, {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements}, constructor's implements, mechanic's kits, or {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) checks made to understand, utilize, or modify technology that you are unaware of or have never seen before.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gormak. Gormak is primitive and gruff, often lacking definitions for things found outside of their homeworld.

rows: Red, orange, yellow, grey, green, or black
Full body fur, flat noses, head cones

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Gotals possess cranial horns as receptors to sense electromagnetism and other energy emissions. These nerve-ending filled cones can sense the natural electromagnetic fields produced by Antar 4's magnetite-rich crust, allowing the species to operate even in total darkness. Their senses also pick up the electromagnetic auras from other life forms. When close to their hunting targets, they can ascertain information on its mood, awareness, and state of mind. Electronic devices can also be sensed by Gotals; in fact, most droids give off enough electromagnetic emissions to at least annoy a Gotal, and at worst to seriously disorient the horned beings, making them notoriously distrustful of droids. Gotals rely heavily on their cones, with their eyesight and hearing being quite weak, and their sense of smell almost completely absent.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Since their natural empathy makes them instantly sensitive to the feelings of others, Gotals have little use for government or laws on their homeworld, resulting in problems when dealing with other societies. No central authority figure can speak for Antar 4 as a whole in a crisis, and no organized Gotal military or police force can act on their behalf. Other species respect the Gotals for their discretion and restraint, but some individuals fear interacting with the horned beings for fear of having their emotional state revealed to others.

entries.name: Names
entries: Gotal names are quite guttural, though there are also many harsher tones within their names. Gotal names do not vary significantly based on gender, and surnames are familial.
{@b First Names.} Thon, Fern, Fuu'rash, Jir, Vluphol {@b Surnames.} Gratlul, Klux, Vathon, Zilat, Krigh, Rahxem

entries.name: Gotal Traits
entries: As a Gotal, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Gotals reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Gotals' polite and respectful nature causes them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Gotals typically stand 6 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Energy Sensors.}} Gotals perceive the environment around them through use of electromagnetic sensors held in their cranial horns. You have {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} out to 30 feet. If another trait would grant you {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight}, the range is increased by half as many feet.
{@b {@i Hunter.}} You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Natural Empathy.}} Gotal's electromagnetic sensors allow them to sense the emotions in those around them. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Antarian. The Antarian language is characterized by growls and clicking noises at various volumes.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Gran can easily be identified by their three eyes and their goat-like snout. Female Gran also have three breasts. They have excellent vision, able to resolve more colors than most species, and even able to see into the infrared, thus they are able to sense one another's emotions and disposition by noting subtle changes in body heat and skin color. Gran have two stomachs, having evolved from herbivorous grazing animals who lived in herds on the mountains and highlands of Kinyen. A single meal can take almost an entire day to finish, after that a Gran does not often need to eat for several days.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The peaceful nature of Gran society is a reflection of their homeworld, Kinyen. Kinyen boasted large and rolling grasslands and highlands, a dense and beautiful forest, and one of the longest and clearest rivers in the Bes Ber Bikade sector. The beauty of this planet, and the need for primitive Gran to band together for defense against predatory animals, helped the Gran develop strong bonds of home and family in their society.

The Grans are also very protective of their families, and were some of the most devoted parents in the galaxy. This is because of their very powerful and sensitive sight, which can sense the emotions of their mates and their children. Gran society maintains its balance by setting up strict career quotas, and making sure young Gran are educated for a specific job that best served his or her talents.

entries.name: Names
entries: Gran names typically are monosyllabic and accompanied by a surname, which is familial.
{@b Male Names.} Ask, Dree, Ree, Pax, Nic {@b Female Names.} Yan, Alijia, Meeb, Sir, Zeek {@b Surnames.} Moe, Leem, Yees, Wix, Naaq

entries.name: Gran Traits
entries: As a Gran, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Gran reach adulthood around their late teens and live up to 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Gran highly organized society cause them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions..
{@b {@i Size.}} Gran typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh around 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Slow Metabolism.}} You are able to go a number of days without food equal to 3 + twice your Constitution modifier before suffering {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.
{@b {@i Keen Sight.}} Through use of infrared vision, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight.

{@b {@i Reader of Hearts.}} Through identifying subtle variations in a target's body heat, the Gran are able to better understand their emotions and intentions. You are proficient in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Toughness.}} Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gran. It is rare to hear Gran spoken on any world other than Kinyen.

rows: Keen Smell Sunlight Sensitivity Tooth and Nail

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The appearance and biological features of half-humans vary drastically by each species, but tend to fall somewhere in the middle. A common side-effect of a species interbreeding with humans is the loss of {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} and tails.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Half-humans are subjects of two separate cultures, but belong in neither. A half-human might be raised amongst humans or their other half, or might be fully ostracized, instead growing up in a remote, isolated place, removed from both species.

entries.name: Traits
entries: Half-humans gain the {@b {@i Defiant}} special trait from their human half. They also gain the special traits from their non-human half, except for those trait(s) mentioned in the Half-Human table above.

entries.name: Names
entries: Half-human names might follow human conventions, or that of the other half. Often, they blend the two in some fashion, perhaps taking a human surname, with a special name.

entries.name: Half-human Traits
entries: As a half-human, you have the following special traits.

{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Half-humans gain the ability score increases of their non-human half, but they can choose any ability score for one of the options, instead of the given option. Half-humans can not increase the same ability score twice during character creation using this feature.
{@b {@i Age.}} Half-humans live around the average of the two species' lifespans.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Half-humans tend towards their non-human half's alignment.
{@b {@i Size.}} Half-humans stand and weigh around the average of the two species' height and weight. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is the size of your non-human half.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is that of your non-human half.

{@b {@i Defiant.}} Half-humans are known to be stubborn and often refuse to give up, even against the worst odds. When you or a creature you can see that can see and understand you makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add it to their roll (no action required). You can use this before or after the roll, but before the GM determines the roll's outcome. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, regardless of whether or not the non-human half can speak it, and the language(s) associated with your non-human half.

rows: Spider-like with six eyes, eight limbs and chelicerae

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Harch possess a large-fanged mouth between two prominent chelicerae, above which they have six red eyes arranged in a semicircle. The two lowest eyes are larger and roughly twice the size of the four smaller eyes. Harch walk on two legs and have six arms, with the second and third set of arm protruding from behind the first pair rather than directly above or below them. These arms are covered in thick hair and end in three-fingered hands.

The Harch are distantly related to the Aqualish species and there is much debate among geneticists regarding the relationship between the Harch and the Aqualish Ualaq subspecies. However, the Harch themselves considered such discussions to be obscene.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Not much is known about the Harch, as few of them have mingled with the galactic community, preferring to stay on Secundus Ando. Harch that leave the planet tend to have a more aspirant nature than their fellows, and often reach great heights in their chosen professions in the galaxy. Such Harch are considered outliers—most apparently care little for titles.
Like the Arcona species, female Harch are seen as more domineering and aggressive than their male counterparts. It is not unheard of for a male Harch to raise entire broods of hatchlings alone.

entries.name: Names
entries: Harch names are not gender-specific. Harch do not use surnames.
{@b Names.} Cubach, Quixoch, Trench, Turch

entries.name: Harch Traits
entries: As a Harch, you have the following special traits: {@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength, Constitution, and Intelligence scores increase by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Harch reach adulthood at age 10 and can live up to 200 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Harch are cold, calculating beings, causing them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Harch stand around 6 feet tall and weigh between 200 and 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Bite.}} Your fangs are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special bite attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, the target is {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} until the end of its next turn, and you can't use this feature again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Six-Armed.}} Harch have six arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

{@b {@i Spider Climb.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing, and while climbing you always have two hands free.

{@b Languages.} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Harchese. Harchese is discernible from other insectoid languages by a noticeable emphasis on consonants, especially the "ch" sound.

rows: Black, gray, pale blue, pale pink

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The herglic are a massive race of creatures descended from aquatic mammals, breathing though a blowhole on top of their heads. They are tall and wide, and have smooth, hairless skin that ranged in color from pale blue to black, though some rare individuals may appear pink or have white markings on their sides. Their girth tends to leave them feeling out of place among smaller species; herglic tend to take up two chairs or fill the entire doorway of any establishment they enter that does not cater to beings their size.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The herglics are very technologically advanced, developing space flight and hyperdrives and colonizing their sector of the galaxy prior to the formation of the Galactic Republic. Natural explorers and traders, they sailed the cosmos establishing crucial trade routes and gaining prestige. Despite their size, herglic are surprisingly dexterous while working with tools, and are some of the finest engineers in the galaxy.

Herglics have an inquisitive but practical nature, enjoying travel and having exotic experiences. Their perpetually calm demeanor  helps them interact with most other species peacefully, though when dealing with smaller species, herglics tend to become nervous and self-conscious about their proportions. They also seem to have an innate predilection for gambling and games of chance, which have gotten more than one herglic into trouble on several occasions.

entries.name: Names
entries: Male names are typically harsher sounding than female names. Herglics rarely use surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Biglu, Melchi, Sehvorah {@b Female Names.} Mahg-Raet, Seese, Uddn

entries.name: Herglic Traits
entries: As a herglic, you have the following special traits: {@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Herglic reach adulthood in their late teens and live up to 120 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Herglics' gentle nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Herglic stand between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh up to 600 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Hold Breath.}} You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour at a time.
{@b {@i Powerful Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.
{@b {@i Technician.}} You are proficient in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Toughness.}} Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Herglese. Herglese has a clear and commanding cadence, drawing the attention of those who hear it.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Ho'dins are tall humanoids with multi-colored skin, naturally webbed and suction cup-tipped fingers and toes, and temperature-sensing red-violet "snake hair". Ho'dins are, on average, over nine feet tall—nearly a full head taller than wookiees. Renowned throughout the galaxy as botanists and healers, the ho'din claim an ancestry derived from the plants of their home planet, Moltok—in fact, "ho'din" translates as "walking flower" in {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}. They are, in fact, reptilian, as their natural climbing skills and cold-bloodedness seem to indicate, and boast a second heart to enhance their survivability. Their "snake hair" is temperature-sensitive, allowing ho'din to sense changes in ambient temperature.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Ho'dins are known to be self-conscious and vain, particularly when it comes to their looks and their work, and do not take criticism or insults well. Their religion, Dinante Fli'R, is centered around worshipping and communing with nature, a trait that has sent many ho'din out into the galaxy to rejuvenate damaged planets. The ho'din have an aversion to technology and avoid surface mining and manufacturing, opting instead to dwell in trees. They have learned to make incredibly advanced pharmaceuticals and gardens using their botanical skills to concoct natural medicines, some of which have cured plagues on distant worlds. The title of "Master Gardener" is one of high esteem and great respect in ho'din society.

entries.name: Names
entries: Ho'din names are quite diverse. Some names look complicated and difficult to pronounce, while others are quite simple. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Baji, Gra'tau, Iwo, Oojoh, Thrung, Vala {@b Female Names.} Chela, Kutu, Lohje, Par'tah, Sirta, Tal {@b Surnames.} Alewune, Kulko, Oolos, Plett, Ustu, Wen

entries.name: Ho'Din Traits
entries: As a ho'din, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Ho'din reach adulthood in their early 30s and live up to 120 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Ho'dins' benevolent nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Ho'din are taller than most species, typically standing 8 to 10 feet tall and generally weighing about 275 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Biological Specialists.}} You have proficiency with {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

{@b {@i Cold Sensitivity.}} You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold.
{@b {@i Crafters.}} You have proficiency with one artisan's implements of your choice.
{@b {@i Naturalist.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Rain Forest Dweller.}} Growing up in the rain forests of Moltok has left an impact. You don't treat forest terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

{@b {@i Reptilian Senses.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sensing heat, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Second Heart.}} When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Treeclimber.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, and Ho'Din. Ho'Din consists of croaks and hisses. Its written form includes characters derived from the shapes of Moltok flora. The Ho'Din lexicon includes a great amount of plant-based idioms and metaphors.

rows: Violet to blue, or yellow to brown
Thick skull, large stature, great physical strength

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Houk are hulking bipeds with thick skin, hairless heads marked with bony ridges and a pronounced brow, flabby jowls, beady yellow eyes, and no visible ears or nose. They are very powerful due to their large bulk of pure muscle.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The houk have well-earned reputations as bullies, cheaters, and backstabbers. They are often compared to wookiees because of their great strength and violent disposition. Houk are humorless, short-tempered beings who use their strength to antagonize weaker beings. Their propensity for deceit and skulduggery is matched only by the hutts. Though their tempers are not as explosive as those of wookiees, houk are known for their tendency to solve problems violently. In politics, they will often wage war without formal declarations, negotiate in bad faith, and ignore treaties. Though this preference for violence tend to cause the houk problems in dealing with other societies, it often gets them what they want. Surprisingly though, in personal combat, houk prefer to use stealth rather than direct confrontation. This gives them a reputation for deceit and cowardice. However, just as each houk colony has a different culture and government, houk individuals have varied personalities. Though all houk come from a culture with high levels of corruption and violence, many houk are hard workers who have learned to get along with other sentients. The houk produce little technology of their own, though they adapt themselves to the standard technology of the rest of the galaxy.

entries.name: Names
entries: Houk names are gruff and primitive in nature, and don't vary by gender.
{@b First Names.} Agamor, Krelba, Morg, Roath {@b Surnames.} Krin, Nar, Vogog, Voss

entries.name: Houk Traits
entries: As a houk, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Houk reach adulthood in their late teens and live for about 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Most houk are short-tempered and deceitful, causing them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Houk typically stand 6 to 8 feet tall and generally weigh about 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Ambusher.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Powerful Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.
{@b {@i Surprise Attack.}} If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.
{@b {@i Toughness.}} Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Houkese. Houkese is mainly formed by grunts, with subtle tonal inflections to differentiate words that would otherwise sound the same. Written Houkese uses primitive ideograms with one letter to represent each simple verb, and complex pictograms to represent nouns.

rows: Black, blue, brown, gold, green, purple, tan, white, or yellow
Blue, gray, green, orange, turquoise, violet, or yellow

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Hutts are a massive slug-like species who have large mouths and stubby arms. They have three lungs and thick leathery skin, which is wrinkled and slimy. Hutts often have watery eyes and lack facial expressions.  Their tails are supported by a skeletal spine.  Despite their legendary size, hutts start out as tiny huttlets less than half a foot in height, and continually grow over the long lives.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Most hutts are crime lords who live opulent lives overseeing criminal underworld activities like spice smuggling, slavery, gambling and bounty hunting. This is not true for all, however, as some eschew the life of a decadent, obese version of their species and prefer a more mobile existence. Hutt society is divided into families known as kajidics, a social structure that is both familial and a crime gang.

Hutts are encouraged to make a name for themselves around the age of 150 while simultaneously not threatening the welfare of the clan.  At around 200, they will likely stop being saved by the clan and encouraged even further to fend for themselves while benefiting the kajidic; they may even be granted a star system or two.  Nomadic or kajidic-less hutts are often hunted or killed by other hutts in fear of the nomad coming to claim a territory.

entries.name: Names
entries: Hutt names with a suffix title as "the Hutt" are usually reserved for noteworthy huts, with the name of a hutt's kajidic coming before the title.  Because hutts are hermaphroditic, choosing a gender at will, their names are considered androgynous.
{@b First Names.} Arok, Gorga, Jabba, Mama, Ziro, {@b Kajidic Names.} Besadii, Desilijic, Fenn'ak, Gnuda

entries.name: Hutt Traits
entries: As a hutt you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Hutts are considered a child until around the age of 200 in which they are a full fledged adult.  Hutts can live upwards of 900 years with even more ancient ones exceeding that.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Hutts are selfish, greedy, and highly organized, causing them to tend toward chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.

{@b {@i Size.}} Hutts have a unique special characteristic; from birth to death, they never stop growing. As an adolescent hutt, you typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh at least 400 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 20 feet.

{@b {@i Closed Mind.}} Hutt brains have an unusual composition which made them resistant to influence from the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

{@b {@i Natural Resistance.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage (explained in chapter 9).
{@b {@i Powerful Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.
{@b {@i Prehensile Tail.}} You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.
{@b {@i Shrewd Demeanor.}} You have proficiency in two Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skills of your choice.

{@b {@i Slow and Lethargic.}} Hutts are slow and generally incapable of moving quickly. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when determining your bonus to AC from your Dexterity, you can't add more than +3.
{@b {@i Wealthy.}} During character creation, you start with additional credits equal to your level x your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} x 1,000 cr.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}. Hutts rarely speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, even though they are perfectly able; if the person with whom they are speaking doesn't understand {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}, they are more likely to use an interpretor than deign to speak the language of lesser species.

rows: Horns, {@spell Precognition|sw5e-phb|precognition}, telepathy, thick pink skin

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Iktotchi do not have hair, but rather they had a very resistant skin which protected them from the violent winds which crossed the satellite. Both males and females have down-curved cranial horns, which gave them an aggressive aspect. The males' horns are generally a little larger, a remnant from their mountain-dwelling, caprinaen ancestors. The horns are able to regenerate if damaged.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Iktotchi are a fiercely guarded and isolationist species - vaunted for their ability to hide their feelings and bury any semblance of emotion. Originating on the harsh, windy moon of Iktotch, which orbits the planet Iktotchon in the Expansion Region, the Iktotch are gifted with {@spell Precognition|sw5e-phb|precognition}, and are courted as often by Jedi as by pirates for their skills.

Iktotchi society is a stratified society. Upward mobility is both possible and encouraged. Iktotchi are an outwardly dispassionate people, which is evidenced by their culture. They have a robust legal system, and suffer little crime. Iktotchi are respectful of cultures other than their own and can easily integrate with others.

Iktotchi who distinguish themselves often earn a titular nickname, by which they are referred to in place of their name. Generally, this is done by accomplishing a remarkable feat that benefits the Iktotchi as whole.

entries.name: Names
entries: Iktotchi names are generally two syllables. Surnames are familial. Respected Iktotchi often adopt a nickname, which they use in place of their birth name.
{@b Male Names.} Dilnam, Imruth, Kashkil, Yellam {@b Female Names.} Kemkal, Onyeth, Reshu, Zorlu {@b Surnames.} Hevil, Kaawi, Mimir, Nudaal, Zelend

entries.name: Iktotchi Traits
entries: As an Iktotchi, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Iktotchi reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Iktotchi are lawful and tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Iktotchi typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Precognition.}} You can see brief fragments of the future, that allow you to turn failures into successes. When you roll a 1 on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
{@b {@i Telepathy.}} You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet of you. You must share a language with the target in order to communicate in this way.

{@b {@i Horns.}} Your horns are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.
