{@b {@i Pilot.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Iktotchese.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The kage are a pale-skinned sentient species native to the caverns in the planet of Quarzite. The kage have a long-time conflict with the belugans, consistently at odds with them. During the Clone Wars, Otua Blank ordered the capture of Pluma Sodi to marry her, she was later given back to the Kage Warriors by Asajj Ventress.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The kage are a dedicated people of physical excellence; they train tireless and elite fighter-monks known as Kage warriors. They tend to use weapons with electric or disruptive properties, but they are also great fighters in unarmed combat. Kage warriors are respected in Kage society as the greatest calling a kage might follow.

Kage also share an affinity with animals, most notably the native multi-legged milodon, developing a symbiotic relationship. They use the milodon as transport; they can keep pace with the subtram transports that supply belugan strongholds, and launch raids that often catch the belugan security forces off-guard.

entries.name: Names
entries: Kage names are generally multisyllable with melodic intonations. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Baalin, Forta, Krismo, Rafa, Timko {@b Female Names.} Chena, Fari, Moora, Ooni, Pluma {@b Surnames.} Buno, Keeli, Nima, Sodi, Tani

entries.name: Kage Traits
entries: As a kage, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kage reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Kages' rigid sense of honor causes them to tend toward lawful light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Kage typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall, and weigh around 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Animal Handler.}} You are proficient in {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Athletic.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Strong-Legged.}} When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

{@b {@i Sunlight Sensitivity.}} You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

{@b {@i Superior Darkvision.}} You've lived most of your life without direct sunlight. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Unarmed Combatant.}} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.
{@b {@i Weapon Training.}} Kage are adept warriors. You are proficient with the electroprod and electrostaff.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice.

rows: Bone masks, elongated ears, flat nose, tusks

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Tusks protrude from a Kaleesh's upper jaw, and shorter ones jut from their chins. Kaleesh have large pointed ears and long nostrils that stretched close to their eyes. They have very keen olfactory sense and were able to produce pheromones. Most of their facial features are obscured behind the traditional masks they wear, and outsiders rarely see Kaleesh unmasked. They are known to practice polygyny, a form of polygamy, where a male courts multiple wives.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Kaleesh society is divided into numerous autonomous tribes. War is viewed as an essential and sacred practice, and the culture's large emphasis on honor is known to spur many acts of vengeance among the various tribes. However, when necessary, the tribes will put aside their differences and bond to fend off a common enemy.

The Kaleesh are a spiritual people, believing that those who perform great deeds in life became gods in death; therefore, burial places are sacred to them. A large number of temples are devoted to their ancestor gods, the holiest of which was called Shrupak.
Abesmi, a great monolith of stone in the Jenuwaa Sea, is the place the Kaleesh believed the gods ascended to the heavens. Pilgrims take the perilous voyage to Abesmi to beseech the gods.

entries.name: Names
entries: Male Kaleesh names are typically one syllable while female are two. Kaleesh surnames are tribal and often use two words.
{@b Male Names.} Bir, Grost, Jick, Xygh, Yles {@b Female Names.} Dduzu, Glaglo, Runda, Yugdo, Zodey {@b Surnames.} Jal Greennath, Lij Jum, San Syrro,

entries.name: Kaleesh Traits
entries: As a Kaleesh, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kaleesh reach adulthood in their early teens and live to be about 80.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Kaleesh tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Kaleesh typically stand about five and a half feet tall and weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} The thermal pits under a Kaleesh's eyes grant {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Weapon Training.}} Kaleesh are adept hunters. You are proficient with the {@item Blaster carbine|sw5e-phb|blaster carbine}, {@item Vibroblade|sw5e-phb|vibroblade}, {@item Vibropike|sw5e-phb|vibropike}, and, {@item Vibrospear|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Keen Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

{@b {@i Tracker.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill. Additionally, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) checks made to track a creature if that creature has a scent.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kaleesh.

If you have questions, concerns, or you notice a typo, post it here!

entries.name: Typos
entries: None so far.
|Kalloran|Keen Hearing|

entries.name: Design Insights
entries: Kalloran are an aquatic species, similar to nautolans or quarren, with excellent physical stats. I would probably build this as a close-quarters, {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} martial character (probably fighter or maybe berserker) and take {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} of the light- and vibro-weapons that have Dexterity requirements.

entries.name: FAQ

entries: What will this species lose to half-human?
Kalloran will lose Keen Hearing.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Kallerans evolved from a semi-amphibious species on Kaller. Kallerans are tall and flexible; their hands and feet have three prehensile digits on each, which leeds kallerans to avoid wearing shoes or boots. The majority of kallerans have green skin patterned with distinctive black stripes. The species have dense muscles that assist them in the protection of their otherwise delicate bodies. The kalleran head is distinguished by fin-like folds on the tops and sides of their faces. These fins augment a kalleran's hearing, allowing sound to bounce back and be picked up by the two antenna crowning their head. These antenna are sensory organs that serve as olfactory and aural receptors. Kallerans have lungs adapted to breathe above water, though the majority of their respiration is done through their skin. A holdover from their amphibious past, their skin can draw oxygen in from the air and filter out carbon dioxide. Their respiratory system requires them to consume more water than other species their size to keep their skin moist and supple. Because they do not primarily breathe through their mouths, kallerans did not evolve noses.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Above all else, kalleran's value personal achievement over collective accomplishments. Because of this, the people of Kaller have never united to form great societies or participate in galactic affairs. Much of the cultural expansion on Kaller was brought by colonists, both friendly and violent, who had settled the world over the course of millennia.

entries.name: Names
entries: Kallerans have regal sounding names, sometimes using accents on vowels, with clan-based surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Gliconn, Orcas, L—vern, Seelv—n {@b Female Names.} Cybele, F—ress, Numarin, Retesh {@b Surnames.} Alash, Byssus, Estair, Lash

entries.name: Kalleran Traits
entries: As a kalleran, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kallerans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Kallerans' individualistic society causes them to tend towards chaotic alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Kallerans typically stand 6 and a half to 8 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.
{@b {@i Flexible.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve flexibility.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing.
{@b {@i Prehensile Feet.}} You have supreme control over your feet and can use them to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

{@b {@i Snap Senses.}} Through your antenna, you can sense incoming danger and react accordingly. When you roll for {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, you can choose to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Alternatively, if you are surprised, you may act normally on your first turn. Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kall. Kall depends upon distinct antenna movements communicate correctly. This leads to this characteristic antenna movement when kallerans speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}. Because antenna movement is an integral part of Kall, it is difficult for most other species to master.

rows: Very tall, long limbs, long necks

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Kaminoans' evolution from aquatic creatures in the vast oceans of Kamino is reflected in their tall shape, glassy coated eyes, near luminescent skin, and long, thin necks. The almond-shaped eyes of kaminoans are also able to see color in the ultraviolet spectrum. While female kaminoans are bald, males possess headcrests and fin ridges along the rear of their small, bulbous skulls.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The kaminoans see themselves as a superior form of life, but nevertheless remained polite to outsiders. To them any species seeking self-improvement is worthy of respect, but those who do not are obviously inferior; self-improvement has a central role in Kaminoan society. Through the development and mastery of selective breeding, genetics, and cloning, the kaminoans were able to overcome a cataclysm that pushed them to the brink of extinction.

Kaminoans live in a caste based society, determined by the color of the kaminoan's eyes. Gray eyed individuals handle administration and are considered of the highest-level caste; middle castes had yellow eyes and handle the skilled work; and lower castes had blue eyes and perform manual labor and other menial tasks. Although it is extremely rare, kaminoans are sometimes born with green eyes. Those are viewed as genetically inferior and as a threat to the kaminoans' well ordered society and as such are exterminated shortly after birth.

entries.name: Names
entries: Kaminoan names typically are composed by around two syllables and a brief surname.
{@b Male Names.} Lama, Ni, Orun, Koa {@b Female Names.} Taun, Ko, Nala, Kina {@b Surnames.} Ha, Su, We, Sai, Wa

entries.name: Kaminoan Traits
entries: As a kaminoan, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2 and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kaminoans reach adulthood at 11 years old and live around 100 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Kaminoans highly organized society lead individuals to tend toward a lawful alignment, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}}  Kaminoans typically stand 7 to 8 feet tall and weigh around 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Geneticist.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Long-Limbed.}} When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

{@b {@i Tech Dabbler.}} You know the {@i temporary boost} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for this power.

{@b {@i Ultraviolet Sight.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sight, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kaminoan. Kaminoan is characterized by its flowing water-like sound.

rows: Multiple rows of sharp teeth, powerful jaws, shark-like heads

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The amphibious Karkarodons have tall, slim bodies with webbed hands and feet. Their shark-like heads have pointed noses, gill slits, and many rows of razor-sharp teeth, which they use when attacking and eating. Karkarodons are skilled and fast swimmers. They attack by grabbing the target and used their jaws for ripping and tearing.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Karkarodons hail from the planet Karkaris, which is located in a star system neighboring the planet Mon Cala. They harbor an intense hatred for the Mon Calamari and Quarren inhabitants. The planet is almost entirely under water, and is very uninviting to non-Karkarodons.

Karkarodon culture is a warmongering, strength-based culture. Clans often fight eachother for dominance, natural resources, and to cull the weak. Each clan on the planet has a ruling triumvirate, usually comprised of venerated warriors who rule for life. When a younger Karkarodon wants to replace one of the ruling body, they challenge them to single, mortal combat. Occasionally, the challenged may spare the life of the challenger when they win, though that usually leads to resentment from the loser.
Karkarodons do not believe in lying or duplicity. They believe in approaching problems head on and saying what they mean, and are generally demeaing towards those they deem their lessers.

entries.name: Names
entries: Karkarodon names are harsh and gutteral. They are generally one syllable. Surnames are clan-based rather than familial.
{@b Male Names.} Aurb, Rend, Riff, Trak, Vour {@b Female Names.} Dewb, Garr, Rast, Scrat, Zend {@b Surnames.} Alben, Gerdall, Kibben, Tamson, Zendall

entries.name: Karkarodon Traits
entries: As a karkarodon, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kakarodon reach adulthood in their early teens and live to be about 70.

{@b {@i Alignment.}} Karkarodons' warmongering nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions {@b {@i Size.}} Karkarodons stand 5 to 7 feet tall and weigh upwards of 250 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Aggressive.}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.

{@b {@i Bite.}} Your sharp teeth are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special bite attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1), and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Karkaran. Karkaran is characterized by its fierce sounds.

rows: Orange, brown, green, blue, or gray

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The kiffar are very closely related to humans, enough that they can interbreed, though kiffar typically have darker hair. The biggest visual difference between the two is that the kiffar always wear tattoos, that represent their clan. Kiffar are more likely to be Force-sensitive, which is typically manifested in {@spell Psychometry|sw5e-phb|psychometry}, a rare {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that about one percent of the kiffar population can use. Using {@spell Psychometry|sw5e-phb|psychometry}, kiffar can touch objects and receive visions from the Force that show them the object—s past.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The kiffar reside on the planets of Kiffu and Kiffex. Kiffar are a people who value their own independence, staying out of galactic affairs and being ruled only by themselves. They see outsiders as dangerous and are generally nationalists. They are organized into clans, and clan heritage is very important to them. Their markings, which they call qukuuf, are passed down through the family maternally, but kiffar with a human mother will typically use their father—s tattoos. Conversely, clan membership is passed down paternally, and those with a human father can join their mother—s clan. The traditional colors of the facial tattoos are red, yellow, and green. Various patterns and designs are used to identify the clan.

Kiffu Guardians, also known as the Guardians of Kiffu, are an important kiffar institution that acts as a police force in their space. The Kiffu Guardians wear black armor, and they share a symbol with clan Vos, which is a gold five-pointed star outlined by a circle.

entries.name: Names
entries: Kiffar use names similar to those of humans, varying drastically clan by clan. Surnames are familiar.
{@b Male Names.} Kurros, Sathran, Vis, Ziflos {@b Female Names.} Grai, Ian—, Kinnas, Sonti {@b Surnames.} Gov, Keffane, Mullisa, Vel

entries.name: Kiffar Traits
entries: As a kiffar, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom or Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kiffar reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Kiffar are independent and free spirited, causing them to tend towards chaotic alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Kiffar vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Iron Will.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed}.

{@b {@i Nimble Reflexes.}} Kiffar are naturally adapted to avoiding the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.
{@b {@i Tribal Warrior.}} You have proficiency with two {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} of your choice.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice. Kiffar never had a tongue to call their own, using {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} as far back as their history goes.

{@b {@i Kiffar Heritage.}} A small percentage of the kiffar population are naturally Force-sensitive, able to read the memories contained within inanimate objects, while others train to become proud guardians of their home sector. You choose one of the following heritages:

items: {@b Paladin.} You have proficiency with light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} as well as the electrobaton and one {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} of your choice. Additionally, you have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.

{@b Sage.} You learn and can cast the {@i telemetry} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i psychometry} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for these powers.

rows: Brown, chestnut, green, red, scarlet, or yellow
Chitinous armor, mandibles projected from face, four arms ending in long three toed claws protrude from their torsos

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Killiks possess a strong chitinous exoskeleton that is glossy and greenish with their carcasses capable of surviving thousands of years of erosion as seen by the colonists of Alderaan. The exoskeleton also contains a number of spiracles which served as their way of breathing. Typically, these Human-sized hive creatures have four arms with each ending in a powerful three-fingered claw. They stand on two stout legs that are capable of leaping great distances. Killiks can communicate with other Killiks through use of pheromones.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Killiks have a communal society, with each and every Killik being in mental contact with another. Due to their hive mind, every Killik nest is virtually one individual. Killiks are also peaceful in nature. Their telepathic connection is capable of extending to other species which includes non-insectoids. A willing creature can submit to this telepathy to become a Joiner. They effectively become another vessel of the hive mind.

Killiks lose connection to their hive mind at great distances. Those who voluntarily leave the hive mind are referred to as Leavers. It is rare that they are allowed to rejoin their hive without reason.

entries.name: Names
entries: Killiks are a hive-mind insectoid that typically don't use names. On the offchance they do, it's usually an incomprehensible series of clicking noises. They are receptive to nicknames given by others.

entries.name: Killik Traits
entries: As a Killik, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Killiks reach adulthood in their 40s and live an average of 200 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Killiks' willingness to brainwash or kill their enemies cause them to tend towards the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Killiks stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Four-Armed.}} Killiks have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).
{@b {@i Hardened Carapace.}} While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Strong-Legged.}} When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.
{@b {@i Telepathy.}} You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet of you. You must share a language with the target in order to communicate in this way.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write Killik. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Klatooinians are a humanoid species with canine features, having short muzzles over toothy overbites. They are also notable for their heavy brows and ridges along the tops of their heads.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: For centuries, klatooinians have been slaves to the hutts, whom they view as almost godlike, immortal beings. Although the hutts allow a council of elders to rule on Klatooine, all off-world affairs are wholly under hutt control. Under the hutts, the klatooinians serve as soldiers and guards. Even those klatooinians who do not serve the hutts are often employed as hired muscle by other masters.

Klatooinian society was known for a strong belief in tradition and the wisdom of the elders, although some younger klatooinians rebelled against this norm and sought out freedom from enslavement. Others attempted to gain their own fortunes as smugglers, pirates, bounty hunters, or raiders.

entries.name: Names
entries: Klatooinian names are often derived from the names of great heroes and historical figures. Surnames are familial, and are usually shorter than klatooinian given names.
{@b Male Names.} Barada, Castas, Sta-Den, Tarados {@b Female Names.} Gelis, Petkara, Sterasi, Yelmith {@b Surnames.} Eek, Gort, Gon, Ovin

entries.name: Klatooinian Traits
entries: As a klatooinian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength, Constitution, and Wisdom scores increase by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Klatooinians reach adulthood in their late teens and can live as long as 90 standard years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Klatooinian society encourages reverence for tradition and an inclination towards violence, causing them to tend toward lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Klatooinians typically stand around 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Enforcer.}} You are proficient in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill. When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action to give an ally {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} check, they gain a bonus to the roll equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.
{@b {@i Toughness.}} Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.
{@b {@i Weapon Training.}} Klatooinians are trained to fight from a young age. You have proficiency in two martial {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} of your choice.
{@b {@i Wisdom of the Elders.}} You are proficient in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Klatooinian, and {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}. Klatooinian is a gutteral, barking language, with many loanwords adopted from {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese} over the centuries.

rows: Black, dark grey, or dark green

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Kubaz are distinctive for their short, prehensile facial snouts which were used for reaching insects within their hives. They have adapted to their sun-scorched, vegetation-deprived world by learning to survive off their world's native insect population. Filled with two rows of teeth for gnashing their food, the Kubaz trunk also functions as a highly sensitive nose.  Due to living on their homeworld of Kubindi—a planet which orbits a blue star—Kubaz are highly sensitive to red wavelengths; when traveling to planets with a red or yellow star, Kubaz are forced to don protective eyewear to avoid damaging their sensitive eyes.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Kubazi society is based on a clan structure which dwell in underground nests. Ruled by a queen, each clan takes the name of their queen they are descended from. Developing a non-verbal language of hand gestures which indicated their intentions, Kubaz are able to speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, though with a strong nasally accent.  When interacting with other species, some Kubaz will share certain hand signals with non-Kubaz in order to ease communications.  Obsessed with tact and decorum, the Kubaz place a high emphasis on the family unit and proper courtesies, displaying truthfulness to a fault. Valuing art and literature with such vigor as to sometimes practice smuggling of great works, the Kubaz do not find such pursuits to be wrong or unlawful.  Due to their diet on Kubindi, the Kubaz have poor relations with sentient insectile species.

entries.name: Names
entries: Kubaz names are usually dominated by harsher sounds, but some names lean more melodic. Surnames are clan-based.
{@b Male Names.} Shaf, Rizor, Duldril, Kurn, Schnaldiz {@b Female Names.} Zhanro, Dizi, Tavo, Agoz, Nuzrem {@b Surnames.} Re, Eadzan, Hai, Khu'nar, Mairvuc, Va

entries.name: Kubaz Traits
entries: As a Kubaz, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kubaz reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Kubaz' courteous nature causes them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Kubaz typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and weigh around 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Art Obsession.}} Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} related to the acquisition or location of art or valuables, you are considered proficient in the check. If you would already be proficient, you instead have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Deft Hand.}} You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, Sleight of Hand, or {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Keen Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.
{@b {@i Slicer.}} You have proficiency with the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill and the {@item Slicer's kit|sw5e-phb|slicer's kit}.

{@b {@i Sunlight Sensitivity.}} You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kubazian. Kubazian is comprised of a unique series of whirring, nasally syllables, causing Kubaz to have a high-pitched accent when speaking other languages.

rows: Typically white but varies based on mood

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Kushibans are four-limbed lagomorphs native to the planet Kushibah. They are diminutive, unimposing, and typically weaker than most humanoids, but they are also quite difficult to track due to their natural {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and stealth.

While Kushibans are quadrupeds, their forepaws are as manipulative as traditional hands. While kushibans can walk on two legs, they typically run around on four feet since they can move significantly faster that way.

Kushibans are inherently cute and fuzzy, and more nefarious species often attempt to take them as slaves. Kushibans are social and do not take well to slavery, and they typically don't live long in solitude or captivity.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Kushibans live in a simple, peaceful society on the non-industrialized, lush green planet of Kushibah in the Outer Rim. Kushibans are typically kind and generous, with a playful sense of humor and a penchant for practical jokes. However, if betrayed or angered, Kushibans can be cruel or vindictive, and they have little patience for bullies, simpletons, and misanthropes.

entries.name: Names
entries: Kushiban names are a single word combining both their first and familial names.
{@b Male Names.} Cerlyk, Etyk, Mabbik, Tieko, Widdimur {@b Female Names.} Asani, Pritsi, Sibble, Mirax

entries.name: Kushiban Traits
entries: As a Kushiban, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kushibans reach adulthood at 13 and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Kushibans' playful nature causes them to tend toward chaotic light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Kushibans typically stand 3 and a half to 4 feet tall and weigh around 40 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Grovel, Cower, and Beg.}} As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.
{@b {@i Mask of the Wild.}} You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

{@b {@i Nimble Agility.}} Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.
{@b {@i Stealthy.}} You are proficient in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kushiban. Kushiban has a bubbly, joyful tone to it.

rows: Green, ranging from lighter olive shades to deep blue-green colors
Compound or slit-pupiled eyes, dense musculature, suffer from respiratory and vision problems in standard gravity environments

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: A lanky, bipedal humanoid species, the Kyuzo originate on the gravity-heavy Outer Rim world of Phatrong. Kyuzo are tall and slender, though their appearance belies their strength and quickness. Due to the uncommon makeup of their homeworld's atmosphere, Kyuzo frequently wear corrective lenses and a highly pressurized filter mask over their faces to protect their sensitive respiratory systems and assist them in coping with uncomfortable climates like galactic standard habitable environments. As well as causing respiratory and vision problems, exposure to such conditions causes a Kyuzo to become ill within in a short period of time, interfering with their ability to concentrate and slowing them down.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: A species known for its strong sense of justice and honor, most Kyuzo regard oaths and contracts as unbreakable and many species seek them as mercenaries, law-enforcement personnel and bounty hunters. A highly political species, the Kyuzo developed societies that span considerable geographical areas, and most identify as members of a particular country or region. Most major islands and continents on Phatrong are their own political units, though they do form a loose confederacy.

entries.name: Names
entries: Male names typically end in vowels, while female names end in consonants. Surnames are based on region.
{@b Male Names.} Drego, Embo, Khalu, Mhali, Zuvio {@b Female Names.} Catras, Garing, Streehn, Turung {@b Surnames.} Brihney, Ghall, Khambey, Maway, Vori

entries.name: Kyuzo Traits
entries: As a Kyuzo, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Kyuzo reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Kyuzos' belief in justice and honor cause them to tend toward lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Kyuzo typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} Your natural evolution allows you to see what others do not in dim and dark conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Foreign Biology.}} Kyuzo struggle in atmospheres other than those of Phatrong. You wear a filter mask, and if your mask is removed while you are in such an environment, you lose consciousness.
{@b {@i Long-Limbed.}} When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

{@b {@i Strong-Legged.}} When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kyuzo. Kyuzo is characterized by short words and quick phrases. Kyuzo struggle with {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} as it is grammatically dissimilar to Kyuzo.

rows: Blue, brown, green, orange, red, purple, yellow, or gray
Amber, blue, brown, gray, green, hazel, purple, or red

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Lannik are short, bipedal humanoids with droopy, long ears. Males and females are equally tall, although the latter have a considerably less strong complexity. Their species is, however, much more vigorous and resistant than what its size could suggest. A Lannik's skin tends to be of colours similar to his or her eyes and hair. The species has evolved long pointy ears which allow them to hear better than human ears.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Lannik culture is apparently war loving, and Lanniks feel a great respect for warriors. At the same time, though, they follow a strict centuries-old code of honour. Lannik soldiers have the custom of tying all their hair in a single topknot over their head. Their species is one of fierce warriors, whose abilities have developed fighting against terrible predators and other Lanniks in a long history of wars. Although many regard the Lannik as hotheaded and temperamental, they are quite fearless and clear-headed even in combat, giving them the ability to think their way out of a dangerous situation.

The Lannik do not show their thoughts through their facial expressions, and seem always angry to other species. They are also very stubborn, and are not likely to change career once they chose it. Most males - and many females - serve in the planetary militia, celebrating the species' past as a warrior species. Some take on off-world mercenary work.

entries.name: Names
entries: Lannik names are generally short. Lanniks don't often give out their surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Minch, Oteg, Vandar, Yaddle, Yoda {@b Female Names.} Giro, Lina, Penny, Vona, Zeya {@b Surnames.} Bek, Kaz, Mon, Var, Zin

entries.name: Lannik Traits
entries: As a lannik, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Lanniks reach adulthood in their 100's and can live up to 900 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Despite the {@spell Turbulence|sw5e-phb|turbulence} on their homeworld, Lanniks tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Lanniks typically stand 3 to 4 feet tall and rarely weigh more than 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Closed Mind.}} Lanniks have a natural attunement for the Force, which makes them resistant to its powers. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

{@b {@i Force-Sensitive.}} You know the {@i guidance} at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i valor} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i force enlightenment} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. Wisdom is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for these powers.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.
{@b {@i Wisdom of the Elders.}} You are proficient in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Lannik. Due to their large ears, the Lannik language is spoken softly, and it is considered insulting to shout.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: A humanoid sentient species, Lasats are notable for their impressive height, strength, and agility, with their muscular digitigrade legs enabling them to run faster, jump higher and farther, and move more quietly than humans. Their large finger pads and prehensile toes assist them in climbing. In addition, their large eyes and ears afford them superior sight and hearing over humans. They had the strength to open a powered-down blast door. A height of two meters tall was considered below-average for a Lasat.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Lasat society is held together by a long-standing oral tradition, featuring clever and stealthy heroes. Within the species, those with fighting skills are highly respected, often being members of the Lasan High Honor Guard, a group of highly trained, highly intelligent warriors sworn to protect their homeworld of Lira San. Bo-rifles are a long-standing tradition in Lasat culture, used exclusively by the Honor Guard of Lasan. The warrior way of the Lasat is the Boosahn Keeraw. When a Lasat is bested by a superior opponent in combat, they would give them their weapon.

Facial hair is an important status symbol in Lasat culture. Those with green eyes and prominent purple stripes are considered to be attractive by others of their species. Juvenile Lasat are noted to climb tree branches.

entries.name: Names
entries: Lasat names tend to be melodic, with the occasionally harsh tone sprinkled in. Surnames are born by communities within Lasat culture rather than individual families.
{@b Male Names.} Brob, Drim, Krus, Parred, Volares {@b Female Names.} Denazo, Gume, Hado, Zanisa {@b Surnames.} Dragarr, Ellias, Krod, Roleb, Vuzan

entries.name: Lasat Traits
entries: As a lasat, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Lasats reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Lasat' honorable tendences cause them to tend toward lawful light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Lasats tower over other species, averaging 7 feet tall and weighing over 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Bo-rifle Training.}} You have proficiency with {@item Blaster rifle|sw5e-phb|blaster rifles}, bo-rifles, and vibrostaffs.
{@b {@i Climbing.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} Your vision can easily cut through darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing and Sight.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.
{@b {@i Powerful Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Lasat, a language whose {@i r}'s are difficult to replicate by most other species.

rows: Prehensile tail and feet, furred body

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Lurmen's bodies are covered entirely in fur, which range in color from a dark brown to a white-gray, though they do wear garments. They can walk either upright on their two legs, and can also use their arms and legs for faster movement. Many lurmen have the ability to roll themselves into a wheeled shape; this allows them to {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} distances at great {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. They may have learned this ability from the native amani on Maridun.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The lurmen use fallen seedpods from the giant trees as shelter and home. Living near the trees proves too dangerous, as the falling pods can be deadly. Instead, the lurmen drag the pods into a clearing and use them as huts. They also extract essential oils from the pods for nutrition and healing medicines. Most lurmen are pacifistic by nature and refuse to fight or run even in the face of death. They often will hide instead of using violence. As pacifists, they carry no weapons but carry farming tools or ropes. The greatest native threat to the lurmen are the amani and the mastiff phalones, raptor-headed quadrupeds that hunted in groups. However, even in defeating these beasts the lurmen attempt to remain true to their pacifist ideals, and not inflict any injury to the creatures. Instead, when cornered by a mastiff phalone, an agile lurmen will try to unbalance the creature by tying a rope around its stout legs.

entries.name: Names
entries: Lurmen names are sharp and made up of a single syllable. Instead of surnames, lurmen are granted additional names based on their importance to the village. Common lurmen possess one name, with leaders having as many as four.
{@b Male Names.} Fee, Gatt, Nub, Shoo, Yup {@b Female Names.} Kal, Laa, Shal, Vook, Yiit

entries.name: Lurmen Traits
entries: As a lurmen, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Lurmen reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} The pacifistic nature of the lurmen causes them to be neutral light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Lurmen typically stand around 3 feet tall and generally weigh about 45 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Natural Healer.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skills, and the bioanalysis kit.
{@b {@i Prehensile Tail and Feet.}} You have supreme control over your tail and feet and can use them to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

{@b {@i Rolling Agility.}} As a lurmen, you can run on all fours, or curl into a ball, to move quickly along the ground. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

{@b {@i Treeclimber.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Lurmese. Lurmese is a name collectively given to the various tribal languages spoken by the lurmen people. While each language is distinct, shared phrases allow translation between dialects.

rows: Sharp predatory features, fin-like growths, cheek tendrils, tall stature

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The warrior caste of the sith purebloods, the massassi have genetically turned into the perfect warrior. While some looked like their sith pureblood brothers, others have more extreme physical differences, including fin-like growths, a taller form and tough skin. These imposing figures live much shorter lives than other species. They, like the few other creatures that inhabit Korriban, derive sustenance directly from the dark side of the Force, in part of a natural symbiotic relationship where sith—like the massassi—feed on the dark side, and empower it in turn. Thus the massassi have such a high rate of Force-sensitivity that they are considered a naturally Force-sensitive species.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The massassi are fearsome, ruthless, and efficient soldiers. As with the sith, war and violence are just as much a part of the natural order of life as peace or serenity for the massassi. They are not only fearsome, but both loyal and formidable warriors that are dedicated to their sith masters. Though they engage in supposedly primitive practices such as sacrifice and hold a strong caste system, their civilization is quite sophisticated. In addition to the focus on war and fighting, the massassi are also loyal and organized. Even though they are not extremely intelligent, they can be trained to carry out complex battle plans and maintain their equipment, starships, and weaponry.

entries.name: Names
entries: Originating from the pureblood sith, massassi abominations follow many similiar naming conventions. Their names represent primitive virtues in the Sith tongue, and have no surname.
{@b Males Names.} Asha, Derriphan, H—sk, Jen, {@b Female Names.} Kintik, Midwan, Siqsa, Ty—k

entries.name: Massassi Traits
entries: As a massassi, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution increases by 2, and your Strength increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Massassi live relatively short lives. They reach adulthood after 14 years, and reach old age around 40 years of life.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} The massassi are savage and brutish warriors who relish on the violence of combat, usually following a dark and chaotic nature.
{@b {@i Size.}} Massassi are between 7 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 200 and 300 pounds. Your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Type.}} Your creature type is both aberration and humanoid.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} Your vision can easily cut through darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can—t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Force Symbiosis.}} When you reach 3rd level, you can cast your choice of the {@i curse}, {@i dun moch}, or {@i hex} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Charisma.
{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Oversized.}} Lightweapons and {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} that lack the dexterity or light property are considered to have the heavy property for you. The strength number for {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} is reduced by one step (from 19 to 17, 17 to 15, 15 to 13, or 13 to 11). If the strength number is 11, you ignore it entirely.
{@b {@i Powerful Build.}} Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Sith. Sith is an agglutinative language, in which words or even phrases were made up of linear sequences of distinct meaningful units.

rows: Green, pink, red, blue, or yellow
Numerous head-tendrils, acute senses of sight and hearing

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Mikkians are a species of brightly colored humanoids. The mikkians' most distinctive feature are their motile head-tendrils, with the number, form, and pattern varying between individuals. These head-tendrils primarily serve as sensory organs, particularly detecting sound as a replacement for an ear common in other species. Mikkian head-tendrils also could detect other information, such as humidity, temperature, magnetic direction and radiation. This radiation detection can be detected to the extent that mikkians can "see" light and dark, although their eyes are still their primary visual organs.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Mikkians place kinship and integrity above all. In fact, their honesty can come across as blunt or even rude to other sentients. Conversely, mikkians often have trouble adjusting to the more flexible views of other races. Their complex code of honor encompass all things in life, with a particular insistance on matters of warfare. Although they respect warrior traditions, the Mikkians nevertheless value discipline and honor over victory or physical might.

Different religious traditions exist among the Mikkians, but belief in the Force plays a central role in all of them. In Mikkian society, their head-tendrils have important cultural significance, and as such tendril-reading is used by Mikkian mystics to predict their future. Every facet of the head-tendril contributes to that meaning.

entries.name: Names
entries: Mikkian names are often short and disyllabic, with a melodic quality to them. Mikkians typically don't use surnames, though some may adopt them.
{@b Male Names.} Cage, Fedlas, Mekko, Sakas {@b Female Names.} Beyra, Fenvar, Tiplee, Zelna

entries.name: Mikkian Traits
entries: As a mikkian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Mikkian reach adulthood in their late teens and live a little over a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Mikkian's honor and integrity based culture causes them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Mikkian typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Blindsight.}} Mikkian can perceive the world around them through heat and radiation. You have {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} out to 30 feet. If another trait would grant you {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight}, the range is increased by half as many feet.

{@b {@i Keen Hearing.}} Your head-tendrils provide a keen awareness of your surroundings. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing.
{@b {@i Bureaucratic.}} You have proficiency with {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} (your choice).
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mikkian. Mikkian is a melodic, flowing tongue made up of several ancient dialects.

rows: Lack of physical eyes, inherent {@i force sight}

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Miraluka are a near-human species that differs from Humans in that they lack eyes, only retaining vestigial eye sockets, and perceive the environment around them through {@i force sight} instead of regular vision. This vision is so strong that if a Miraluka looks upon a Jedi or Sith, they can "see" Force radiating off them. The strength of a Miraluka's connection to the Force varies by individual.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Miraluka are a thoughtful, cautious, and deliberative species. They have little interest in personal gain or glory. For social reasons, Miraluka hide their appearance by wearing a headband, a mask, or similar concealing headwear. In addition all Miraluka are very united by species. They call themselves "brothers" and are considered as members of a great family. As a Force-using species, Miraluka are often quite {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} if 'shown' life not connected to the Force.
Many Miraluka worship two gods, Ashla and Bogan, through the philosophy of the Greater Force. They do not believe in good or evil, but were taught to accept both life and death.

Miraluka Force-sensitives are an order of their own called the Luka Sene. Academic in atmosphere and culture, the Luka Sene focus primarily on developing the sense-related powers of their members. However, unlike the Jedi, Sith and other traditions, the Luka Sene does not dictate a member's personal life.

entries.name: Names
entries: Miraluka names are generally two syllables. Miraluka don't use surnames, as they believe they are one family.
{@b Male Names.} Aakih, Pafil, Rikhor, Vociif, Xuwuth {@b Female Names.} Auchaod, Favom, Mucem, Wilierth

entries.name: Miraluka Traits
entries: As a miraluka, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Miraluka reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Miraluka believe in balance and thus tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Miraluka typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Force-Sensitive.}} You know the {@i mind trick} at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i sanctuary} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i force confusion} power once per day. Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for these powers.

{@b {@i Force Sight.}} Miraluka perceive the environment around them through use of the Force. You are constantly under the effects of the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} {@i force sight}, though the power does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} for you.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Miralukese.

rows: Blue, green, violet, grey, red, yellow, or orange

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Mirialans are a near-human species native to the planet Mirial. They have green to yellow skin and tattoos on their faces. The Mirialans are known for their spirituality and strong connection with the world around them. Mirialans are very flexible and agile, making them fast and formidable foes.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Mirialan people are deeply religious and practice a primitive understanding of the Force. They believe each individual's actions contribute to their destiny, building upon past successes and failures to drive them towards their fates. Within their belief system was the view that individual actions ripple through the Force, also affecting the destiny of the species as a whole.

A Mirialan often places a unique, geometrically repeated tattoo on their face and hands to signify that they have completed a certain test or task, or achieved sufficient aptitude for a certain skill. The number of tattoos often acts as a good indicator of how mature and/or skilled a Mirialan was. Because the more markings brings about a form of status, Mirialan society is stratified and allows the heavily marked citizens to access greater opportunities. Despite its importance, most Mirialans do not know the entirety of the tattoo lexicon due to its complexity. The interaction between placement and positioning of the shapes is incredibly subtle and changes their meaning greatly.

entries.name: Names
entries: Mirialan names are typically concise and rarely more than two syllables. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Boca, Floha, Jemy, Puv, Choqa {@b Female Names.} Buf, Ches, Kebe, Ovof, Shaqa {@b Surnames.} Acave, Ishakee, Kefvi, Uflozi, Zoria

entries.name: Mirialan Traits
entries: As a mirialan, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Mirialan reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Mirialans spiritual tendencies cause them to tend towards the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Mirialan typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and weight 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.

{@b {@i Spiritual.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) checks made to learn or recall something about a culture's religion.
{@b {@i Surprise Attack.}} If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.
{@b {@i Unarmed Combatant.}} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mirialan.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Mustafarians are an insectoid species of sentients native to the volcanic planet of Mustafar. They are divided into two subspecies: the lanky northern mustafarians, and the stocky southern mustafarians. The southern mustafarians were notable for their greater strength, making them more suited to manual labor. Both subspecies shared many traits, particularly their hardened exoskeletons and leathery skin, which acclimated them to the extreme heat of their volcanic environment.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Mustafarians evolved from arthropods living in the slightly cooler hollows within dormant volcanoes on the surface of Mustafar. As a result of such close living, mustafarian culture is isolationist by nature, though they tolerate trade with other systems. Mustafar hosts scarce minerals and rare metals, making mustafarians an invaluable trade partner.
Native mustafarians rarely take sides when galactic conflicts rage, instead preferring to keep to themselves and control their own planet. They are daunting enemies when provoked, however.

entries.name: Names
entries: Mustafarian names are often inspired by displays of competency or bravery, such as recovering large quantities of rare minerals, or successfully taming a lava flea. Their surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Aumstrogh, Chivos, Ikt, Ulon {@b Female Names.} Altoa, Hailith, Saonji, Yura {@b Surnames.} Fal'co, Glost, Mensix, Nek'dem

entries.name: Mustafarian Traits
entries: As a mustafarian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Mustafarians reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Mustafarians are usually judicious and value good work above all else, causing them to be lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Mustafarians stand between 5 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 165 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet. You ignore the strength property of {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} As an originally cave-dwelling species, your eyes are adapted to the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Lava Dweller.}} Your body is well accustomed to extreme heat, giving you resistance to fire damage. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to hot climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

{@b {@i Refinery Specialist.}} You have proficiency in your choice of constructor's implements, scavenging kit, or surveyor's implements. Additionally, whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}) check to identify a metal or mineral, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mustafarian. Mustafarian consists of choppy clicks and emphatic groans.

rows: Three hearts, long limbs, elongated heads

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Muuns are tall, gaunt humanoids with thin bodies, long limbs, and elongated hairless heads. They typically have pale pink or white skin, most likely derived from their propensity for staying indoors. Muuns have tiny ears on the middle of the sides of their heads, flat noses, and slim mouths which leads to a commonly nasally voice.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Muuns believe in tradition, with an established culture based on intelligence and merit. A class-based hierarchy, Muuns consider the  the intellectual pursuits — financiers, lawyers, engineers, diplomats, scientists — as the highest levels of society. Muun culture, and life, revolves around economics and finance. Intense competition among coworkers encourages economic growth, increased productivity, and superior work ethic. Muuns also have a fundamental respect for justice, though they typically adhere to the letter of the law rather than the spirit.

Since Muuns tend to shy away from fighting and physical pursuits, Muun society relies on alternative means for their planet's protection, using vast financial resources to purchase massive floating defense platforms to defend their civilization from attack.

entries.name: Names
entries: Muun names are typically clear and concise, rarely containing more than two syllables, with familial surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Clu, Hego, Nix, Pors, San {@b Female Names.} Dax, Efra, Gil, Rel, Ter {@b Surnames.} Card, Damask, Hill, Lesser, Tonith

entries.name: Muun Traits
entries: As a muun, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Muuns reach adulthood in their late teens and live an average of a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Muuns' lawful culture nature causes them to tend toward lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Muuns typically stand 6 and a half to 7 feet tall and weigh around 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Finance Savvy.}} Muun share a keen business sense and an ability to find value where others don't. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check involving finances you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Long-Limbed.}} When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

{@b {@i Three Hearts.}} When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Muun. The Muuns' admiration of mathematics carries over into their language, which bares a striking resemblance to {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary}.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Neimoidians are distant genetic relatives of the duros and retain many similarities to them, including basic form, noseless faces, and green-blue skin (though neimoidians tend to be grayer). Their eyes also have pupils that split horizontally, and they are distinguished by small lumps on their foreheads and down-turned mouths. Instead of noses, they have olfactory glands underneath their eyes. These genetic differences are attributed to the distinct features of their homeworld, Neimoidia, including its gravity, which is markedly heavier than duro.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Neimoidians spend their formative years as puny grubs in the communal hives of Neimoidia, until the age of seven standard years. They are knowingly neglected by being given limited amounts of food. This way, the weaker individuals are weeded out, while the most acquisitive grubs hoard more food than they can eat by themselves. Neimoidian education ensures the survival of the greediest. Neimoidians place tremendous value on wealth and material possessions, and would go to great lengths to gain money and power. This has resulted in a stereotype of neimoidians being greedy and cowardly. While not all neimoidians are easily intimidated, many prefer to avoid direct combat.

entries.name: Names
entries: Neimoidian names are usually short and easy to pronounce, to make them more memorable to other species that approach them as consumers. Their surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Lok, Gap, Krinit, Mar, Nute {@b Female Names.} Bu, Fia, Feza, Vissi {@b Surnames.} Dod, How, Kethe, Preelli, Tuuk

entries.name: Neimoidian Traits
entries: As a neimoidian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Neimoidians reach adulthood in their 20s and live about 150 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Neimoidians' greedy nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Neimoidians typically stand around 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 135 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Grovel, Cower, and Beg.}} As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Smooth Talker.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Wealthy.}} During character creation, you start with additional credits equal to your level x your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} x 1,000 cr.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Pak Pak. Pak Pak is often considered an elegant-sounding language by those who hear it. It consists of husky sighs and guttural ululations.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Nikto are reptilian humanoids that are noted for their leathery skin. They hold a limited range of facial expressions because they lack the necessary anatomical infrastructure. Their eyes are covered by a protective membrane, being a thin transparent pellicle that protects their eyes underwater and during windstorms. As a result, they are noted for their "staring" eyes and a seemingly blank expression which leads to many underestimating nikto intelligence.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Although lacking in personal charisma, nikto posses a single-minded {@optfeature Tenacity|sw5e-phb|tenacity} that makes them excellent followers. Their lives made nikto cunning combatants. Most nikto are content with a life of servitude as in their eyes a life in slavery was preferable to the hardship and toil on their homeworld. Not all nikto work for the hutts though most free members of their kind were formerly enslaved. Whilst nikto are known to escape from their master, most tend to fall into service of another hutt who "inherited" them according to custom should their previous employer die. However, some escaped nikto did instead use some opportunities to genuinely become free beings. Any such emancipated nikto have to be constantly on guard as they risked capture by hutt-employed slavers who return their prey to their "rightful owners". In addition, they lacked charisma and preferred to follow orders instead of giving them. As a result, the Nikto were most identified with their Hutt masters.

entries.name: Names
entries: Nikto names are very complex, hard to pronounce, and harsh sounding. Name length also differs a lot, longer names having apostrophes or dashes. Their names are unisex, with surnames being familiar and optional.
{@b First Names.} Jydabaum, N'rok'ratu, Sussa, Vydgish {@b Surnames.} Gozorc, Irtitt, Qegmarg, Umpluurg

entries.name: Nikto Traits
entries: As a nikto, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Nikto reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Nikto's self-sufficient and clever nature causes them to tend toward balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Nikto typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.
{@b {@i Protective Membrane.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}.
{@b {@i Radiation Resistant.}} The dying star nearby their homeworld makes nikto naturally used to radiation. You have resistance to necrotic damage.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Nikto, and {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}. Nikto is spoken with sharp syllables with a deep and rumbling cadence.
