{@b {@i Adaptation.}} The frequent radiation bursts from the nearby dying star caused the nikto to mutate and adapt into different subspecies over time, specialized for different environments. Choose one of the following adaptations:

items: {@b Esral'sa'Nikto (Mountain)} {@b {@i Acute Hearing.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to hearing, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill. {@b {@i Cold Adaptation.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold.
{@b Gluss'sa'Nikto (Pale)} {@b {@i Hold Breath.}} You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time. {@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

{@b Kadas'sa'Nikto (Green)} {@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage. {@b {@i Forest Dweller.}} You don't treat forest terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}. {@b {@i Treeclimber.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

{@b Kajain'sa'Nikto (Red)} {@b {@i Heat Adaptation.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme heat. {@b {@i Survivor.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b M'shento'su'Nikto (Southern)} {@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

rows: Advanced olfactory senses, claws, hunting prowess.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Noghri are a primitive humanoid species hailed from the planet Honoghr with steely gray-blue skin that are renowned assassins. A natural gift for stealth and hand-to-hand combat, Noghri are efficient killing machines with their rending claws and strong olfactory sense that can often determine familial lineage. Their smaller size belies their ruthlessness and potent hunting skills.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Noghri culture relies heavily on honor, with society being clan-based, revolving around the Dukha, a community center in each village. The greatest strength of the Noghri stems from their loyalty and secrecy; when a Noghri takes a job, they always fulfill it, even if it would result in their death. As such, they make exceptional, albeit expensive bodyguards.

Noghri are loathe to fight with weapons larger than small daggers, believing combat to be a personal celebration to be sullied by use of heavier weapons. As such, it is rare (though not impossible) to see a Noghri wielding a weapon larger than their forearm.

Each Noghri clan village centers around the Dukha, with each clan being led by a Dynast. The Dukha is inhabited by the clan's Maitrakh, who functions as the storyteller, spiritual leader, and lore keep of the clan.

entries.name: Names
entries: Noghri names vary from short to long, with female names being typically softer. Surnames are clan-based.
{@b Male Names.} Cakhmaim, Ezrakh, Khabarakh, Rukh {@b Female Names.} Cilnaas, Edvir, Kahr'corvh, Meewalh {@b Surnames.} Bakh'tor, Eikh'mir, Hakh'khar, Khim'bar

entries.name: Noghri Traits
entries: As a noghri, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Noghri reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Noghri's honorable society causes them to tend toward a lawful alignment, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Noghri typically stand about 5 feet tall and weigh around 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Hunter.}} You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Keen Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

{@b {@i Powerful Leap.}} If you jump at least 10 feet in a straight line before hitting with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can attempt to trip the target prone as part of the same attack. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Strong-Legged.}} When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.
{@b {@i Unarmed Combatant.}} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Honorghran. Honorghran is characterized by its scratchy, gutteral sounds.

rows: Near-human, flaky golden skin, skilled pilots

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Near-humans possessing golden, flaky skin, nothoiins feature fair to brown hair with brown eyes and typically have physical heights and builds common to humans.  Nothoiins' appearance has earned their species the nickname of "Goldskins."

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Although nothoiins hail from their eponymous homeworld and star system in the Anoat Sector, they are ubiquitous throughout the Greater Javin Region and Corporate Sectors.  Their history of interstellar exploration and colonization was facilitated by their species' natural spacefaring abilities in both piloting and navigation and necessitated by their home planet's periodically harsh, dry climate.  Droughts on Nothoiin can last for decades, and the wildfires they foster have served as one of the primary factors behind the limited development of the planet's economy beyond the ur-diamond mining industry, which produces the system's chief export.

Large-scale emigration from Nothoiin has led members of its native species to seek careers as pilots, navigators, and operatives in numerous criminal enterprises.  Various nothoiin colonies have given rise to a number of different governmental systems running the gamut from representative democracies to autocracies.

entries.name: Names
entries: Nothoiin typically receive a gendered given name and a familial surname.
{@b Male Names.} Amrosio, Jado, Kosimas, Troov {@b Female Names.} Elayah, Giranti, Lorinah, Sil {@b Surnames.} Caban, Mordu, Plintus, Starstrider

entries.name: Nothoiin Traits
entries: As a nothoiin, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}}  Nothoiin reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Nothoiins tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Nothoiins typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Born Pilots.}} Nothoiins demonstrate seemingly innate piloting abilities from a very young age.  You have proficiency in the {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Expert Navigators.}} You are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) checks made to navigate.
{@b {@i Galactic Traveler.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Heightened Reflexes.}} Whenever you make a Dexterity {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can choose to add 1d4 to the result. You can use this before or after the roll, but before the GM determines the roll's outcome. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

{@b {@i Major Miners.}} Nothoiins have intimate knowledge of ur-diamond mining and refinement practices.  You gain proficiency in your choice of jeweler's implements, scavenging kit, or archaeologist kit.

{@b {@i Starship Specialists.}} Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check related to starships, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice. You can also communicate via Notho, a native hand language developed by hunters living in the Nothoiin plains.  Usage of Notho is exceedingly rare outside Nothoiin culture.

rows: Stocky builds, trunklike noses, floppy ears, small mouths, brightly dyed fur

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Ortolans are squat, heavily-built humanoid bipeds with long, trunklike noses and beady black eyes. They possess floppy ears, which are extremely sensitive to sound waves. They have two hands, each ending in four chubby fingers and a thumb, which is not opposable. A thick, baggy hide covered in fuzz resembling velvet hangs off of the Ortolan body. Ortolans have a keen sense of smell to help them forage for food. In fact, they are handicapped in their business affairs by their attachment to food, sometimes accepting otherwise unfavorable contracts when promised enough to eat. Their twin obsessions are food and music; offworld, many Ortolans find success as chefs or musicians.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Ortolan society is reasonably industrialised, though not as technologically advanced as other species. Despite this, their economy is mostly based on barter, with credits primarily used to trade with offworlders. Education is the responsibility of their parents, though gifted youngsters are often traded to other families to get specialized education.

While most Ortolans appear to have blue skin, Ortolans are actually covered in short velvety fur which they often dyed in bright colors, most often blue and pink.  This tradition began when a Devaronian trader tried to sell Ortolans a shipment of food dyes—they considered dyeing their food a waste of time, but found dyed fur to be quite stylish.

entries.name: Names
entries: Ortolan names are generally short with big sounds. Female names are typically softer. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male names.} Donmb, Hegh, Nax, Parm, Teeb {@b Female names.} Bedla, Folfe, Nelni, Phoff, Sallo {@b Surnames.} Bigek, Lubum, Nad, Rojool, Somo

entries.name: Ortolan Traits
entries: As an ortolan, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Ortolans are considered adults at the age of seven and typically live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Ortolans' love of food and music causes them to tend toward chaotic light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Ortolans stand around 3 to 4 feet tall and weigh about 55 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Foragers.}} Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check to forage for food you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Grovel, Cower, and Beg.}} As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Hide.}} Your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing and Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.
{@b {@i Musical.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} and one musical instrument of your choice.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ortolan. Ortolan is characterized by its grunts and hoots.

rows: Long snout, bulbous body on thin legs

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The pa'lowick are a species of humanoid amphibians who live in the coastal salt marshes of Lowick. They have compact but rotund midsections that top a pair of long, spindly legs ending in anisodactylic feet—three toes pointing forward, one back. This configuration, combined with their powerful lungs, enabled them to swim.
The most prominent feature of pa'lowick physiology is their prehensile snout, which ends in a pair of pouty, human-like lips. Pa'lowick are also born with sharp tusks, which some lose by middle age.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Pa'lowick live in large, independent communities with a feudal system of government. Many pa'lowick become fishers or hunters, as their biology allows.

Songs and stories are the most treasured aspect of pa'lowick culture. Pa'lowick music runs the gamut of genres and subjects, although religious music is particularly common. Cultural heritage, such as history, genealogy, and parables, is largely passed down orally. Every Pa'lowick community has a dedicated storyteller; the esteem afforded this individual makes the position a coveted one. Large lungs make the Pa'lowick hearty singers and affords at least some members of the species the ability to scream loudly and disarm opponents in combat.

entries.name: Names
entries: Pa'lowick names tend to grow longer as the family tree grows older, with each generation adding a few syllables they are fond of.
{@b Male Names.} Loran, Jelanto, Neeamesh, Samoos {@b Female Names.} Larisselle, Rensilla, Sy, Tripika {@b Surnames.} Chatrunis, Dym, Geeci, Snootles

entries.name: Pa'lowick Traits
entries: As a pa'lowick, you have the following special traits: {@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Pa'lowick reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 75 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Pa'lowick enjoy a raucous good time, causing them to tend toward chaotic light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Pa'lowick stand about 5 feet tall, and weigh approximately 100 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Hold Breath.}} Pa'lowick have a great lung capacity and can hold their breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

{@b {@i Proud Performer.}} Pa'lowick are best known for the energy they can bring to a singing performance. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}) check involving singing, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Snout.}} You have supreme control over your snout and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands. Additionally, your snout is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Sonic Scream.}} As an action, you can violently expel air in a 15-foot cone. When you do so, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). A creature takes 2d6 sonic damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 4d6 at 5th level, 6d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 17th level. This ability has no effect on constructs. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Lowickese. Lowickese requires the user to purse their lips and blow air, and is considered amusing by other species.

rows: Blue skin, yellow eyes, cold resilience

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Pantorans are a sentient species native to Pantora, a moon orbiting the planet Orto Plutonia. At first glance, they only differ from the otherwise similar humans in their blue skin and yellow eyes. The pantorans share many traits with other blue-skinned races, especially the wroonians, and, to a lesser extent, the chiss. The pantorans also seem to have a greater resilience to low temperatures than humans, since they only needed light wardrobe even under extreme cold weather conditions.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Pantoran society developed on Pantora, a world located in a region flush with slavers and spice merchants. Constant run-ins with these types led the pantorans to become fiercely independent and proud. While the pantoran society is democratic, the feudal traditions of marking their foreheads, and cheeks with yellow markings to symbolize lineage persists into the common era. These traditions spurred a cultural interest in genealogy and history, and many pantorans cherish relics from the past such as jewelry which connect them to their noble ancestors or helmets that belonged to great heroes of a bygone age. The old nation states of Pantora are unified under a democratic planetary government, the politics of which are considered an art form. Governed by the Pantoran Assembly, the elected body is led by a Speaker, who balance the power of the chief executive officer, known as the Chairman.

entries.name: Names
entries: Pantoran use sophisticated names with numerous vowels, though often sound similar human names.
{@b Male Names.} Charl, Ikurrece, Maatsu, Pulengo {@b Female Names.} Freyu, Jicelli, Nandia, Suya {@b Surnames.} Ipujarero, Molidias, Tuteru, Vagana

entries.name: Pantoran Traits
entries: As a pantoran, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence or Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Pantorans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Pantorans' interest in politics causes them to tend towards lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Pantorans typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Cold Adaptation.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold.
{@b {@i Cultured.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Impose Order.}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can command each ally within 15 feet of you to move up to half that ally's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Once you use this trait, you can—t use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Negotiators.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) checks meant to negotiate terms or agreements between parties.

{@b {@i Organized.}} Your society values organization, and as such you are good at making good use of the space provided. When you are in charge of packing a space, such as a vehicle or cargo hold, that space's carrying capacity is increased by one-fourth its base capacity.
{@b {@i Political Guile.}} You are proficient in {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Pantoran. Pantoran comprises many dialects that prevent clear communication, a vestige of the feudal culture of the planet's past. Because of the difficulties of operating a planetary government with so many different languages, the Assembly established {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} as the official language of their people as a means of unifying the planet.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Patrolians are fish-like in appearance, covered in pale, pastel-colored scales and possessing numerous fins on their long limbs and face, as well as a notable dorsal fin which often require modified clothing to accommodate.

Thanks to their gills, patrolians are perfectly comfortable breathing underwater as well as on land, and their physiology is also notoriously resistant to electric shocks—both likely throwbacks to evolution on their native homeworld of Patrolia.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Patrolians are a notably innovative and resourceful species, and many of their number have found their way into roles in the construction, maintenance and sale of technology.

Unfortunately, patrolians tend to pursue these businesses in a shady manner, and most tend to operate such ventures in the criminal underworld, working as bounty hunters, thieves, fences, slicers and other such technically-demanding criminal roles.

This inclination towards crime stems from their homeworld, which is perpetually stalled in a state of economic decay due to wartime. With the advent of multiple wars fought in the system, different armies continue to see the aquatic world as a strategic bulwark in the region. Because of this, patrolians have to find work not only off-world, but typically in fields not falling under governmental purview; unfortunately, criminal activities are the most common path.

entries.name: Names
entries: Patrolian names are usually multisyllabic and sing-songy with lots of open vowels and few fricatives. Patrolians are not known to use family names or other surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Dalladu, Feddi, Nogagai, Teconica {@b Female Names.} Kakeda, Machibido, Rinimma, Talla

entries.name: Patrolian Traits
entries: As a patrolian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity or Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Patrolians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Patrolians' greedy, scheming nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Patrolians typically stand just over 3 feet tall and generally weigh about 40 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.
{@b {@i Conniving.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Electrical Resistance.}} Patrolians are notably capable of shrugging off electricity. You have resistance to lightning damage.
{@b {@i Specialist.}} You have proficiency in one {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb|specialist}'s kit of your choice.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet.
{@b {@i Technician.}} You are proficient in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Patrolian. Patrolian is a high-energy language, consisting mostly of gurgles and skittish vocalizations. Patrolian, even when spoken on land, sounds like it's being spoken underwater.

rows: Red eye sockets, pinstriped skin, long lifespan, jagged teeth

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Pau'ans have large, sunken black eyes in red eye sockets and jagged, fang-like teeth used for tearing into raw meat, as they are carnivores. The species has pale, wrinkled skin, due to the fact that they lived in the sinkholes of Utapau, giving them limited access to light. These traits cause some to view them as frightening. However, Pau'ans as a society are generally friendly, and are happy to welcome guests to their often overlooked world. Pau'ans have long lifespans, living up to 700 years, much longer than the Utai. This earned them the nickname of "Ancients".

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Pau'ans fulfill most of the governmental and administrative duties on Utapau, as the utai do not desire such work, serving as laborers instead. Most pau'ans served as leaders early in their lives, often managing teams of Utai laborers. This gives them experience that will be used later in their lives. Pau'ans are kind leaders, and sympathetic to their subordinates. Each city on Utapau is controlled by a Master of Port Administration, a hereditary title reserved for pau'ans. These administrators are assisted by advisory councils for making important decisions about their city, and each administrator serves on the Utapauan Committee and oversees planetary governance. However, the committee rarely makes crucial decisions, as the cities are able to function on their own most of the time.

entries.name: Names
entries: Pau'an names are fairly simple, and generally melodic. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Kernul, Sivrol, Tar, Vizun, Yal, Zeolbud {@b Female Names.} Cas, Jevoh, Nesim, Sizil, Ten, Yofan {@b Surnames.} Gesat, Kluneln, Nom, Vley, Voy, Zet

entries.name: Pau'an Traits
entries: As a pau'an, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Pau'ans reach adulthood in their 30's and have been known to live up to 700 years old.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Pau'ans' commanding presence, yet friendly and kind nature, cause them to tend to be lawful light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Pau'ans typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Authoritative.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} (your choice).
{@b {@i Cultured.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Hypersensitive Hearing.}} Pau'ans possess incredibly receptive hearing, often to their detriment, so you wear special covers on your ears. Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check involving hearing, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill, but if your hearing aids are removed, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal sonic damage.

{@b {@i Vigilant.}} You can choose to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your next {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb} check. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Utapese. Utapese is characterized by its rigid, yet melodic sound.

rows: Elongated, tapered skull with an undersized face

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: A sentient species, the pykes are humanoid, although slimmer and taller than most humans. They have two long, lanky legs, and two arms that end in three-fingered hands. Their heads are large and elongated, with a tapered skull and an undersized face, a feature which some other species find unsettling. Pykes had two narrow, almond-shaped eyes which could be magenta or blue in color.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Pykes hail from Oba Diah, a terrestrial planet marked by obsidian cliffs. Visitors to Oba Diah view both the population and terrain as unwelcoming. The pyke homeworld serves as the headquarters of the Pyke Syndicate, a criminal dealership within the Spice Cartel that operates in the criminal underworld distributing spice, an illicit substance harvested by slaves in the spice mines of the planet Kessel. To deliver spice to their customers, such as crime families on Coruscant, the Pyke Syndicate relies on smugglers and freighter captains to complete the dangerous Kessel Run. The Pyke Syndicate almost completely controls the production of raw spice in the galaxy, while maintaining tentative alliances with other criminal organizations throughout the galaxy, such as the Black Sun and the Crimson Dawn.

entries.name: Names
entries: Pyke names are often influenced by naming conventions of other species, with their rarely-used surnames being familial.
{@b Male Names.} Dor, Eife, Qalo, Thok, Zret {@b Female Names.} Gali, Taela, Shethni, Vent, Zeeren {@b Surnames.} Kemtol, Nek, Pyke, Safet, Welkor

entries.name: Pyke Traits
entries: As a pyke, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Pykes reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Due to their underhanded nature, Pykes tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Pykes typically stand 6 to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 155 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Long-Limbed.}} When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.
{@b {@i Mercantile.}} You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Notorious Slavers.}} Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} related to the buying, selling, or controlling of slaves, you are considered proficient in the check. If you would already be proficient, you instead have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}.
{@b {@i Spicer.}} You are proficient in spicer's kit.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Pyke. The Pyke language is characterized by its multisyllable grunts.

rows: Four tentacles that protrude from their jaws, finned or suction-cup tipped fingers, able to spit out clouds of ink in defense

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Quarren are squid-like with four facial tentacles which protrude from their lower jaw. They have a pair of deep, turquoise eyes and finned hands with suction-tipped fingers. As an amphibious species, they are strong swimmers. They are also bipedal beings that can walk and sit upright. In the two long protrusions that extended from either side of their faces, Quarren have gill-like structures that are actually hearing organs. The Quarren are also capable of spitting out clouds of ink as a defensive measure.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Quarren are a very self-centered and proud species, almost to the point of being xenophobic, would coincides with their isolationist behavior. Quarren find Humans to be very crude beings and think {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} to be very cumbersome and unsuitable for speech. The Quarren instead speak their native language more frequently.

The Quarren are conservative and practical in their thinking, yet they reminisce more than they look to the future. The Quarren are isolationist, preferring to stay in the depths of the oceans of their homeworld. However, some Quarren make their living in the galaxy as business managers and accountants. The Quarren diligently mine metal ore from the deepest parts of the ocean, where they live deep beneath the waves. Their cities stretch far below the surface.

entries.name: Names
entries: Quarren names are typically harsh. Male and female names do not significantly deviate. Surnames are familial.
{@b Names.} Bagker, Jujon, Kibkyl, Qiockish, Yuntoz {@b Surnames.} Chobnek, Geeckol, Nukranx, Tsastanx

entries.name: Quarren Traits
entries: As a quarren, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Quarren reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Quarren desire for equal rights causes them to tend toward balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Quarren typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.
{@b {@i Climb.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.
{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Ink Cloud.}} As an action, you can expel ink in a 10-foot cone. When you do so, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, a creature is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} until the end of its next turn. This ability has no effect on constructs. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Quarrenese. The Quarrenese language is characterized by its garbled nature that evokes an image of speaking underwater.

rows: Long necks, two brains, two pairs of arms

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Created by arkanian scientists from the DNA of the xexto species, the quermians were designed to be taller than their fore-bearers and were left to evolve without any predators on their terraformed garden homeworld. Equipped with long necks for peering over vegetation mats, bulbous heads with a permanently bemused smile, and two sets of spindly arms, they also have two brains, one located in the chest cavity. Their two brains can cause mental problems when each brain developed a different personality, but also gives them a type of "telepathy" which they attribute to an ability to better observe and understand body language. Possessing no noses, the olfactory glands of this species are found in the hands.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Quermians are a gentle, unassuming people. They embrace reason, shun violence, and enjoy interacting with members of other species and cultures. A peaceful society developed on Quermia without arkanian interference, as the quermians evolved on their own in the absence of any predators or outside intervention. As a race they are dedicated to complex philosophical ideas, and many of the galaxy's most prominent diplomats and thinkers are found among their ranks. While they have four arms and are capable of using both sets with ease, they prefer to keep the lower set hidden beneath their robes when dealing with offworlders.

entries.name: Names
entries: Quermian names are usually one to three syllables long, featuring hard or soft consonants.
{@b Male Names.} Murk, Koa, Jedoo, Vinian {@b Female Names.} Gouren, Kindee, Meroo, Kiaa {@b Surnames.} Kreen, Lundi, Raelo, Bactra

entries.name: Quermian Traits
entries: As a quermian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Quermians reach adulthood in their early teens and live a little under a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Querians philosophic culture causes them to tend toward light alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Quermians typically stand 7 to 8 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Diplomatic.}} You have proficiency with {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

{@b {@i Four-Armed.}} Quermians have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

{@b {@i Natural Empathy.}} Quermians' talent at reading the body language of others allow them to sense the emotions in those around them. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

{@b {@i Two Brains.}} When you make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Once you've done so, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can do so again.
{@b {@i Watchful.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Quermian. You can also communicate with other quermians more effectively through a thorough understanding of body language that xenobiologists widely attribute to latent telepathy.

rows: Horizontal eye stalks, vertical blade shaped head, tridactyl hands

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: In appearance, rakata are smooth skinned amphibian-like humanoids that had tall craniums along with eyes that protruded from each side of their heads on short stalks. These bipedal beings have three digit hands that are tipped with claws for digging through packed dirt. As a species, they are uniformly lean and tall; while most rakata have a similar height and weight, females tend to be more slender than males, though just as tall. Rakata are primarily carnivorous, likely stemming from the fact that they are cannibalistic, often making a meal of other species.
Long term abuse of the Force in their society, exacerbated by a plague, culled the rakata's ability to sense the Force.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Rakatan technology and structures hold the unique property of blending with the Force, creating powerful and long-lasting monuments that are almost impossibly to replicate. Rakatan society is devoted to conquering and enslaving those they deem weak. At the height of its power, the Rakatan Infinite Empire had conquered and enslaved dozens of worlds. They would strip entire planets of their resources and then terraform them to fit their own needs.

After a plague ravaged their civilization and caused the fall of the Infinite Empire, rakata broke off into smaller tribes rather than a unified organization. Despite their newfound tribal nature, rakata retained their ability to quickly adapt to and appropriate technology.

entries.name: Names
entries: Rakatan names do not distinguish by gender, and they do not use surnames.
{@b Names.} Ceh'let, Orsaa, Skal'nas, Soa, Tul'kar

entries.name: Rakata Traits
entries: As a rakata, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Rakata reach adulthoood by 20 and rarely live longer than 90 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Rakata's propensity towards war and aggression cause them to tend toward lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Rakata typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 180 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Adaptive Resilience.}} Prolongued use of technology allows rakata to readily adapt to its effects. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.

{@b {@i Cannibalize.}} If you spend at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Force-Insensitive.}} While rakata can be manipulated by many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, they can not sense the Force. You can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.
{@b {@i Technician.}} You are proficient in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rakata. Rakata is characterized by its deep tones and simplistic nature, using mainly consonants and long vowels. It's script seems to be a very ancient form of {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}.

rows: Near-human features, white skin, usually with a bald head, often tattooed

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Rattataki are a near-human species characterized by their nimble movements, chalk-white skin and oft-bald heads. Virtually isolated from the rest of the galaxy, the Rattataki developed a violent society on their home planet of Rattatak, which involves extensive gladiatorial combat.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: While most other inhabitants of Rattatak came from the Unknown Regions, there are a significant number of off-worlder mercenaries who come to Rattatak from time to time, likely to view or participate in gladiatorial combat, only to be stranded there permanently. The remarkably harsh conditions on the planet nearly drove its population to extinction. For eons, the Rattataki constantly battled amongst themselves and their fellow inhabitants (represented primarily by Humans, Zabraks, Siniteens, Vollick, and Weequay) over the planet's limited resources. Despite being nearly completely isolated from the outside galaxy, the Rattataki displayed remarkable {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and continually created new ways to kill each other.

Rattataki culture is bloody and unforgiving. Punishment for even the smallest crimes is unnecessarily harsh, which does little to quell that behavior. In fact, Rattataki who are known to commit crimes without being caught are celebrated.

entries.name: Names
entries: Rattataki names are harsh sounding and short. Surnames are familial, though many Rattataki abandon them in favor of self-aggrandizing titles.
{@b Male Names.} Aidus, Charnagus, Karok, Veran {@b Female Names.} Amaran, Kassien, Silas, Sraja, Vol {@b Surnames.} Anjek, Danvik, Degger, Kolla, Venkorr

entries.name: Rattataki Traits
entries: As a rattataki, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Dexterity or Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Rattataki reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Rattataki are self-serving and violent which causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Rattataki typically stand about 5 and a half feet tall and weigh 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.
{@b {@i Acrobatic.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Intimidating.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Surprise Attack.}} If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.
{@b {@i Unarmed Combatant.}} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rattataki. Rattataki is known for have an inordinate amount of curses.

rows: Sound mimicry, enhanced hearing and sight

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Rishii are a sentient, avian species of carnivores which possess two legs ending in four-toed feet, two arms, a tail, and a head. The species' two arms consist of feathered wings ending in nimble humanoid hands, capable of manipulating tools. The wings grant the Rishii the ability to fly at great speeds, which is their method of travel equivalent to running in land-based species. A Rishii's head contained a beak between two yellow eyes framed by a large brow. Rishii were capable of mimicking anything said to them perfectly, and also possessed extremely strong senses, particularly hearing and sight.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Native to the planet Rishi, the Rishii live in loose primitive tribes, known as nests, clustered high upon the planet's mountains, away from the hot and humid lowland swamps. Each nest consists of a small number of family units led by a chieftain, with neighbouring nests respecting each others territories and living in harmony. This peaceful and accepting attitude goes beyond just other Rishii and was extended to all neighbours of a nest, including the many other species who colonise the lowlands of Rishi. Due to the unfavorable conditions found in the lowlands, the native avians do not understand the off-worlders' choice to live there, but were not opposed to their presence.

entries.name: Names
entries: As with much of their speech, Rishii names include clicks, trills, and whistles to the point that other peoples have a difficult time pronouncing them. Typically, a name has two to four syllables with the sounds acting as connectors. Rishii names do not vary based on gender. Rishii are responsive to nicknames given by outsiders.

entries.name: Rishii Traits
entries: As a rishii, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Rishii reach adulthood at 10 and generally live no longer than 60 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Rishii tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Rishii range from 4 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh less than 130 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Flight.}} You have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing and Sight.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

{@b {@i Mimicry.}} You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check opposed by your Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rishii. Rishii's clicks, trills, and whistles are difficult for outsiders to learn without the aid of a protocol droid, and so Rishii often feel comfortable speaking to eachother in the language in front of others.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Their homeworld long lost from memory and time, the ryn are a humanoid race of musicians, vagabonds and travelers. The ryn's bodies are covered in soft, short fur, with a head of white hair which is matched by a tuft of hair at the end of their long prehensile tails, excellent for grasping things. Very uniquely ryn in nature, are their beak-like noses that contain fluted holes. These holes allow the ryn to play their 'beaks' like flutes. This talent has been used to communicate between ryn and has uniquely been observed in communication with droids.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Wanderlust consumes the ryn. The ryn are a nomadic species, their original homeworld forgotten, even to them. They cannot abide confinement and constraint, and they itch to move on shortly after they arrive in a new place. Due to their homelessness, musical talent, natural secrecy, and avoidance of written records, ryn developed a nomadic culture and a reputation for confidence games, leaving many species prejudiced against them. In some sectors it is legal to enslave or hunt ryn. Their language is outlawed in many locations, and a large number of ryn women are used as slave breeding stock. They claim that sabaac, the popular card game that took the place of Pazaak in terms of card game prominence, is derived from their use of it as a fortune telling tool in their auguries. These auguries are today favored by hutts, who have a superstitious belief in the card tellings. A peculiar habit is that a ryn cannot sleep in the same location twice.

entries.name: Names
entries: Ryn names have a very melodic tone, taking cues from many different languages from across the galaxy. Ryn do not use surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Corfat, Dirygat, Garya, Nemagary {@b Female Names.} Cogesama, Giani, Gypopha, Simeti

entries.name: Ryn Traits
entries: As a ryn, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence or Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Ryn reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Ryn's superstitious and solitary nature causes them to tend toward balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Ryn typically stand 4 and a half to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Con Artist.}} You have proficiency in one gaming set of your choice.
{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Divination.}} Whether through mystical divination or sheer luck, you can turn failures into successes. When you roll a 1 on the {@dice d20} for an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
{@b {@i Eternal Nomads.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} (your choice).
{@b {@i Musical.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} and one musical instrument of your choice.
{@b {@i Prehensile Tail.}} You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ryn. Ryn uses tones and inflections and is easily described as melodious by anyone who hears it. You can communicate with droids and other ryn without using words through the use of your beak.

rows: Venom-tipped claws, artificial misting vents, cephalic lobes, three-digit hands, two-toed feet

entries.name: Biology & Appearance
entries: The Selkath are an aquatic species, known for being skilled swimmers and diplomats. Their heads resemble sting rays and they have a blue, pink, or green skin naturally patterned as an underwater camouflage. Their mouths are bracketed by cephalic lobes. Female Selkath differed from males due to the presence of tendrils on the back of their heads.

All members of the Selkath race have rectractable, venom-tipped claws. The use of these claws in any form of combat or attack was considered dishonorable and a sign of madness; to do this was to give in to animal instincts unbecoming of a sentient species. Because of the Selkath's water-dwelling nature, their chest armors were fitted with misting vents in order to keep their skin moist.

entries.name: Society & Culture
entries: Selkath are native to the planet Manaan, the only naturally occurring source of the medical liquid referred to as kolto. The Selkath have leveraged this monopoly on maintain their neutrality, peddling their invaluable healing supplies to all comers.

Manaan is an ocean planet is home to only one above-surface settlement, the floating Ahto City, built directly above Hrakert Rift, the most abundant source of kolto on Manaan.  As bacta began to replace the inferior kolto on the galactic stage, Manaan fell from their previously respected position, shirking away their previous prestige and causing many Selkath to disappear from the galactic eye into isolationism and tribalism.

entries.name: Names
entries: Selkath names tend to have a flowing quality to it, like a stream of water. They rarely use surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Chata, Galas, Qual, Morgo, Shaelas {@b Female Names.} Halsuna, Dolmas, Shasa, Ulsuru

entries.name: Selkath Traits
entries: As a selkath, you have the following special traits.
{@b Ability Score Increase.} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b Age.} Selkath reach adulthood in their late teens and live up to 100 years.

{@b Alignment.} Selkath have been renowned for countless millenia of the careful preservation of neutrality. As such individuals tend towards the neutral balanced alignment, though there are exceptions.
{@b Size.} Selkath typically stand between 4 and a half to 5 and a half feet tall and average 130 pounds. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b Speed.} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b Amphibious.} You can breathe air and water.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special claw attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, the target is {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} until the end of its next turn, and you can't use this feature again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b Gift of the Progenitor.} You know the {@i temporary boost} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i kolto pack} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i kolto cloud} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.
{@b Swim.} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.
{@b Languages.} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Selkatha. Selkatha has a very moist and gurgling tone to it.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The selonians are carnivores who are believed to have descended from aquatic mammals. Their bodies are covered by a sleek fur and they normally do not wear clothing. However, when working or visiting offworld, they wear appropriate outfits. Their long bodies are equally comfortable walking on either two or four legs. Their long tails serve as a counterbalance for their bodies when standing upright. These tails are equally capable of being used as potent bludgeoning weapons in combat. At the end of their paw-like hands are retractable claws which not only gives them the capacity to dig but also makes them excellent climbers. They have long pointed faces with bristly whiskers as well as long teeth. Most selonians born are infertile females. One in every hundred are male, and one in every five hundred are fertile females.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Despite the massive starship traffic to Corellia, many visitors and even native Corellians know very little of the selonians and their distinctive unique alien culture. In mindset, they are a thoroughly grounded and serious race who are primarily concerned with the safety of their people. This means that the protection of their family dens and their species as a whole was a chief concern. The basis for this line of thinking is because they viewed that the needs of the society outweighed the needs of the individual. To those unaware of the deeper intricacies of the race, the selonians appear as an outgoing, friendly and charitable species. However, their interests rarely go beyond securing the good of their respective den.

entries.name: Names
entries: Selonian use punctual names with no surnames.
{@b Male Names.} Duldayd, Gov, Krez, Qaran {@b Female Names.} Chu, Driacnear, Fiircasa, Shilis

entries.name: Selonian Traits
entries: As a selonian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Selonians reach adulthood in their mid teens and live for about 75 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Selonians are serious and den-focused, causing them to tend towards lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Selonians typically stand 6 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 180 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.
{@b {@i Climb.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 35 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can—t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Nimble Agility.}} Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the end of the tum. Once you use this trait, you can—t use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

{@b {@i Tail and Claw.}} Your strong tail and razor-sharp claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 35 feet.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mandaba. Selonians use the name "Home Talk" to refer to their own language.

rows: Black or light to dark brown
Black, light to dark brown, grey (usually with age)
Lupine appearance, enhanced senses, increased {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, increased strength, healing ability

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Shistavanen have pronounced muzzles, sharp claws, long pointed teeth, and pointed ears set on top of their heads. Shistavanen also possess large glowing eyes, and can also run at high speeds for long periods without getting tired, alternately using two or four limbs. As predators, they possess keen hearing and smell and excellent night vision.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: As a species, the Shistavanen are isolationists. The species colonized all the unpopulated worlds in the Uvena system to prevent them from being settled by non-Shistavanen, and their restrictive trade laws (which are unapologetic in how they favor their own kind over off-world traders).  Most of their society uses technology similar to the rest of the galaxy, though some parts of Uvena Prime use slightly less sophisticated technology.

A minority of Shistavanen are more outgoing, and travel the galaxy's hyperlanes. Even these Shistavanen usually remain by themselves or with other Shistavanen. Due to their natural predatory instincts, Shistavanen commonly find employment as scouts, mercenaries and bounty hunters. Many other species react badly to Shistavanen, since their isolationist culture makes them an unfamiliar sight, and their predatory appearance put other species on edge.

entries.name: Names
entries: Shistavanen first names typically sound graceful, while their surnames are more gutteral. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Bustuc, Hulvav, Kembol, Nemdav, Sirul {@b Female Names.} Gaeft, Laer, Recloz, Shaalir, Thovnim {@b Surnames.} Ghirat, Lakrevl, Meq, Nukroft, Rosk

entries.name: Shistavanen Traits
entries: As a shistavanen, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Shistavanen reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Shistavanen are private and tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Shistavanen typically stand around 6 feet tall and weigh between 140 and 190 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Forced March.}} Shistavanen are able to maintain a fast pace longer than other species. Shistavanen have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb} due to prolongued travel, as described in Chapter 8.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing and Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.

{@b {@i Regenerative.}} When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

{@b {@i Tooth and Nail.}} Your fangs and claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Shistavanen. The Shistavanen language is characterized by its barks and growls.

rows: White, gray, black, brown, blue, violet, or red

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Squibs are small, sentient, humanoid mammals with both rodent and canine characteristics. Their pink skin is covered in fur that offers some protection from cold weather, but, more importantly, it serves as an olfactory organ, able to pick up scents at a distance and ascertain intrinsic details—such as penetrating through a disguise or identifying a forgery—when rubbed against. The species has both male and female sexes, although non-Squibs often have difficulty determining the sex of a Squib based on appearance alone. Their mouths are full of forbidding, sharp, white teeth, and their flexible cheeks were capable of storing items.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Squibs are friendly and cheerful to such an extent that, over time, they are considered quite annoying. Squibs are inherently curious, handling items with little regard to care. They are unabashed pack rats, and they wear clothing for the excess storage rather than necessity. The Squibs' overconfidence is a defining trait. The typical Squib response to a threat is not to fight or flee, but to bluff and bluster, especially when not face-to-face. In person, their sharp teeth are their favored means of intimidation. Squibs believe that bargaining is the highest form of communication, and they believe haggling is more important than the goods themselves. A deal is a binding oath to Squibs, and they are incredibly loyal to their business partners.

entries.name: Names
entries: Squibs combine their first and last names, which are familial, into one long, hyphenated name. They often go by nicknames derived from their full names. Male and female names do not significantly deviate.
{@b Full Names.} Galaneever-marmalios, Meelawin-demort, Sleerinwilpher-remalior {@b Nicknames.} Galan, Meela, Wilpher

entries.name: Squib Traits
entries: As a squib, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Squibs reach adulthood at nine years of age and live an average of sixty-five years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Squibs' cheerful nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Squibs typically stand 3 to 3 and a half feet tall and weigh around 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Bite.}} Your sharp teeth are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Business Savvy.}} A common trait of all Squibs is their desire and love of haggling. Squibs believe a deal is done when both sides believe they got the better of the other. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check involving haggling you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Flexible Cheeks.}}  Squibs have flexible cheeks in which they can store small goods. You can store up to two items that weigh a combined total of no more than 2 lb. in your cheeks, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) checks made to conceal them.
{@b {@i Hide.}} Your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.
{@b {@i Keen Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

{@b {@i Sensitive Fur.}} Squibs' fur is exceptionally sensitive to physical details. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on touch.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Squibbian. The Squibbian language originated as a secret form of communication for Squibs to convey information without being understood.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Ssi-ruuk are a predatory, warm-blooded saurian species gifted with ferocious strength, remarkable {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and sharp fangs and claws, traits that serve them well in the volcanic jungles of their homeworld of Lwhekk. Their muscular forms combined with their powerful tails make them very agile hunters, and their colorfully-scaled hides have been proven to be resistant even to {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} bolts. From their nostrils, two scent-tongues protrude that grant them enhanced olfactory senses, compensating for the poor vision afforded them by their dark, three-lidded eyes. No Ssi-ruu has ever been known to be Force-sensitive.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The citizens of the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium follow a rigid caste system in which their station in society is determined by the color of the scales they are born with. Among these, the brown-scaled outcasts are regarded as the lowest of the low, and have no place in the Imperium beyond menial labor or death at birth. Deeply xenophobic and religious, the Ssi-ruuk view the rest of the galaxy as populated by lesser beings whose worlds rightfully belong to the Imperium. Despite their fierce nature, most ssi-ruuk are afraid of dying on a world unconsecrated by their priest caste, as they believe their souls would be doomed, so they harvest and "entech" the life-energy of other species to power droids that fight for them. The entechment process is torturous and painful to its victims, and is the main power source of Ssi-ruuvi technology.

entries.name: Names
entries: Ssi-ruuvi names are difficult to pronounce and gender neutral. Many ssi-ruuk adopt nicknames to make the lives of their associates easier. Ssi-ruuk do not have surnames.
{@b Names.} Firwirrung, Ivpikkis, Sh'tk'ith, Th'twirirl, Yifaii

entries.name: Ssi-Ruu Traits
entries: As a ssi-ruu, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Ssi-ruuk reach adulthood in their early teens and live to between 100 and 120 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Ssi-ruuk's cultural drive to enslave and entech others cause them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Ssi-ruuk typically stand between 6 or 7 feet tall and weigh over 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.
{@b {@i Type.}} Your creature type is both beast and humanoid.

{@b {@i Force-Insensitive.}} While Ssi-ruuk can be manipulated by many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, they can not sense the Force. You can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.
{@b {@i Hunter.}} You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Keen Smell.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

{@b {@i Natural Empathy.}} Ssi-ruuk have scent-tongues that let them read the emotions of individuals. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

{@b {@i Sunlight Sensitivity.}} You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

{@b {@i Thick Skin.}} You have tough, scaly skin and prefer not to wear clothes. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Tooth and Nail.}} Your fangs and claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ssi-ruuvi. Ssi-ruuvi is a language of musical whistles, honks and clicks, and is nigh impossible for humans and similar species to speak.

rows: Large ears, scarns, ultra-sensitive hearing, jet-black eyes, two flaps of jowls around their cheeks

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: A diminutive species of near-humans, Sullustans bear round, tapered skulls. Sullustans are distinguishable for their almond-shaped black eyes, facial jowls called dewflaps and large, round ears. Their wide earlobes provide excellent hearing, and their large eyes provide exceptional low-light vision. Due to their relative lack of exposure to natural light, Sullustans begin to suffer from corneal defects after 30 standard years. Many choose to wear special visors to prevent further damage. Some Sullustans tattoo their heads as a form of individual expression.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Sullustans are outgoing and mercantile, friendly and pragmatic. As a species they are altogether lacking in xenophobia. Though fond of practical jokes and extremely shrewd in their business dealings, they are eager to explore and travel the galaxy. Inquisitive by nature, some have described Sullustans as reckless, especially for their preference to learn and discover whenever possible through personal experience. Sullustans organize themselves into familial units known as Warren-clans. Each clan consists of one polyandrous female, several husbands, and their young. Unmated females, known as "Fems", are active members of their communities until they reach breeding status, called "Ready", when they choose their mates.

entries.name: Names
entries: Male names are typically longer than female names. Surnames are based on Warren-clan.
{@b Male Names.} Duedt, Oshror, Partheen, Throthinnitz {@b Female Names.} Asulu, Eldo, Tri, Vo, We {@b Surnames.} Frovarr, Jeard, Plonr, Tsah, Vhiibb

entries.name: Sullustan Traits
entries: As a sullustan, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Sullustan reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Sullustans' outgoing and friendly nature cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Sullustans typically stand 4 and a half to 5 feet tall and weigh around 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Keen Hearing.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

{@b {@i Mercantile.}} Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check related to conducting business, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Pilot.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Sullestese, and one more language of your choice. Sullestese is characterized as a robust language in business, and as such is commonly learned by professional merchants.

rows: Black, dark blue, or dark red
Covered in fur, four eyes, unable to speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Talz are large, bulky, bipedal creatures, that are covered head to toe in thick white fur, which provides exceptional insulation against their frozen world. Talz have four eyes, which are also adaptations to their native environment. The larger set of eyes are shut during the day, when sunlight reflects off the snow with dazzling brightness—able to blind sensitive optical organs—leaving the smaller set to navigate with.
