Alternatively, during the deep darkness of their homeworld's moonless night, the larger pair are utilized to provide the Talz with adequate vision. Talz use a small proboscis to eat and communicate, creating high-pitched chirps and buzzes.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Talz are a hunter-gatherer, clan-based society. They work in unison, and treat the entire clan as one single familial entity. Resources on Ordo Plutonia are often scarce, which leads to warring among Talz tribes. However, the clans are adept at forming a unified front when they face a common enemy.

Talz are large, brutal creatures and are often used as guards and enforcers. Sometimes they are taken as slaves, though it's rare; they are rebellious against authority and don't take well to slavery. There are rumors that Talz are captured for scientific experimentation.

entries.name: Names
entries: Talz names are fairly gutteral and are characterized by their harsh nature. Female names are typically longer than male names. Surnames are clan-based, though it's rare that a Talz shares them with non-Talz.
{@b Male Names.} Drak, Fedirk, Imom, Ke, Twift {@b Female Names.} Ilnuno, Ontuga, Utrukk, Zimtucc {@b Surnames.} Dic, Noetoc, Suptat, Wume, Zapak

entries.name: Talz Traits
entries: As a talz, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Talz reach adulthood at 10 and rarely live longer than 50 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Talz' peaceful and slow-to-anger nature cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Talz stand between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh around 250 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} Your vision can easily cut through darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Hide.}} You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.
{@b {@i Long-Limbed.}} When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write Talzzi. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it. Talzzi is characterized by its high-pitched chirps and buzzes.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Tarasins are tall reptilians covered in translucent scales that allows the species' color-changing skin below to show through. Tarasins also have a colorful fan of flesh and scales—known as a kampo—that opens around their heads when they experience strong emotional distress, which can be a detriment to negotiations, as it is difficult for a tarasin to hide discomfort. This color-changing ability is useful for camouflage and communication, and the scales naturally repel heat. Some examples of colors they take on include being brown when calm and in a comfortable environment, or becoming red after extended exertion or when excited. Tarasins also have short spines that protrude from their forearms—known as a sa'tosin—which give the creatures the ability to sense the use of the Force. Tarasins are naturally curious and protective but also slow to anger. What they lack in sheer physical strength they make up for with a brilliant intellect.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Tarasins live in a tribal system in the jungle underbrush of Cularin, grouping together in clans called irstat. The tarasin believe they have a symbiotic relationship with Cularin, and their religion is based around the appreciation of the natural world. This closeness with their homeworld is what makes the tarasin reluctant to leave it for an extended time. The tarasin have a strong connection with the Force, and their spiritual leaders are often able to call upon the Force in small ways. The tarasin believe that the ch'hala tree is sacred. This may have been influenced by the trees having a similar ability to shift their colors as the tarasin, but it is also the most unique tree on Cularin.

entries.name: Names
entries: Tarasin names are generally very soft and melodic. Names are agendered, and surnames are not used.
{@b Names.} Feliosa, Misona, Nissira, Vylana, Ziransa

entries.name: Tarasin Traits
entries: As a tarasin, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Tarasins reach adulthood at 10 and live less than 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Tarasins' curious yet composed nature causes them to tend toward balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Tarasins typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 130 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Chameleon Skin.}} Your scales are translucent, allowing your color-shifting skin to help you blend into your surroundings. You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill. Additionally, you can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.
{@b {@i Jungle Dweller.}} Growing up in the jungles of Cularin has left an impact. You don't treat jungle terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.
{@b {@i Naturalist.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Sa'tosin Sense.}} Tarasins have short spines called sa'tosin that allow them to sense the use of the Force. You are constantly under the effects of the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} {@i sense force}, though the power does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} for you.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Tarasinese. You can communicate non-verbally with other tarasins through use of a complex system of skin color changes.

rows: Bony and ridged skulls, tendrils  and fin-like protrusions on the back of their heads

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Taung are a humanoid species of tall and strong sentient simians. Physically, the taung are extremely resilient and are able to endure hardships many other species are unable to, which benefits their warlike nature as well as their tendencies to conquer planets.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Taung society is one steeped in war, and the taung are warriors above all else. Nomadic and clan-based, the taung greatly value strength and honor, with pragmatism and ruthlessness being common traits amongst them. Originally waging war as a means of ritual worship to their god Kad Ha'rangir, the taung eventually became the Mandalorians, and - under the leadership of Mandalore the Indomitable - the act of war itself became the center of Mandalorian worship, and to wage war is to {@i be} divine.
Despite their volatile nature, the taung are far from primitive, and maintain a high priority in procuring the latest technological advancements whenever possible.

The Mandalorian armor that has become iconic throughout the galaxy originally began with the culture's taung founders, with their unique helmets and war masks being forged in the image of the taung's face, including slanted outer angles and a pointed chin. However, the armor is quite sparse among the taung as they believe that unarmed combat brings the highest honor.

entries.name: Names
entries: Taung names reflect their practical nature, typically choosing names that correspond to traits they deem desirable. Their names are rarely gender specific and can apply to either male or female. Their surnames reflect that of the clan they hail from.
{@b First Names.} Adenn (merciless), Atin (stubborn), Kot (strength), Kotep (brave), Tor (justice), Verd (soldier) {@b Surnames.} Cadera, Fett, Keldau, Lok, Ordo, Vizla

entries.name: Taung Traits
entries: As a taung, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Taung reach adulthood at 13 and live to around 85, though they rarely live even half the length as they naturally can due to their deadly lifestyles as Mandalorians.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} The taung live by the traditions and honor-bound code of the Mandalorians, making them tend towards a lawful alignment, typically balanced or dark, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Taung typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 210 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.
{@b {@i Toughness.}} Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

{@b {@i Relentless Endurance.}} When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b {@i Taung Weapon Training.}} You gain proficiency in one {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} and one {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} of your choice.
{@b {@i Menacing.}} You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Force Insensitive.}} While taung can be manipulated by the force, they cannot sense the Force. You can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mando'a. Mando'a is primarily a spoken language and is very expressive with simple grammar.

rows: Small horns, pale skin, colorful hair

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The original appearance of the theelin is officially uncertain, as almost all known "theelin" are not full-blooded specimens, but hybrids. It is possible that some aspects of these individuals' appearances are not from their theelin genes, but from other near-human ancestors. Most, however, have vividly colored hair and pale skin, often mottled with colorful spots. Unfortunately, a series of mutations arose among later generations of theelin. These mutations have led to genetic incompatibilities within their species, making it impossible to produce offspring. Even attempts to continue their species by cross-breeding with other near-humans could not stop the theelin slide towards extinction, due to the high infant mortality rates such couplings suffer from. Theelin began inevitably dwindling in number—only a few million theelin and part-theelin remain by the time the Republic fell, and pure theelin are presumed extinct by the fall of the Empire. Some of their greatest works are produced in these years, however, as an epitaph for a dying people.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Theelin performers and artists created many of the galaxy's greatest works of art. The Theelin Divas, an all-female religious order, are recognized by many scholars of music as the greatest singers in the galaxy. Because of the rarity of the theelin, many female theelin and part-theelin are named "Diva" at birth, in hopes that they will develop the musical talent necessary to continue the traditions of the Diva order.

entries.name: Names
entries: Theelin use names similar to those in their community, typically human-similar names with exotic tinges.
{@b Male Names.} Dhess, Gooti, J—nsone, Qylett {@b Female Names.} F—niss, Diva, Prystill, Saqua {@b Surnames.} Joolie, Masozi, Oasay, Rellik

entries.name: Theelin Traits
entries: As a theelin, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Theelin reach adulthood in their late teens and live for about 70 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Theelin's good-nature and positivity despite the dour state of their species causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Theelin typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Expressive.}} You have proficiency in your choice of artist's implements, disguise kits, synthweaver's implements, or one musical instrument of your choice.
{@b {@i Performer.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} skill.
{@b {@i Skill Versatility.}} You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice.
{@b {@i Mutation.}} Theelin gain unique mutations, a result of cross-breeding with other humanoids. Choose one of the following mutations.

items: {@b Balanced Hooves.} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.
{@b Darkvision.}  You can see in dim light within 30 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b Enhanced Senses.} Choose one from hearing, sight, or smell. Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to the chosen sense, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b Heightened Reflexes.} Whenever you make a Dexterity {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can choose to add 1d4 to the result. You can choose to do this after the check is rolled, but before the DM determines if you—ve passed or failed the check. You cannot do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b Unarmed Combatant.} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

rows: Black, blond, brown, grey, or white (with age)

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Thisspiasians are easily recognized by their abundant beards and their long tails, which often reach over six feet. These tails are very strong and are commonly used to carry large objects. When meditating or at rest, a thisspiasian will coil their tail beneath their torso, reducing their height by several feet. They also possess four arms, with the upper set being stronger and larger. Each of their four hands have five fingers, and each finger is tipped with a long, sturdy claw. It is thought unsophisticated or unseemly by upper-class thisspiasians to have the bottom two visible in public, so they are generally hidden from sight via larger garments, with the smaller limbs sometimes even bound to their bodies. Thisspiasians need very little sleep to function normally, resting for only two hours a day, with brief meditative moments scattered throughout the day to refocus.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Thisspiasian culture is one of proud warriors who keep their emotions well-concealed and their rages checked. Many outsiders see only a thisspiasian's outward facade of tranquility, and to most being it seems as if thisspiasians existed in a sea of calm. This is far from the truth, however, as they are in truth a very passionate species below the surface. A thisspiasian who doesn't meditate as often as they should will often be prone to otherwise atypical emotional outbursts.
Thisspias is ruled by a hereditary leader called the Blood Monarch. Due to their seemingly archaic ruling structure, thisspiasians are often considered out-of-touch.

entries.name: Names
entries: Thisspiasian names typically are composed of two similar sounding syllables. Surnames are familial.
{@b First Names.} Annak, Effed, Emmet, Gorro, Koto {@b Surnames.} Albarn, Braibel, Kirsingr, Raledurn

entries.name: Thisspiasian Traits
entries: As a thisspiasian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Thisspiasians reach adulthood in their 20s and often live more than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Thisspiasians' emotional composure causes them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Thisspiasians typically stand 5 to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.
{@b {@i Cultured.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Four-Armed.}} Thisspiasians have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

{@b {@i Inscrutable.}} Your calm demeanor and control make you hard to read. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against an effect that would read your thoughts.
{@b {@i Prehensile Tail.}} You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

{@b {@i Trance.}} You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Thisspiasian. Thisspiasian is a complex language characterized by its interlocking sentences and heavy use of sibilants.

rows: Long necks, sharp teeth, colorful scales, tails

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Tiss'shar are bipedal therapods descended from predatory reptilians native to the humid jungle continents of Tiss'sharl. They are relatively strong and agile, with long necks, slender torsos, wider hips, and a short but wiry tail. Their mouths are filled with short, sharp teeth, and their large tongues are pink and constantly moving. Their large eyes appear glassy as a result of the clear, resilient film that covered and protected them. Many tiss'shar have prominent sickle-shaped claws on the first toe of their feet; some also possessed a crest of feathers atop their heads.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Tiss'shar social structure is inextricably tied to business. Nearly all tiss'shar families have a corporation as a patron, which provides the family with its material needs in exchange for the dedicated labor of its members. Patron corporations regularly supply food, housing, health care, education, and security services. The predatory instincts of the tiss'shar, redirected into the realm of business, often serve them well. While no stereotype fully defines the species, they often were considered aggressive, resourceful, calculating businessbeings. These traits also made them excellent assassins and gunfighters, renowned galaxywide for their efficiency. Most tiss'shar had an appreciation for the art of the deal, and conducted their business legitimately; even those who chose the path of the assassin remembered that they were conducting business and respected their contracts.

entries.name: Names
entries: Tiss'shar names are segmented, with males receiving an additional "tail name." Surnames always come last.
{@b Male Names.} Si-Di-Ri, Tra-Skan-Lor, Geor-Dan-Thi {@b Female Names.} Von-Ra, Ura-Vaza, Shu-Xangiz, Sav-Lork

entries.name: Tiss'shar Traits
entries: As a tiss'shar, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Strength, Intelligence, or Charisma score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Tiss'shar reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Tiss'shar's moral flexibility causes them to tend towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Tiss'shar typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} Your vision can easily cut through darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can—t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Predatory Talents.}} You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}, Sleight of Hand, {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Surprise Attack.}} If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

{@b {@i Tooth and Nail.}} Your sharp teeth and claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special bite attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1), and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Tiss'shar. Tiss'shar is mainly formed of hisses, shrieks, and lisping vocalizations. As a written language, it has a violent-looking calligraphy of curves and sharp lines.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Tognath are a sentient species native to Yar Togna. Yar Togna is a foul-smelling, high-gravity planet with a toxic, fume-saturated atmosphere. As a result, tognath wear a breathing apparatus to process the oxygen content in a planet's atmosphere. The tognath have a striking look thanks to their insectoid and mammalian characteristics; another factor is their having both an endo- and exoskeleton. They also possess a very primitive nervous system, which provides them with immunity to most pain (a helpful trait in combat). Tognath begin life as larvae born from egg clutches hatched in a suspension jelly, and latch onto one of their parents, feeding directly from their bloodstream. While in that jelly, two or more eggs (not necessarily from the same parent) sometimes graft together, thus creating a bond that continues throughout the life of the eggmates. Six months later, parents visit a nursery tree, where the young detatch from them and spin a cocoon. Within, the offspring undergo a metamorphosis, developing both their skeletons to resist the high gravity and pressures of Yar Togna.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Tognath live in stilted homes with lava channels near the main mountain range of Yar Togna, where they have access to mountain springwater. Most of tognath society believes that mate selection and egg laying should occur late in life, after having dedicated most of one's prime years to a career. This means that parents are generally retired and dote on their children relentlessly, often homeschooling them after their transformation.

entries.name: Names
entries: Tognath use generally simple, nongendered names, without bothering with surnames.
{@b First Names.} Darjia, Essec, Irion, Tathak

entries.name: Tognath Traits
entries: As a tognath, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores increase by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Tognath reach adulthood by 10 and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Tognath are famously dedicated and hard workers, causing them to tend towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Tognath typically stand 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Crafters.}} You have proficiency with one set of artisan's implements of your choice.
{@b {@i Exoskeleton.}} You have a thick exoskeleton. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Foreign Biology.}} You cannot breathe oxygen. The tognath have created a breathing apparatus to negate the negative effects of living in an oxygen rich environment, but if your mask is removed while you are in such an environment, you lose consciousness.

{@b {@i Life in the Void.}} You have resistance to necrotic damage, and while exposed to the vacuum of space, you can survive for a number of hours equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 hour), instead of a number of rounds.

{@b {@i Primitive Nerves.}} Because of their primitive nervous systems, tognath are immune to most pain, letting them shrug off major injuries. When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to roll a {@dice d12}. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled, and reduce the damage by that total. Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Vocalizer.}} Tognath vocal cords are not made for oxygen rich environments, and rely on a vocalizer to communicate effectively with other species. If your vocalizer is removed or destroyed, your voice becomes quiet and difficult to understand.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write Tognath. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it.

rows: Large frame, retractable claws, striped fur, rigid honor code

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Togorian people are a feline warrior species native to the planet Togoria. They are large, heavy-framed bipeds, with retractable claws on their hands and feet. Female Togorians grow up to 7 feet tall, while adult males can reach up to 9 feet. They're covered in gray-white, black, brown, or orange fur, often with colorful spots or stripes.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Togorians have a unique cultural division between their sexes. They evolved as nomadic hunters of creatures like the bist and etelo, surviving on the wilderness as apex predators. As time went on, a rift in their society developed between the two sexes. Males were drawn to continue their lifestyle as nomads and hunters for their people, while females tended to prefer remaining in permanent camps and contributed the vast majority of their species technological developments. This division has continued into modern times, with males continuing their nomadic traditions and females frequently preferring to stay in villages and cities. Males visit their mates for about a month each year, but otherwise the sexes live completely separate lives. Whether in spite of this separation of the sexes, or because of it, Togorians are typically monogamous and devoted to their chosen mates.

entries.name: Names
entries: Togorian names tend to be short and primal-sounding. Female names tend to include softer consonants and more vowels, while male names are typically harsher. Togorians do not use surnames.
{@b Male Names.}  Mezgraf, Mlatar, Morto, Mrrov, Torr {@b Female Names.} Coelle, Elotis, H'sishi, Kra'ake, Rrowv

entries.name: Togorian Traits
entries: As a togorian, you have the following special traits.
{@b Ability Score Increase.} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity or Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b Age.} Togorian reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b Alignment.} Togorians' rigid sense of honor causes them to tend toward lawful light side, though there are exceptions.

{@b Size.} Togorians tower over almost all other species, with smaller females standing upwards of 7 feet tall and weighing 250 lbs., while males can easily reach 8 feet tall and weigh around 350 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b Speed.} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Claws.}} Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

{@b Savage Attacks.} When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}.
{@b Stealthy Hunter.} You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skills.
{@b Toughness.} Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.
{@b Languages.} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Togorese. Togorese is characterized by its deep, resonating growls.

rows: Two wings, facial tusks, snout, three fingers and toes on appendages

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: A mammalian species of winged, stout bodied humanoids, the Toydarians have stubby facial tusks which protruded from their lower jaw and framed a short pudgy trunk. While their stubby legs can support their body weight, Toydarians' primary mode of locomotion was their use of the wings on their upper back. Though their wings can beat as fast as ten times a second, the effort burned up large amounts of energy, causing the species to need to replenish itself often through regularly eating mass quantities of food. In order to fuel this hyperactive metabolism, Toydarians eat concentrated foods and egg-seeds. Most of the bloodiest wars in their history were fought over food supplies.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Despite being ruled by the Hutts, the Toydarian people are able to govern themselves free of major outside intervention through the establishment of a feudal monarchy. A ruling king sits on the planet's throne, allowing vassals to form allegiances and have minor disputes to solve their own problems. The king makes sure to keep his vassals happy and to have their allegiance, but will occasionally encourage infighting to reveal the true character of the vassals and weed out treachery.
Toydarians are known as shrewd businessmen.

entries.name: Names
entries: Toydarian names are fairly simple and guttural, but a few harsher elements can be found here and there. Male names are generally shorter than female names. Female names always end in a vowel.
{@b Male Names.} Dod, Nesteddo, Tul, Zloomroo {@b Female Names.} Fefiffe, Lenlibo, Nugni, Zoldibu {@b Surnames.} Daab, Faabb, Kepo, Mitra, Vulba

entries.name: Toydarian Traits
entries: As a toydarian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Toydarians reach adulthood at 10 and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Toydarians' greedy nature causes them to tend toward chaotic balanced, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Toydarians average 4 feet tall and weigh less than 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Business Savvy.}} A common trait of all Toydarians is their shrewd business sense and their ability to haggle any deal. A loyal and proud people, these traits could be off-putting to outsiders, as many Toydarians in the galaxy were seen as crooks or slimy businessmen, but this was not always the case. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check involving haggling you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Closed Mind.}} Toydarian brains have an unusual composition which made them resistant to influence from the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

{@b {@i Flight.}} You have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.
{@b {@i Shrewd Demeanor.}} You have proficiency in two Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skills of your choice.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}, and Toydarian.

rows: Diminutive stature, porcine features, technological affinity

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Ugnaughts are diminutive, porcine humanoids who have pink skin, upturned noses, white hair, and thick layers of jowls. Some have tusks that they use in blood duels. They are strong and resilient, and their life-spans reached up to 200 standard years. They notably eat genteslugs.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Ugnaughts are ruled by councils comprised of elected officers. Ugnaughts live their lives in accordance to their "blood profession", with Ugnaught parents teaching their children their trade. Infant Ugnaughts are known as Ugletts. If the number of new Ugnaughts in a given profession exceeds the need, a blood duel is called. When the Ugnaughts reached their twentieth year of age, these fights are held to the death, with the victor winning the right to inherit their blood profession. Despite this outdated and violent custom, the Ugnaughts are generally a peaceful people with a rich culture.

When greeting an Ugnaught, it is advised to bow silently, then wait for a guttural purring as a positive response. Usage of the common galactic greeting "yaa-yaah" is considered a personal insult to Ugnaughts. If this occurrs, it was advisable to duck and {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, as various mechanical implements will be thrown one's way.
Ugnaughts are often enslaved as they are fairly meek.

entries.name: Names
entries: Ugnaught names are generally concise. Female names sound more cheerful. Surnames are determined by blood profession.
{@b Male Names.} Banax, Dral, Durn, Togre, Yirkux {@b Female Names.} Admeva, Olnito, Ruskor, Vurlilli {@b Surnames.} Col, Gnatro, Mikk, Roc, Sag

entries.name: Ugnaught Traits
entries: As an ugnaught, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Ugnaughts reach adulthood at 20 and can live to reach 200.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Ugnaughts tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.
{@b {@i Size.}} Ugnaughts typically stand around 4 feet and weigh about 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25.

{@b {@i Bite.}} Your tusks are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.
{@b {@i Crafters.}} You have proficiency in one tool of your choice.
{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Industrial Hazards.}} You have resistance to acid damage.

{@b {@i Tech Dabbler.}} You know the {@i mending} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i analyze} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i overheat} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

{@b {@i Tinker.}} You have proficiency with {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements}. You can use these and spend 1 hour and 100 cr worth of materials to construct a Tiny Device (AC 5, 1 hp). You can take the {@action Use an Object|sw5e-phb} action to have your device cause one of the following effects: create a small explosion, create a repeating loud noise for 1 minute, create smoke for 1 minute, cause harmless tremors for 1 minute. You can maintain a number of these devices up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} at once, and a device stops functioning after 24 hours away from you. You can dismantle the device to reclaim the materials used to create it.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy shields. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ugnaught. The Ugnaught language is composed of grunts, squeals, and chatters, and is difficult for other species to learn.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Ugors are sentient, unicellular protozoans. Considered exotic for being one of the few sentient species to fall outside the standard classificiations of birds, mammals, etc. Their bodies consist of cytoplasm, which can vary in colors and shade, bound by a slime-coated membrane. Being amorphic, ugors can assume nearly any shape, and can exude pseudopodia limbs such as crude arms, mouths, and sensory organs, although a globular form was the most comfortable and easy to maintain. Due to their unique physiology and evolution, they are able to digest substances that would prove toxic to other species, and can subsist on other species' trash. While most maintain globular form, some who interact with humanoid species will wear EVA suits or armor to give themselves a humanoid appearence.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Ugor society revolves around trading and scavenging; they are famed for providing equipment to nascent civilizations and for salvaging wreckage from failed ones. The beings are supremely adaptable and astutely able to get what they want from others. Ugor business deals are extremely complex, incorporating opaque knots of loans, interest, and payment plans. Ugors have an intense love of trash, which they base their religions off, and excel at those skills that are useful in their pursuit of rubbish collection: a member of the species' education emphasizes skills related to scavenging and starship operation (although members of the species rarely became more than passable pilots).

entries.name: Names
entries: Ugor names typically consisted of two parts, with no notable difference between the genders. Ugor do not use surnames.
{@b Names.} ArrGack, GrrKack, SplrMuck

entries.name: Ugor Traits
entries: As an ugor, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}}  Ugors reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 70 years, though some live to be over 100.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Ugors are loyal to their theocratic state and see outsiders as expendable. Many follow a Lawful Balanced alignment, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Ugors typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh 130 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

{@b {@i Amorphous Form.}} You can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide, provided you are wearing and carrying nothing. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} you make to initiate or escape a grapple.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can—t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
{@b {@i Galactic Scavengers.}} You have proficiency in mechanic's kits or scavenging kits (your choice).
{@b {@i Natural Resilience.}} You have resistance to poison damage, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison.

{@b {@i Shape Self.}} If you are not {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, you can reshape your body to give yourself a head, one or two arms, one or two legs, and makeshift hands and feet, or you can revert to a limbless blob (no action required). As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can extrude a pseudopod that is up to 6 inches wide and 10 feet long or reabsorb it into your body. You can use this pseudopod to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour out the contents of a container. The pseudopod can—t attack, activate enhanced items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read and write in {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ugor. Additionally, Your vocal range allows you to speak languages other species might have difficulty with.

rows: Blue tinted skin and sunken, colorless eyes

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Umbarans, called the "Shadow People" by some, are a near-human species characterized by their pale, bluish skin and colorless, sunken eyes. Their homeworld, Umbara, is situated deep within the Ghost Nebula, and receives almost no direct light from the planet's primary star. As a result, Umbaran eyes are well-adjusted to seeing in low light, and can see into the ultraviolet spectrum, but can be disoriented by bright light.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Umbaran society is strictly divided into a leveled caste system, with most Umbarans constantly scheming to improve their social rank, using tactics such as blackmail, subterfuege, and even assassination if necessary. Only those within the ten highest caste tiers were given opportunities to leave their homeworld. Because of the cutthroat machinations required to get there, Umbarans in the wider galaxy are known as skilled, ruthless politicians. This reputation is enhanced by the Umbarans' talents for reading and influencing the emotions of others.
Umbara developed its own technological advances separate from galactic society, and possessed technology that was in many fields far more advanced than the galactic standard.

entries.name: Names
entries: Umbaran names are typically no more than one or two syllables. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Mee, Pir, Nyss, Moshenu {@b Female Names.} Sly, Syll, Myn, Sata {@b Surnames.} Deechi, Moore, Phobi, Nenn

entries.name: Umbaran Traits
entries: As an umbaran, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma or Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Umbarans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

{@b {@i Alignment.}} Umbarans' desire to improve their social standing at all costs causes them to tend towards chaos, though there are exceptions {@b {@i Size.}} Umbarans typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Superior Darkvision.}} You've lived most of your life without direct sunlight. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Umbaran Specilization.}} You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Tech Dabbler.}} You know the {@i ward} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i analyze} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you can also cast the {@i infiltrate} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. Intelligence is your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for these powers. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.
{@b {@i Shadow People.}} You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by dim light.

{@b {@i Sunlight Sensitivity.}} You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Umbaran. Umbaran is characterized by its blending of technical jargon with informal language. It is rarely spoken off Umbara.

rows: Hive-based insectoids, radio wave senses, technological aptitude, hardened carapace, short snouts, and small, toothless mouths

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Verpine are thin bipedal insectoids whose heads are dominated by large compound eyes. They also have two antennae, one located behind each eye. Their hardened carapace, composed of a green chitinous substance called carahide, is as flexible as the skin of other creatures, yet tough enough to deflect a blade or even absorb a glancing {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} bolt. The Verpine circulatory system does not contain a heart.

Verpine eyes are keen enough to pick out microscopic details. Their antennae contain tympanic nerves which pick up sound. Their antennae are also sensitive to radio waves, giving Verpine the natural ability to sense and transmit radio waves to communicate with another Verpine in their language over long distances.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Verpine people hail from the Roche asteroid field, which is the fractured remnants of their home planet. The Roche live in artificial, self-sustaining environments inside these fragments.

Verpine culture is oriented around crafting; they are noteworthy manufacturers of weapons, shield generators, armor, as well as personal use items such as breathing apparatuses. They are also gifted pilots.

entries.name: Names
entries: Verpine had variable naming customs. Not all Verpines adopt surnames. Male and female Verpine names do not differentiate.
{@b First Names.} Fxz'et, Kuli, Moegid, Ss's, Zix {@b Surnames.} And'et, Ned'Ix, Ned'lx, Niskooen, Zes'sx

entries.name: Verpine Traits
entries: As a verpine, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Verpine reach adulthood in their 40's and live an average of 200 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Verpine's altruistic and generous nature cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Verpine stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and rarely weigh more than 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Crafters.}} You have proficiency in one tool of your choice.
{@b {@i Hardened Carapace.}} While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

{@b {@i Tympanic Antennae.}} You have {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb|tremorsense} out to 30 feet. You can detect and pinpoint the origin of vibrations within that radius, provided that monster and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same ground or substance. {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb} can't be used to detect flying or incorporeal creatures {@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write Verpine. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it. You can communicate with other Verpine at distances of up to a mile using your antennae.

rows: Mechanical apperance, unique patterns and markings along face, neck, and body

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Voss are humanoid sentients with a high rate of Force-sensitivity who display prominent sexual dimorphism. The male Voss have blue skin and bright orange eyes, while the females have red skin and azure eyes. The Voss do not have hair or distinct pupils, and posess unique patterns of markings on their face, neck, and body, a trace of their shared ancestry with Gormak. Their voices have a slight mechanical tinge to them, making them sound somewhat like a droid or machine. Voss undogo a physical, developmental change during their marriage ceremonies (known as the Rite of Ardor) and do not develop sexually prior to the performance of these rituals.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: The Voss species resides in the isolated mountain-top city of Voss-Ka and is vastly outnumbered on their homeworld by its other native sentient species, the Gormak, who are extremely hostile toward them and from whom they arose. Most Voss live peacefully in Voss-Ka, caring for their families, cultivating the wild plants and maintaining equipment for the Voss commandos in the war against the Gormak, although some Voss do live outside the capital city, such as the Voss Mystics who reside in the Shrine of Healing. The Voss are great lovers of art, and their architecture features a distinctive artistic style. The entire Voss society is guided by the Force visions of Voss Mystics, which are considered infallible without exception.

entries.name: Names
entries: All Voss have two short names, connected by a hyphen, with the family name being the second one.
{@b Male Names.} Char, Edan, Fadith, Nodin, Orin {@b Female Names.} Amin, Magra, Tala, Weylin, Yana {@b Surnames.} -Ko, -La, -Po, -Rae, -Va

entries.name: Voss Traits
entries: As a voss, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Voss reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century. They do not reach sexual maturity until they undergo the Rite of Ardor.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} As Voss culture encourages duty and emotional composure, individuals tend toward a lawful alignment, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Voss typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of grey.

{@b {@i Precognition.}} You see brief visions of the future, that allow you to turn failures into successes. When you roll a 1 on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
{@b {@i Mystic Healing.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Voss Weapon Training.}} You have proficiency with the {@item Blaster rifle|sw5e-phb} and {@item Techblade|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Inscrutable.}} Your calm demeanor and control make you hard to read. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against an effect that would read your thoughts.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Voss. The Voss language is characterized by it's mystic-sounding word pairings.

rows: Dark blues, greens, greys, or reds
Bulbous eyes, head crests, three-fingered hands

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Vurks are the predominant sentient species of the planet Sembla. They are tall, reptilian humanoids with bulbous dark eyes and sweeping head crests. Their hands and feet have three digits each, one of which was opposable. They have distinguishing gray-green, leathery skin. Being able to breathe both water and air, they are perfectly adapted to travel Sembla's warm, shallow seas dotted with volcanic islands. They share a strong nomadic instinct with their amphibious ancestors.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Young Vurk males are married off by their parents; those who failed to marry before reaching adulthood remain bachelors for the rest of their lives. Because their way of living resulted in virtually no sizable permanent settlement whatsoever, Vurks were generally considered primitive by the rest of the galaxy; however, that was not true. They are very intelligent and believe in a highly developed philosophical tradition that emphasizes personal integrity and individual freedom and encourage personal honesty. Their compassionate and calm manner made them better than average diplomats.

Vurks are very family-oriented. It is common for multiple generations to remain in the same location as a single household, with the eldest family member being the patriarch or matriarch and making the decision for the entire family.

entries.name: Names
entries: Vurk names are traditionally two to three syllables. Female names typically end with a vowel, while male names vary. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Coleman, Jadran, Milanko, Zlatko {@b Female Names.} Elka, Iryna, Miglena, Tanya, Verka {@b Surnames.} Cheevochik, Provric, Trebor, Vorgecz

entries.name: Vurk Traits
entries: As a vurk, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Vurk reach adulthood in their 20s and live an average of 70 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Vurk philosophies cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Vurks typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 175 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.
{@b {@i Athletic.}} You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Head Crest.}} Your head crest is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Semblan. Semblan has a very melodic feel and often evokes images of waterfalls to those who don't understand its meanings.

rows: Four arms, long necks, spindly limbs

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Xexto are spindly invertebrates with four arms with six fingers and two legs with ten toes. Almond-shaped eyes dominate a small head perched atop a long neck. Their brain is split between two parts of their body; the part located in the skull controls primitive emotions and basic body functions, while another portion in their chest controls higher functions such as creative thinking and logic. It's believed that xexto's body structure and lightning-fast reflexes developed to help them escape predators while pursuing their own prey, there is no question that genetic manipulation forever altered their evolutionary development.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Although the Old Republic had long since outlawed experimentation on sentient beings, unscrupulous arkanian geneticists continued to search for primitive sentients on distant planets as fodder for their experiments. One such group found the xexto's forbears- a society of loosely organized hunter-gatherer tribes taking shelter in the trees of Troiken. Independently, they developed technologically advanced civilizations, and were on the verge of attaining interstellar travel when Republic scouts contacted them. Difficult terrain and dangerous predators found on their homeworld have led many Xexto to admire and encourage risk-taking. Despite their thrillseeking nature and willingness to take risks, xexto are generally well mannered and even-tempered. Questioning a Xexto's bravery is one way to make him or her angry.

entries.name: Names
entries: Xexto have very unique names, often sounding odd to outsiders. Surnames are familiar but optional.
{@b First Names.} Babading, Cicity, Gastoro, Maila, Qinla {@b Surnames.} Cherum, Hevad, Qatabas, Riived, Serap

entries.name: Xexto Traits
entries: As a xexto, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Xexto reach adulthood at 9 and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Despite being avid thrillseekers, xexto are calm and even tempered, tending them towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Xexto typically stand 3 to 5 feet tall and generally weigh about 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.
{@b {@i Dexterous.}} You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}, or Sleight of Hand.
{@b {@i Fearless.}} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}.

{@b {@i Four-Armed.}} Xexto have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).
{@b {@i Jungle Dweller.}} Growing up in the rainforests of Troiken has left an impact. You don—t treat jungle terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

{@b {@i Racer's Reflexes.}} Whenever you make a Dexterity {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can choose to add 1d4 to the result. You cannot do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Split Mind.}} When you make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Once you've done so, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can do so again.

{@b {@i Treeclimber.}} You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} that involve climbing.

{@b {@i Undersized.}} Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can—t use heavy shields. Additionally, you can—t use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Xextese. Xextese is a blubbering sort of language, with many metaphors for natural phenomenon found in its vocabulary.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Physically, the Yevetha are tall beings with a ghoulish appearance that is bereft of any body hair, being described as being so gaunt as to seem skeletal due to their pallid gray skin and lithe builds. The species possesses six fingered hands that have retractable dewclaws. Each one is located on the inside of the wrist above their six-fingered hands. Their dewclaws shoot from a sheath of a skin beneath their cadaverous hands and are capable of being retracted. When extended fully, the wrist blades reach about a foot in length, and are used in close combat and blood sacrifices. The Yevetha also possess a greater tolerance for g-forces when compared to Human pilots.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Within their society, blood is an important aspect of their culture and is a central focus of their religious belief system. This has resulted in them becoming a particularly violent species. For the Yevetha, death is not to be feared. They are described as being dutiful, attentive, cautious but also fatalistic in their view of the universe. When fighting against other foes, Yevetha are notable for being ruthless fighters who never surrender even in the face of certain defeat. Due to the brutal nature of their society, the Yevetha do not possess a single jail, penitentiary or stockade as they believe there is no need for such facilities. In fact, they do not possess a word in their language for either convict or incarcerate.

entries.name: Names
entries: Yevetha names are sharp and are kept to one syllable, not varying significantly based on gender. Surnames are familial.
{@b First Names.} Ral, Var, Cax, Tav, Fol, Sip, Nov {@b Surnames.} Faalk, Naalar, Giinn, Ralle, Xoota

entries.name: Yevetha Traits
entries: As a yevetha, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Yevetha reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Yevetha's xenophobic attitude causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Yevetha typically stand between 6 and 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

{@b {@i Aggressive.}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

{@b {@i Arm Blades.}} Your retractable dewclaws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.
{@b {@i Toughness.}} Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

{@b {@i Mechanical Memory.}} Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check related to memorizing or duplicating mechanical readouts, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Yevethan. Yevetha are able to speak other languages, but their isolationist nature makes them tend to reject the languages of other species. Only rarely would a Yevethan speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, as this would often decrease their social standing.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Zeltrons are one of the few near-human species that differentiated from the baseline stock enough to be considered a new species of the Human genus, rather than simply a subspecies. They possess two biological traits of note. The first is that they all produce potent pheromones, similar to the Falleen species, which enhanced their attractiveness and likeability. The second is a limited telepathic ability, used to project emotions onto others, as well as allowing them to read and even feel the emotions of others; some Zeltrons have been hired by the Exchange for this ability. Because of their telepathic ability, positive emotions such as happiness, love and pleasure are very important to them, while negative ones such as anger, fear, or depression are shunned.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Zeltron culture is highly influenced by sexuality and the pursuit of pleasure in general. Most of their art and literature is devoted to the subject, producing some of the raciest pieces in the galaxy. Zeltrons are known to dress in wildly colorful or revealing attire. It's common to see Zeltrons wearing shockingly bright shades of neon colors in wildly designed bikinis, or nearly skin tight clothing of other sorts with bizarre color designs, patterns, and symbols.

entries.name: Names
entries: Zeltron names often have an air of mystique to them, to evoke sensuality. For a Zeltron, a beautiful face is nothing without an equally beautiful name. It's not uncommon for a Zeltron to forsake their familial surname in favor of a more attractive-sounding one.
{@b Male Names.} Marruc, Bahb, Rahulh, Demagol {@b Female Names.} Lyshaa, Dani, Vianna, Chantique {@b Surnames.} D'Pow, Blue, Duare, Sapphire

entries.name: Zeltron Traits
entries: As a zeltron, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Zeltron reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 80 years.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Zeltron are a deeply sensual, hedonistic species, causing them to tend toward chaotic balanced or dark side alignments, though there are exceptions.

{@b {@i Size.}} Zeltron tend to be slender and statuesque, typically standing between 5 and 6 feet tall and rarely weighing more than 150 lb. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Charismatic.}} You have proficiency with {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

{@b {@i Enthralling Pheromones.}} You can use your pheromones to influence individuals of both sexes. Whenever you roll a 1 on a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Additionally, once per short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower on a Charisma check as a 10. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

{@b {@i Natural Empathy.}} Zeltron's limited telepathy allow them to sense mood shifts in those around them. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

{@b {@i Two Livered.}} Zeltron have two livers, which makes them adept at filtering toxins. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage (explained in chapter 9).
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice.

rows: Four-fingered hands, three-toed feet, stalk eyes

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The zilkins are a bipedal, amphibious species discernible by their diminutive stature and stalk eyes. Their homeworld, Zilk, has many dense jungles and swamps deemed impossible to navigate by most species. Only the zilkins themselves, evolved from worm-like creatures, were able to easily slip through the gaps in the tangled, coarse foliage. Their powerful legs make them adept at swimming and leaping.
Zilkin also have bulbous chins which inflate with excess air while they are speaking.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Their short lifespans cause zilkins to be one of the fastest learners in the galaxy, capable of learning in weeks what takes other species months. Zilkins live in large communities woven into the thick clumps of trees on Zilk. Whenever a dispute occurs, zilkins turn to a ritualistic form of debate where everyone affected voices their opinion on the matter. Whoever croaks their views the loudest and most confidently, wins. As a result, zilkins tend to be quite opinionated.

For a long time, the zilkins remained unknown to the galaxy at large, simply because few individuals had any interest in visiting Zilk, let alone exploring its notoriously impenetrable jungles. Having lived in isolation for so many generations, and often mocked for their size, zilkins tend to exhibit cantankerous behavior toward other species. Despite this, a number of zilkins leave their homeworld and take an active role in galactic politics, gaining the planet representation in the Senate.

entries.name: Names
entries: Zilkin names are usually clear and concise. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Belip, Jegg, Meebur, Ponix {@b Female Names.} Fula, Nili, Sia, Vo {@b Surnames.} Bestrein, Cruu, Odebre, Telvet

entries.name: Zilkin Traits
entries: As a zilkin, you have the following special traits: {@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Zilkin are considered adults at 4 years old, and rarely live to be over 12.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Zilkin have an outspoken but just nature that causes them to tend towards lawful light side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Zilkin stand between 1 and 2 feet tall and weigh around 10 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Tiny.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 20 feet.
{@b {@i Amphibious.}} You can breathe air and water.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Pintsized.}} Your tiny stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use medium or heavy shields. Additionally, you can't wield weapons with the two-handed or versatile property, and you can only wield one-handed weapons in two hands unless they have the light property.

{@b {@i Puny.}} Zilkin are too small to pack much of a punch. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when determining your bonus to attack and damage rolls for weapon attacks using Strength, you can't add more than +3.
{@b {@i Quick Learner.}} When using downtime for learning a new language or training with a set of tools, it takes half the amount of time and credits necessary to complete.

{@b {@i Small and Nimble.}} You are too small and fast to effectively target. You have a +1 bonus to AC, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

{@b {@i Strong-Legged.}} When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.
{@b {@i Swim.}} You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 20 feet.

{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Zilkin. Zilkin is characterized by loud, croaking noises from the throat, supported by air stored in the chin.

rows: Large pointed ears, clawed hands, fur-covered faces, bony facial spurs

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Zygerrians are a bipedal, sentient humanoid species. Feline in appearance, the species possesses strong, angular features, with long fangs jutting from their jaws and claws extending from their hands. The Zygerrians' faces and their pointed ears are almost entirely covered with fur; males usually have more hair than females, with bands of fur growing on their cheeks. Male Zygerrians also display a number of bony spurs protruding from the chin, which females typically lack. Zygerrians usually have sallow complexions and are physically strong, but some suffer from obesity.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: A warlike species, the Zygerrians hold strength—both physical and mental—in great esteem, viewing it as a means to gain power and authority. They believe that it is the natural order of life for the strong to dominate the weak, so slavery is normal for the species, and a display of weakness could mean death or enslavement in their culture. Those who become their slaves are viewed as inferior by the Zygerrians.

Zygerrian society is organized into clans and classes. They have a noble class, many members of which, despite their high status, pursue a career in the military. The Zygerrian government is a monarchy; female rulers hold the title of Queen, and males are addressed as Kings.
The center of the Zygerrian society is the Zygerrian Slavers Guild, which focuses on the slave trade in the Outer Rim Territories.

entries.name: Names
entries: Zygerrian names are rather diverse, though shorter names are the most common. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Agruss, Darts, Atai, Sono {@b Female Names.} Miraj, Faralhi, Latrans, MaDall {@b Surnames.} D'nar, Molec, Scientel, Thanda, Tyne

entries.name: Zygerrian Traits
entries: As a Zygerrian, you have the following special traits.
{@b {@i Ability Score Increase.}} Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.
{@b {@i Age.}} Zygerrians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
{@b {@i Alignment.}} Zygerrian culture's emphasis on subjugation and strength causes them to tend towards chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.
{@b {@i Size.}} Zygerrians normally stand between 5 to 6 feet tall and weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
{@b {@i Speed.}} Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.
{@b {@i Acrobatic.}} You have proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}.
{@b {@i Claws.}} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

{@b {@i Darkvision.}} You have a cat's keen senses, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

{@b {@i Notorious Slavers.}} Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} related to the buying, selling, or controlling of slaves, you are considered proficient in the check. If you would already be proficient, you instead have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}.
{@b {@i Reputation for Cruelty.}} You are proficient in {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, as well as the {@item Saberwhip|sw5e-phb|saberwhip} and {@item Vibrowhip|sw5e-phb|vibrowhip}.
{@b {@i Languages.}} You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Zygerrian. Zygerrian is characterized by its subtle growls and purrs.

entries.name: Adrenaline
entries: {@i 1st-level tech power}

items: {@b Casting Time:} 1 {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}, which you take when a creature within range that you can see would roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}

entries: You infuse one creature within range with a jittery burst of power, speeding its senses and reactions to the point of near {@spell Precognition|sw5e-phb|precognition}. The creature makes its {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} check with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Aid Droid
entries: {@i 1st-level tech power}

Choose one droid or construct that you can see within range. The target can immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 1d6 + your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} modifier.
{@b {@i Overcharge Tech.}} When you cast this power using a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

entries.name: Alter Self
entries: {@i 2nd-level tech power}

You alter your form with tech. When you cast the power, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the power. While the power lasts, you can end one option as an action to gain the benefits of a different one.
